title: Junior Full-Stack Developer - Arthace (Surat, Onsite)
description:
**About Arthace** Arthace ("Maximise Financial Intelligence") is an AI\-powered double\-entry accounting product for Indian businesses. We're at pilot stage and shipping toward a public launch in couple of months. We're hiring our first engineer to take over day\-to\-day engineering execution and ship the launch alongside the founder.

**Role at a glance**

* Position: Junior Full\-Stack Developer (first technical hire)
* Experience: 1–3 years (strong freshers with shipped projects also welcome)
* Salary: ₹25,000 – ₹35,000 per month (top of band for clear AI\-tool shipping history)
* Hours: Mon–Sat, standard business hours, onsite
* Reporting: Directly to founders
* **Immediate joiners strongly preferred**

**Where you'll work**

* **First month:** at our office in Tatithaiya (Block 178, Parekh Industrial Estate, Tal\-Palsana, Surat 394315\), working closely with the engineering founder
* **From month 2 onward:** at our coworking space in **Vesu, Surat** with the rest of the team

This is an onsite role.

**What you'll own**

*Bug fixing in the live product*

* Take partner\-reported bugs across voucher pages, reports, and master data screens; locate the surface in our React \+ Node \+ Postgres codebase; ship a clean fix using AI coding tools
* Read AI\-generated code critically \- catch issues, push back when something is wrong, validate the output before it ships
* For accounting\-sensitive changes, run the audit checks before pushing \- incorrect numbers are unacceptable

*Deploys and CI*

* Own the deploy pipeline on Railway: every push triggers a deploy, you confirm the healthcheck goes green and surface failed builds with the failing log step
* Own GitHub Actions CI hygiene: when tests go red, you triage whether it's a real regression or an environment issue, and resolve it the same day
* Manage environment variables and connection strings carefully \- no credentials in chat, ever

*Data safety*

* Own daily Postgres backups, restore tests, and off\-site copies. Client financial data must never be lost
* Maintain SSL, secrets management, access control, and a sensible security posture we can show clients

*Release handoffs to QA*

* After every shipped change, author a clear "for smoke test" handoff document
* Co\-founder Rahul runs partner\-pilot QA on every release before it goes live; you collate his retest feedback at the start of the next session and flag what passed vs. what still needs work

*Pilot growth*

* Help onboard new pilot accountants: run our import scripts, verify the trial balance matches their existing system
* As you ramp, take ownership of one larger feature track post\-launch (bank reconciliation / GSTR\-2A / multi\-tenant scale\-up)

**Must\-have skills**

* Hands\-on experience using **AI coding tools (Claude, Cursor, Copilot, or similar) to actually build and ship a project** \- please share what you built
* Working knowledge of **Node.js or Python** \- comfortable reading and writing backend code
* Comfort with **Git, command line, and reading logs** (build logs, server logs, browser console errors)
* Experience **deploying an application to a real server** (Railway, Vercel, AWS, DigitalOcean, Hetzner, or similar) \- env vars, healthchecks, connection strings
* Basic **SQL** — SELECT / JOIN / WHERE / GROUP BY, transactions, indexes
* Strong written and spoken English \- you'll write daily release handoffs another person executes without re\-asking
* Honesty about what you do and don't know

**Nice to have**

* PostgreSQL or Prisma ORM beyond basic queries
* React / JSX comfort (controlled inputs, useState, useEffect)
* Familiarity with Indian accounting (GST, TDS, Trial Balance, vouchers) or accounting software (Tally, Zoho Books, QuickBooks)
* Conversational Hindi \- useful for nuanced bug reports from pilot partners
* Side projects on GitHub

**Who you are**

* Owner, not ticket\-closer. If something is broken before a client demo, you tell us before we find out
* Careful with data. Accounting numbers must be exactly right
* Pattern\-spotter. When a bug shows up in one place, your first instinct is to check whether the same pattern exists elsewhere in the code
* Process\-oriented. You document what you ship and what you tested
* Want to grow into a senior role as we scale

**Why this role is interesting**

* First engineering hire on a paying\-pilot accounting product, going to launch this year
* Direct working relationship with the founders, no manager layer
* Deep, real\-world exposure to AI\-paired software development
* Clear path to Senior Engineer / Tech Lead as we incorporate and scale
* Compensation moves with performance and the company's stage

**How to apply** Apply through Indeed with:

* A short cover note (5–10 lines): what you've shipped using AI coding tools. Link, demo, or GitHub repo ideal
* CV / resume
* Current notice period and earliest joining date
* Expected monthly salary

Email: **hello@rahuldbhatia.com**. WhatsApp **\+91 98252 75100** for quick questions only \- not for applications.

Arthace is an equal\-opportunity employer. We hire based on what you can build, not where you went to school.

Pay: ₹25,000\.00 \- ₹35,000\.00 per month

* Have you used Claude, Cursor, Copilot, or similar AI coding tools to build and ship a project? (Yes / No)
* Briefly describe one project you built using AI coding tools.
* Do you have at least 1 year of hands\-on experience with Node.js or Python? (Yes / No)

* Are you willing to work onsite in Surat — first month at Tatithaiya, then Vesu coworking? (Yes / No)

 Cityfurnish is a fast\-growing furniture and appliance rental platform operating across 7 Indian cities. We combine technology, design, and operations to deliver a seamless subscription experience — and we're now building the people infrastructure to match our growth.
 



  





**ABOUT THE ROLE** 




  





 We're looking for a Senior HR Manager to own the entire people function — from hiring and compliance to administration and legal. **Talent Acquisition**

 •     Define hiring frameworks, manage offer negotiation, and own onboarding experience
 



  





**Learning, Development \& Training** 




 •     Design L\&D plans for corporate and warehouse teams

 •     Ensure all regulatory\-mandated certifications are current and renewed on time
 



  





**Payroll \& Compensation** 




 •     Own accurate, on\-time payroll for all employees including contract and warehouse workforce
 



 •     Handle FnF settlements, increments, and TDS coordination with finance
 



  





**Statutory \& Regulatory Compliance** 




 •     Corporate: PF, ESIC, PT, Gratuity, Shops \& Establishment Act, POSH, Labour Welfare Fund
 



 •     Warehouse: Fire NOC, medical fitness, PPE enforcement, accident reporting, contractor compliance
 



 •     Maintain a zero\-miss compliance calendar and liaise with labour departments
 



  





**Legal \& Employee Relations** 




 •     Draft and enforce HR policies — employment agreements, NDAs, asset and data policies
 



 •     Handle absconding cases end\-to\-end: legal notices, asset recovery, FIR coordination
 



 •     Manage terminations, PIPs, show\-cause notices, and labour court matters
 



  





**Exit Management** 




 •     Own full exit lifecycle — asset recovery, access revocation, FnF, exit interviews
 



 •     Track attrition trends and present quarterly insights to leadership
 



  





**Performance Management** 




 •     Build the PMS framework from scratch — KRAs, review cycles, ratings, PIP process
 



 •     Tie outcomes to increments, promotions, and recognition programs
 



  





**Administration \& Facilities** 




 •     Manage the office space end\-to\-end — housekeeping, security, AMCs, pantry, seating
 



 •     Handle landlord/building liaison, lease documentation, and office insurance
 



  





**Vendor Management** 




 •     Own all HR and admin vendors — staffing, BGV, payroll, HRMS, compliance, legal
 



 •     Negotiate contracts, manage SLAs, and conduct periodic performance reviews
 



  





**WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR** 




  





 •     8–13 years of HR experience with at least 3 years in a leadership role
 



 •     Mandatory: prior experience in warehouse, logistics, or manufacturing
 



 •     Proven ability to build HR systems and policies from scratch
 



 •     Strong knowledge of Indian labour law, statutory compliance, and HR legal frameworks
 



 •     Hands\-on with payroll, admin, and facilities — not just oversight
 



 •     Strong vendor network and excellent written communication
 



 •     High ownership mindset — comfortable building structure where none exists
 



  





**WHY JOIN CITYFURNISH** 




  





 •     Build the HR function from the ground up — full ownership from day one
 



 •     Direct access to founders and high visibility across the organisation
 



 •     Fast\-paced startup with real problems to solve at scale
 



 •     Competitive compensation commensurate with experience

* Comprehensive ratio analysis — liquidity (current, quick), profitability (ROE, ROA, EBITDA margins), solvency (D/E, interest coverage), and efficiency (asset turnover, receivables days).

title: Polymer Laboratory Technician
description:
Working at **Ray Colors**, a specialized masterbatch manufacturer based in Anand, Gujarat, involves working with high\-tech equipment to develop and test colorants and performance additives. Since they cater to demanding sectors like fiber, automotive, and packaging, the role of a Lab Technician is critical for maintaining their reputation for "innovation and honesty."

Below is a structured job description tailored for both entry\-level and experienced candidates.

Job Title: Polymer Lab Technician

**Location:** Anand (Vitthal Udyognagar), Gujarat

**Company:** Ray Colors (Masterbatch \& Compound Division)

**Employment Type:** Full\-Time

Role Overview

You will be responsible for the formulation, testing, and quality assurance of polymer masterbatches. This includes color matching, physical property testing, and operating lab\-scale machinery to ensure products meet stringent industrial standards (ISO/ASTM).

Key ResponsibilitiesFor Freshers (Trainee Level)

* **Sample Preparation:** Assist in weighing pigments, additives, and resins according to batch cards.
* **Machine Operation:** Learn to operate lab\-scale extruders, injection molding machines, and blown\-film lines under supervision.
* **Testing Basics:** Perform routine tests such as **Melt Flow Index (MFI)** and moisture analysis.
* **Housekeeping:** Maintain a clean and organized laboratory environment and ensure all samples are labeled and stored correctly.
* **Documentation:** Accurately record test data in lab registers or ERP systems.

For Experienced Candidates (Senior/Technician Level)

* **Color Matching:** Use spectrophotometers to match precise shades and develop new color formulations (Black, White, and Special Effects).
* **Advanced Testing:** Conduct complex analyses including **Filter Pressure Tests (FPT)**, Tensile Strength, and UV Weathering tests.
* **R\&D Support:** Collaborate with the R\&D team to develop "Nano Masterbatches" or high\-performance additives.
* **Troubleshooting:** Identify the root cause of batch failures (e.g., poor dispersion or pigment streaks) and suggest corrective actions.
* **Calibration:** Manage the periodic calibration and maintenance of sensitive lab instruments.

title: Embedded Systems Engineer
description:
**Job Summary:**

Muonix, a rapidly expanding electronics manufacturing company based in Jaipur, is looking for a highly skilled **Embedded Systems Engineer** to design, develop, and implement firmware for our next generation of hardware products. You will be responsible for the entire lifecycle of microcontroller programming—from selecting the right architecture to writing low\-level drivers and optimizing system performance. The ideal candidates will possess a strong passion for electronics and a desire to contribute to the manufacturing of high\-quality electronic products.

**Responsibilities:**

* Microcontroller Programming: Design and implement firmware in C/C\+\+ for various MCU architectures (e.g., ARM Cortex\-M, ESP32, STM32, or PIC).
* Hardware Interfacing: Develop and debug low\-level drivers for peripherals such as UART, SPI, I2C, CAN, ADC, and PWM.
* System Architecture: Design efficient software architectures for real\-time systems, including memory management and power optimization.
* Testing \& Debugging: Use hardware tools like Oscilloscopes, Logic Analyzers, and Multimeters to troubleshoot firmware\-to\-hardware communication issues.
* RTOS Implementation: Develop applications using Real\-Time Operating Systems (e.g., FreeRTOS, Zephyr) or bare\-metal environments.
* Collaboration: Work closely with hardware engineers to review PCB schematics and ensure firmware compatibility with hardware layouts.

**Qualifications:**

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* B. Tech. in Electrical Engineering, Electronics \& Communication, Computer Science (IOT), or a related field.
* Prior experience in electronics manufacturing.
* Knowledge of industry standards and regulations.
* Familiarity with quality management systems.

title: Software Engineer
description:
**About Us**
 Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.
   

  

 At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.
   

  

 Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Visa’s Technology Organization** 
 is a community of problem solvers and innovators reshaping the future of commerce. We operate the world’s most sophisticated processing networks capable of handling more than 65k secure transactions a second across 80M merchants, 15k Financial Institutions, and billions of everyday people. While working with us you’ll get to work on complex distributed systems and solve massive scale problems centered on new payment flows, business and data solutions, cyber security, and B2C platforms.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 We are looking for Versatile, curious, and energetic Software Engineers who embrace solving complex challenges on a global scale.
   

  

 As a Software Engineer, you will form an integral role in the development and deployment of medium to complex solutions that process millions of transactions per day worldwide. We are looking for experienced stars to solicit input from business and technology stakeholders across the enterprise and be responsible for the quality of large\-scale technology initiatives.
   

  

 You’re an Individual. We’re the team for you. Together, let’s transform the way the world pays.
   

  

**The Work Itself**
* Design code and systems that touch 40% of the world population while influencing Visa’s internal standards for scalability, security, and reusability
* Collaborate multi\-functionally to create design artifacts and develop best\-in\-class software solutions for multiple Visa technical offerings
* Actively contribute to product quality improvements, valuable service technology, and new business flows in diverse agile squads
* Develop robust and scalable products intended for a myriad of customers including end\-user merchants, b2b, and business to government solutions.
* Leverage innovative technologies to build the next generation of Payment Services, Transaction Platforms, Real\-Time Payments, and Buy Now Pay Later Technology
* Opportunities to make a difference on a global or local scale through mentorship and continued learning opportunities


**Essential Functions**
* Work as a member of a team responsible for designing, coding, testing and maintaining Visa's payment products.
* Contribute to enhancements and changes to existing applications codebase.
* Develop code that complies with design specifications and meets security and Java/J2EE best practices. Use industry standard design patterns where applicable.
* Create code that is easily maintainable and have high system performance.
* Collaborate with Development \& QA staff on individual and team deliverables.
* Utilize GenAI tools to enhance software development processes, including code generation, optimization, and testing.
* Identify opportunities for future enhancements and refinements to standards, best practices, design patterns and development methodologies.
* Work closely with project team and other groups (e.g. Platform, Ops, Release Engineering/Management).
* Participate in design and code review sessions to ensure the quality of work delivered by self and teammates are in accordance with development standards.
* Interact with business units to define requirements/modifications and use case to utilize in designing appropriate solutions. Ask question to understand what and why and then decide the how.
* Adapt quickly to new application knowledge and changes. Complete proof of concepts and other technical evaluations of technologies, designs and solutions
* Work in a loosely structured, fast\-paced organization


**The Skills You Bring**
* Energy and Experience: A growth mindset that is curious and passionate about technologies and enjoys challenging projects on a global scale
* Challenge the Status Quo: Comfort in pushing the boundaries, ‘hacking’ beyond traditional solutions
* Language Expertise: Expertise in one or more general development languages (e.g., Java, C\#, C\+\+)
* Builder: Experience building and deploying modern services and web applications with quality and scalability
* Learner: Constant drive to learn new technologies such as Angular, React, Kubernetes, Docker, etc.
* Partnership: Experience collaborating with Product, Test, Dev\-ops, and Agile/Scrum teams
* We do not expect that any single candidate would fulfill all of these characteristics. For instance, we have exciting team members who are really focused on building scalable systems but didn’t work with payments technology or web applications before joining Visa.


 This is a hybrid position. Hybrid employees can alternate time between both remote and office. Employees in hybrid roles are expected to work from the office 2\-3 set days a week (determined by leadership/site), with a general guidepost of being in the office 50% or more of the time based on business needs.
   

  

 Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.
   

  

**Qualifications**
 Education/Experience:
   

  

 Bachelors/Masters degree in computer science/Computer Engineering or other related fields with minimum of 6 months to 2 yrs experience in application development.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 6 months to 2 years of relevant work experience with a Bachelor’s Degree or at least 6 months – 1 year of experience with an Advanced Degree (e.g. Masters)
* 6 months to 2 years of hands\-on experience in Java/J2EE application development
* Proficiency in frameworks: Spring Boot, Spring MVC, JPA, Hibernate
* Experience building and consuming RESTful APIs with a focus on security and reliability
* Object oriented analysis and design using common design patterns and adherence to SOLID principals
* Familiarity with Test\-Driven Development (TDD) and unit testing frameworks (JUnit, Mockito)
* Creative, high\-energy, proactive problem\-solving skills with appropriate sense of urgency.
* Focus on customers and user experience
* Ability to write clean, coherent code following established coding guidelines
* Knowledge of relational databases: Oracle, MySQL, PostgreSQL and NoSQL databases
* Knowledge in Microservice architecture, Containers Orchestration (Kubernetes, Docker etc.,)
* Good understanding of generative AI models and tools/LLMs, such as Claude Code, GPT, Llama etc.,
* Familiarity with GenAI tools such as GitHub copilot, chatGPT, Copilot for Microsoft 365, and other relevant platforms
* Knowledge in software configuration management with tools development, automation (GIT, Maven, Artifactory, Jenkins, CI/CD etc.,)
* Exposure to monitoring/logging tools: Splunk, ClickHouse, or equivalent


**Visa is an EEO Employer**
 Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

title: Trial Attorney (Health Care Fraud) Open Continuous
description:
Hiring Organization
  
National Fraud Enforcement Division
  
Hiring Office
  
National Fraud Enforcement Division
  
Attorney Appointment Type
  
Attorney Term
  
  

**Location:**  

Multiple Locations
  
  

**Application Deadline:**  

Wednesday, September 30, 2026
  
About the Office
  
  

This announcement will be open until positions are filled. However, first round consideration will be given to applications submitted by May 25, 2026, 11:59 pm, Eastern Standard Time. Applications will be reviewed approximately every two weeks.
  
  

The Department of Justice’s National Fraud Enforcement Division (“Fraud Division”) investigates and prosecutes those who commit fraud against the American people. We fulfill our mission by using advanced data\-driven investigative techniques; coordinating with agencies responsible for administering taxpayer\-funded programs; partnering with federal, tribal, state, territorial, and local law enforcement on fraud\-fighting efforts; developing systems and processes that ensure efficient identification and investigation of fraud; and equipping prosecutors and law enforcement with state\-of\-the\-art tools and resources needed to bring criminal actors to justice. The Fraud Division works every day to protect the financial integrity of the United States of America, ensure the vibrancy of the American economy, and seek justice for victims of fraud.
  
  

Job Description
  
  

The National Fraud Enforcement Division, U.S. Department of Justice, is seeking qualified, experienced attorneys for three\-year renewable term positions in the Fraud Division's Health Care Fraud (HCF). The HCF investigates and prosecutes the most complex health care fraud schemes.
  
  

The incumbent will serve as a Trial Attorney in HCF and, as such, will independently direct, conduct, and monitor investigations, prepare for and conduct trials, and advise on pleadings and other court filings. Upon accepting an offer of employment, applicants must make a three\-year commitment to the Fraud Division.
  
  

**Generally, as a Trial Attorney in the HCF, the incumbent:**  

Handles the development and management of HCF prosecutions. Engages in all phases of investigation and litigation, including, but not limited to, the use of grand jury, advising federal law enforcement agents, preparing appropriate pleadings, litigating motions, and conducting trials in U.S. District Court;
  
Makes charging decisions and proposes dispositions with regard to assigned cases; and
  
In collaboration with managers, develops and maintains the Fraud Division's program to foster effective investigation and prosecution of HCF violations, including advising on strategy and legal complexities, and developing litigation priorities, policy and legislative recommendations.
  
  

**Vacancies in the following locations:**  

Washington, DC
  
Los Angeles, CA
  
Miami, FL
  
Orlando, FL
  
Tampa, FL
  
Chicago, IL
  
New Orleans, LA
  
Boston, MA
  
Detroit, MI
  
Concord, NH
  
Newark, NJ
  
Brooklyn, NY
  
Dallas, TX
  
Houston, TX
  
San Francisco, CA
  
Phoenix, AZ
  
Las Vegas, NV
  
Philadelphia, PA
  
  

Qualifications
  
  

**Required Qualifications:** Interested applicants must possess a J.D., or equivalent, degree, be duly licensed and authorized to practice as an attorney under the laws of any State, territory of the United States, or the District of Columbia, and be an active member of the bar in good standing.
  
  

**Grade Specific Qualifications:**  

To qualify at the GS\-14 grade level, applicants must have at least two and a half (2\.5\) years post J.D. legal experience, one of which was specialized experience at, or equivalent to, the GS\-13 grade level. Examples of specialized experience include: performing legal analysis and formulating recommendations to senior managers; composing pleadings, briefs, and other court documents involving legal issues in civil or criminal litigation; and conducting civil or criminal litigation.
  
To qualify at the GS\-15 grade level, applicants must have at least four (4\) years post J.D. legal experience, one of which was specialized experience at, or equivalent to, the GS\-14 grade level. Examples of specialized experience include: independently performing legal analysis; composing pleadings, briefs and other court documents involving unique and/or difficult legal issues in civil or criminal litigation; conducting highly complex civil or criminal litigation; and leading paralegals and support staff.
  
  

**Preferred Qualifications:**  

Experience as a criminal prosecutor.
  
Experience with civil or criminal health care fraud matters.
  
Knowledge of white collar criminal litigation.
  
Experience in supporting, litigating, and supervising federal or state criminal cases.
  
Experience in U.S. District Court or state court.
  
Experience with the federal judiciary.
  
Application Process
  
  

The Application Package must be received by 11:59 PM, Eastern Time, on the closing date of this announcement. Please submit your application package to FraudDivisionHiring@usdoj.gov .
  
  

**A complete application package must include:**  

Cover Letter (highlighting relevant experience).
  
Resume \- Applicants will be evaluated based on a comparison of the position requirements against the quality and extent of experience or related education as reflected in their resume. Applicants are encouraged to ensure work experiences clearly show the possession of knowledge of the subject matter pertinent to the position and the technical skills to successfully perform the duties of the position. Your resume must be no more than 2 pages. Resumes longer than 2 pages will not be accepted. Please ensure all information you believe is qualifying for the position is contained within your resume, or you may be marked ineligible. Additionally, your resume must include your JD date and the following information for each job listed: month and year, start/end dates (e.g. June 2007 to April 2008\), and full\-time or part\-time status (include hours worked per week).
  
**Writing Sample:** Not to exceed 10 pages.
  
Documentation of eligibility for special hiring authorities (if applicable) to prove appointment eligibility. Examples include: Schedule A disability letter, Peace Corps volunteer letter, military spouse hiring authority documentation, etc.
  
Current or Former Political Appointees (if applicable) \- please note on your resume and attach an SF\-50\. The Office of Personnel Management (OPM) must authorize employment offers made to current or former political appointees. If you are currently, or have been within the last 5 years, a political Schedule A, Schedule C or Non\-Career SES employee in the Executive Branch, you must disclose this information to the HR Office.
  
Schedule A Documentation (if applicable) \- The Fraud Division welcomes and encourages applications from persons with disabilities and is firmly committed to satisfying its affirmative obligations under the Rehabilitation Act of 1973 to ensure that persons with disabilities have every opportunity to be hired and advanced on the basis of merit within the Department.
  
  

**Veterans Preference Documentation (if applicable):**  

If you are a discharged, non\-disabled veteran, you must submit a copy of your DD\-214 showing character discharge (Member 4 copy), or other Documentation of Service and Separation under Honorable Conditions. If you don't have your DD\-214, you may request it after discharge from the National Archives at www.archives.gov/veterans.
  
If you are a veteran within 120 days of discharge, you must submit signed documentation from the Armed Forces certifying: 1\) your expected release/retirement from active duty, 2\) under honorable conditions, 3\) your pay grade/rank/rate at time of discharge, 4\) dates of active duty service, 5\) any campaign or expeditionary medals received, and 6\) dated within 120 days of your separation.
  
If you are a disabled veteran, Purple Heart recipient, or mother or spouse of a disabled or deceased veteran, you must submit a completed SF\-15 http://www.opm.gov/forms/pdf\_fill/SF15\.pdf and all additional proof required by the SF\-15, as applicable. If you don't have your Department of Veterans Affairs letter establishing proof of disability, you may request it at https://www.va.gov/resources/getting\-started\-with\-va/ or call 1\-800\-827\-1000\.
  
  

Applicants should familiarize themselves and comply with the relevant rules of professional conduct regarding any possible conflicts of interest in connection with their applications. In particular, please notify this Office if you currently represent clients or adjudicate matters in which this Office is involved and/or you have a family member who is representing clients or adjudicating matters in which this Office is involved so that we can evaluate any potential conflicts of interest or disqualification issues that may need to be addressed under those circumstances.
  
  

Salary
  
  

This is a term position at the GS\-14 or GS\-15 grade level. The salary range for this position will be based on grade and locality. Please visit OPM's web page for more information on salary at https://www.opm.gov/policy\-data\-oversight/pay\-leave/salaries\-wages/.

title: Creative Lead
description:
Job description:

CACTUS is a remote\-first organisation and we embrace an accelerate from anywhere culture.  

This role is for someone who leads by example and is equally comfortable setting creative direction and getting hands\-on when required. As a Design \& Creative Lead, you are not just managing work; you are shaping quality, safeguarding brand integrity, and ensuring predictable delivery within a team\-based model.


You start the day with clarity by aligning with the Allocator, reviewing priorities, and knowing exactly what is in flight. Throughout the day, you stay close to the work: reviewing concepts, unblocking designers, joining critical calls, and ensuring that every deliverable moves forward with a clear owner and purpose.

  


Job responsibilities:  

* Provide clear creative direction across formats including print, digital, UI/UX, presentations, abstract visuals, and video storyboards, with a strong eye for aesthetics, usability, and storytelling.
* Guide the team toward stronger ideas through timely reviews, constructive feedback, and hands\-on intervention when required.
* Ensure every output meets a high bar for design, consistency, and execution. Review work early and often to avoid downstream rework.
* Take full accountability for what goes out, as the work represents the organisation, not just the individual.
* Act as the single point of contact for assigned brands and stakeholders, owning outcomes end\-to\-end across quality, timelines, First\-time\-right (FTR), Zero\-Error\-Delivery (ZED), and utilisation.
* Assess scope, complexity, and effort accurately. Prioritize work to meet timelines without compromising quality, recognising that strong work delivered late still impacts outcomes.
* Ensure one clear owner per deliverable from start to finish, and avoid midstream reshuffles unless unavoidable, with proper handover and clarity.
* Align daily with the Allocator to set priorities and assign work. Maintain visibility across all tasks covering status, owner, ETA, and risks.
* Know when to guide and when to step in hands\-on. Enable skill development and maintain fair and balanced workload distribution within the team.
* Balance workloads proactively to avoid under\- or over\-utilization. Look across teams to address capacity gaps before considering freelancers, and plan leave coverage to protect continuity.
* Act as the brand's voice and custodian within the team, ensuring consistency across all creative outputs through shared templates, components, file\-naming conventions, and version control.
* Personally review critical work and step in to unblock, accelerate, or close work when needed. Stay close to execution at all times.

  

\#LI\-Remote
Qualifications and prerequisites:
* Bachelor's degree or diploma in Graphic Design, Visual Communication, Fine Arts, or a related creative discipline, or equivalent professional experience with a strong portfolio demonstrating range across formats and brand work.
* 6 to 9 years of experience in design, with at least 2 to 3 years in a lead or senior creative role within a studio, agency, or in\-house creative team.
* Prior experience working within the pharmaceutical, life sciences, or medical communications industry is essential.
* Proven ability to lead creative output across print, digital, UI/UX, and presentation formats, with hands\-on execution capability to personally produce or finish work when required.
* Strong creative direction and critique skills; able to identify problems and guide solutions, not just flag issues.
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to articulate creative rationale clearly to both designers and non\-design stakeholders.
* Comfortable managing multiple brands and stakeholders simultaneously in a fast\-paced, structured delivery environment.
* Proficient in **Adobe Creative Suite** (Illustrator, Photoshop, InDesign, After Effects) and **Figma**; familiar with Microsoft PowerPoint and Google Slides for presentation design.
* Working knowledge of project and workflow management tools such as Asana, Monday.com, or similar. Awareness of AI\-assisted design tools including Adobe Firefly or Midjourney, with sound judgment on where and how to apply them responsibly.


Application process:

Before applying, please ensure you meet the role requirements listed above and have legal authorization to work in the country where this role is advertised. Our selection process typically involves an initial screening by a recruiter, a technical assessment, and two to three interview rounds. For this role, the process includes 1 round of **Technical Interview** with the Hiring Managers, followed by another interview round and then the final HR Round. All interactions will be conducted virtually via **MS Teams.**

 **Equal Opportunity**

  

Our hiring practices reflect our commitment to providing equal opportunities and creating an environment where everyone can thrive, develop, and succeed. We celebrate the uniqueness of our team members and prohibit discrimination of any kind, based on race, color, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, or any other protected characteristic.

 **Accelerating from Anywhere**


As a remote\-first organization, these are essential attributes we look for in all our candidates.

* Taking ownership of your work with minimal supervision, showing strong ability to organize, prioritize and deliver results independently.
* Documenting work that brings everyone on the same page.
* Maturity to choose between synchronous and asynchronous collaboration.
* Effectively collaborating with colleagues across different time zones by setting dedicated hours for collaboration and keeping team members updated through your MS Teams status.


About Us:

Cactus Life Sciences (cactuslifesciences.com) is a leading medical communication company headquartered in Princeton, NJ, with nine global offices. Its expertise lies in delivering scientific content across the product lifecycle with a focus on science, innovation, and efficiency. The company specializes in providing impactful medical strategy, custom operational models, content development and dissemination, and promotion of patient inclusion for biopharmaceutical organizations. Cactus Life Sciences’ scalable solutions cater to the challenges encountered in product development, guiding brands, and organizations towards their future objectives. With a client\-centric approach, the company prioritizes understanding their evolving needs and technology trends to drive its growth. Cactus Life Sciences is a subsidiary of Cactus Communications (cactusglobal.com/), a leading science communication and technology company.

title: Sr Manager HR Data Analytics
description:
Dayforce is a global human capital management (HCM) company headquartered in Toronto, Ontario, and Minneapolis, Minnesota, with operations across North America, Europe, Middle East, Africa (EMEA), and the Asia Pacific Japan (APJ) region.
  
Our award\-winning Cloud HCM platform offers a unified solution database and continuous calculation engine, driving efficiency, productivity and compliance for the global workforce.
  
Our brand promise \- Makes Work Life Better™\- Reflects our commitment to employees, customers, partners and communities globally.
  
  

About the opportunity
  
  

The Sr. Manager, HR Data Analytics leads the delivery of workforce insights, reporting, and analytics solutions that inform and influence business and talent decisions. Reporting to the Director, HRIS and Data Analytics, this role operates at the intersection of business strategy, data, and technology, translating workforce data into actionable intelligence.
  
  

This role is accountable for translating workforce strategy and business priorities into a clear analytics roadmap and delivering measurable impact through insights. The Sr. Manager leads day\-to\-day analytics operations, partners closely with HR and business leaders, and ensures outputs are decision\-focused, scalable, and aligned to enterprise priorities.
  
  

What you'll get to do
  
  

Workforce Analytics \& Insights Delivery
  
  

* Lead the development and delivery of workforce reporting, dashboards, and analytics across the employee lifecycle (hiring, engagement, performance, retention, workforce planning).
* Translate business questions into structured analytical approaches and actionable insights.
* Ensure analytics outputs are clear, decision\-oriented, and tied to measurable outcomes such as improved retention insights, hiring funnel visibility, and workforce cost transparency.
* Lead the advancement of analytics capabilities from descriptive reporting toward diagnostic and predictive insights, in alignment with team and organizational maturity.


Stakeholder Partnership
  
  

* Serve as a trusted advisor to HR, Finance, and business leaders on workforce analytics, helping shape decisions through data\-driven insights.
* Partner with HRBPs and COEs to identify key business questions and prioritize analytics initiatives.
* Communicate insights through clear, compelling storytelling tailored to executive and operational audiences.
* Partner with HR and Finance to support workforce planning and organizational decision\-making through data and analysis.


Analytics Operations \& Execution
  
  

* Own the operating model for workforce analytics, including intake, prioritization, and delivery processes.
* Manage a structured backlog and roadmap to ensure alignment with business priorities.
* Ensure timely, high\-quality delivery across recurring reporting and ad hoc analysis.
* Establish and track SLAs, performance metrics, and continuous improvement practices.
* Balance speed and analytical rigor across tactical and strategic work.


Data \& Technology Partnership
  
  

* Partner with HRIS and data teams to ensure data availability, integrity, and usability.
* Act as a business owner of key workforce metrics, ensuring consistent definitions and alignment across systems and reporting.
* Contribute to data governance practices including KPI definitions, data standards, and quality controls.
* Support development of scalable self\-service analytics capabilities.


Team Leadership
  
  

* Lead, develop, and mentor a team of analysts and BI professionals, while remaining close to the work to ensure quality and relevance of insights.
* Set clear performance expectations and development plans.
* Foster a culture of curiosity, accountability, and business impact.


Skills and experience we value
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in Analytics, Data Science, Statistics, Business, HR, or related field (or equivalent experience).
* 7–10\+ years of experience in workforce analytics, business intelligence, or related field.
* 3\-4\+ years of people leadership experience.
* Strong proficiency in BI tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau) and data querying (e.g., SQL).
* Experience working with HR systems (e.g., Dayforce) and workforce data.
* Demonstrated ability to translate business needs into analytical solutions.
* Strong communication skills with ability to present insights to senior stakeholders.


What would make you really stand out
  
  

* Experience in a complex, matrixed or high\-growth organization.
* Exposure to predictive analytics, workforce planning, or statistical modeling.
* Familiarity with data governance practices and enterprise data environments.
* Experience supporting executive\-level reporting.


Leadership Competencies
  
  

* Frames ambiguous business problems into structured, data\-driven approaches
* Influences decisions through evidence\-based insights
* Balances analytical rigor with speed and practicality
* Builds trust with stakeholders through consistency and insight quality
* Develops talent with both technical and consultative skillsets


What’s in it for you
  
Dayforce is fueled by the diversity of our talented employees. We are an equal opportunity employer and consider and embrace ALL individuals and what makes them unique. We believe our employees should be happy and healthy, with peace of mind and a sense of fulfillment.
  
We encourage individuals to apply based on their passions.
  
Dayforce encourages personal and professional growth. We offer excellent time away from work programs, comprehensive wellness initiatives and recognition through competitive pay and benefits.
  
With a commitment to community impact, including volunteer days and our charity, Dayforce Cares we provide opportunities for you to thrive both in your career and personal life. Our focus is not just on your job but on supporting you to be the best version of yourself.
  
Fraudulent Recruiting
  
Beware of fraudulent recruiting. Legitimate Dayforce contacts will use an @dayforce.com email address. We do not request money, checks, equipment orders, or sensitive personal data during the recruitment process. If you have been asked for any of the above, or believe you have been contacted by someone posing as a Dayforce employee, please refer to our fraudulent recruiting statement found here: https://www.dayforce.com/be\-aware\-of\-recruiting\-fraud
  
Dayforce actively monitors all job applications to ensure authenticity. Submissions determined to be fraudulent or misleading will be declined from the recruitment process

title: Senior Manager, People Technology
description:
What You'll Do:

Avalara is looking for a Senior Manager, People Technology to lead the daily delivery, optimization, and governance of our Workday platform. In this role, you will lead a team of Workday experts. This team designs, builds, and supports scalable solutions across the employee lifecycle. These solutions include human capital management, talent, performance, compensation, absence, benefits, payroll, recruiting, and Workday Extend. You will translate priorities into a practical roadmap, simplify processes, and help make Workday easier for employees, managers, Talent Acquisition, People and Culture, and Finance teams to use. You will also help Avalara strengthen operational readiness, improve people data quality, and apply automation and artificial intelligence in responsible, practical ways that reduce manual work and improve decision\-making.


You will be reporting to Director, Enterprise Systems.


What Your Responsibilities Will Be:
* Be a product owner for Workday across important modules, including core human capital management, talent, performance, compensation, absence, benefits, payroll, recruiting, and Workday Extend.
* Lead major Workday programs from discovery through deployment and stabilisation, including recruiting implementation, global process redesigns, new modules, and annual cycles.
* Oversee Workday operations, incidents, enhancements, data corrections, release planning, and service\-level performance.
* Define and maintain Workday configuration standards, security model principles, business process design guidelines, and change governance.
* Partner with People and Culture, Talent Acquisition, Payroll, Finance, Security, Audit, Compliance, and business leaders to align priorities, trade\-offs, timelines, and impacts.
* Manage Workday integrations with downstream systems, including payroll, benefits, identity, recruiting tools, and analytics platforms.
* Strengthen audit readiness, access reviews, control testing, privacy alignment, and system discipline to support risk management and business scale.
* Build and coach a high\-performing Workday team with clear ownership, documentation, and repeatable delivery practices.
* Identify automation and artificial intelligence opportunities across Workday and adjacent people processes, with attention to data quality, compliance, privacy, and user experience.
* Improve employee and manager experiences by simplifying hiring, transfers, performance, compensation, benefits, leave, and other Workday workflows.


What You'll Need to be Successful:
* + 10\+ years of experience in human resources information systems, People Technology, or human resources systems, including 6\+ years of hands\-on Workday ownership in a global environment.
	+ 4\+ years of people management experience leading Workday or human resources technology teams, with experience in coaching, raising team capability, and reducing reliance on external partners over time.
	+ Deep functional and configuration experience across multiple Workday modules, such as core human capital management, talent and performance, advanced compensation, time and absence, benefits, payroll, recruiting, Workday Extend, Studio, or Orchestrations.
	+ Experience leading large Workday programs, including implementations, new modules, major redesigns, global rollouts, integrations, vendor partnerships, and post\-launch stabilisation.
	+ Experience with end\-to\-end human resources and Talent Acquisition processes, Workday security, business process design, configuration standards, controls, and audit readiness.
	+ Simplify complexity, influence senior stakeholders, and apply automation and artificial intelligence responsibly to improve efficiency, system reliability, user experience and data quality
\#LI\-Remote


This is a remote position.

Avalara is an AI\-first Company:
**AI Expectations**


The successful candidate will:

* Identify and prioritize AI and automation opportunities within Workday and adjacent HR/TA processes to reduce manual work and improve decision quality.
* Evaluate AI\-enabled capabilities in Workday and related platforms, balancing innovation with data quality, risk, and change\-management needs.
* Apply sound judgment on ethics, privacy, and compliance when using AI in people processes, escalating risks and helping to shape appropriate governance and guardrails.
* Identify AI opportunities tied to revenue enablement, efficiency, workforce quality, or risk reduction.
* Elevate AI maturity and best practices across the function.

:

Assistant Manager \- Demand Planning **Function/Group**  

Logistics **Location**  

Mumbai **Shift Timing**  

1:30 PM to 10:30 PM **Role Reports to**  

Operational Demand \& Forecasting Leader **Remote/Hybrid/in\-Office**

-------------------


The Learning Business Partner (LBP) acts as the strategic interface between the business and the Learning \& Workforce (LVW) organization. description:
**Delivery Executive**
----------------------


Role Name : Delivery Executive


Grade : E1/E2


Location : Bangalore

  

**Role Summary**
----------------


The Delivery Executive \& Transformation Leader is a senior leadership role responsible for end to end delivery excellence, client satisfaction, and large scale delivery transformation, with a strong focus on offshore industrialization. The role combines accountability for business critical engagement delivery, financial performance, and risk management with the mandate to design and execute strategic transformation initiatives that scale offshore capabilities, improve productivity, and enable sustainable growth.
  

The role acts as a key interface between clients, onshore leadership, and offshore delivery organizations, ensuring predictable delivery, profitability, and continuous improvement while driving workforce transformation and capability building.


**Purpose of the role**
-----------------------

  

  

* Ensure successful delivery of complex and strategic engagements with high client satisfaction.
* Drive delivery productivity, profitability (DVI/CM), and operational excellence.
* Lead and execute offshore transformation initiatives, including transfer of work, and capability development.
* Act as an escalation point and trusted advisor for clients and internal stakeholders.
* Strengthen delivery, engagement management, and transformation maturity across the portfolio.
**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------


* Client \& Delivery Leadership
  

	+ Own and govern end to end delivery for complex and business critical engagements.
	+ Ensure client satisfaction (OTACE), proactive risk identification, and effective issue resolution.
	+ Act as the escalation point for delivery, commercial, and operational issues.
	+ Maintain strong relationships with senior client business and IT stakeholders, positioning Capgemini as a trusted delivery partner.
	+ Participate in solution reviews, deal qualification, and delivery sign off during pursuit and proposal stages


* Offshore Transformation \& Industrialization
  

	+ Lead execution of the Offshore Transformation roadmap, aligned to account and BU strategy.
	+ Identify, qualify, and transition suitable workstreams from onshore to offshore, ensuring delivery readiness and continuity.
	+ Support RFPs, renewals, and client pitches by demonstrating scalable offshore delivery models and success stories.
	+ Engage with clients to address resistance to offshoring by showcasing talent quality, governance, and delivery outcomes.


* Financial \& Commercial Accountability
  

	+ Accountable for delivery profitability, productivity, and contribution margin improvement.
	+ Own DVI, CM, revenue protection, and add on sales through disciplined delivery and contract governance.
	+ Lead or contribute to commercial management, including contract negotiations, change requests, and renewals.
	+ Ensure accurate forecasting (ETC, EAC), invoicing, and financial reporting.


* Governance, Risk \& Quality Management
  

	+ Establish and run robust delivery governance (M Reviews, monthly delivery inventory, risk dashboards).
	+ Ensure compliance with delivery processes, cybersecurity, data protection, and contractual obligations.
	+ Monitor portfolio level risks and lead mitigation plans in collaboration with MU/BU leader


* Talent, Capability \& Leadership Development
  

	+ Build and strengthen Engagement Manager capabilities across the portfolio.
	+ Define role based hiring and workforce plans to support offshore scale up across key technologies.
	+ Partner with practices to drive upskilling, certification, academies, and coaching.
	+ Develop strong successor pipelines, promote internal mobility, and improve retention.

  

***Key Interfaces:***

  

  

* Clients (Business, IT Leadership)
* Group Client Delivery Partners
* BU / MU Delivery Heads
* Onshore \& Offshore Delivery Leadership
* Practices, HR, Finance, Sales
**Ideal Candidate**
-------------------


He / she / they or the incumbment should have atleast 16\+ years of relevent expirence in managing E2E Delivery for an acocunt. A strong project record and expirence in P\&L management.

  

  

* Demonstrated success in offshore delivery transformation, capability scaling, or industrialization.

• Experience working across multi country, multi culture delivery organizations.• Deep understanding of delivery models, financial levers, and transformation frameworks.
  

* Strong client facing, stakeholder management, and crisis management skills.
* Ability to lead change, influence senior stakeholders, and drive alignment.
* Strong analytical, problem solving, and decision making capabilities.
* Excellent communication and people leadership skills.

  

***Certifications \& Qualifications:***

  

  

* EM Certification – Level 2 or above (mandatory for complex engagements).
* Strong foundation in at least one technology or industry domain.
* Knowledge of Capgemini multi SBU offerings and delivery ecosystem.
***Key Success Metrics (KPIs):***

  

Financial
  

* Revenue
* Contribution Margin (CM)
* DVI
* Add on sales

Operational
  

* OTACE (Client Satisfaction)
* Delivery quality \& schedule adherence
* Risk \& issue management effectiveness
* EM certification coverage and talent readiness

description:
**About us**

  

At ExxonMobil, our vision is to lead in energy innovations that advance modern living and a net\-zero future. As one of the world’s largest publicly traded energy and chemical companies, we are powered by a unique and diverse workforce fueled by the pride in what we do and what we stand for.

  

The success of our Upstream, Product Solutions and Low Carbon Solutions businesses is the result of the talent, curiosity and drive of our people. They bring solutions every day to optimize our strategy in energy, chemicals, lubricants and lower\-emissions technologies.

  

We invite you to bring your ideas to ExxonMobil to help create sustainable solutions that improve quality of life and meet society’s evolving needs. Learn more about **our What and our Why** and how we canwork **together**.

**ExxonMobil Affiliates in India**
----------------------------------

  

ExxonMobil’s affiliates have offices in India in Bengaluru, Mumbai and the National Capital Region.

  

ExxonMobil’s affiliates in India supporting the Product Solutions business engage in the marketing, sales and distribution of performance as well as specialty products across chemicals and lubricants businesses. The India planning teams are also embedded with global business units for business planning and analytics.

  

ExxonMobil’s LNG affiliate in India supporting the upstream business provides consultant services for other ExxonMobil upstream affiliates and conducts LNG market\-development activities.

**About Accenture**  

Accenture is a global professional services company with leading capabilities in digital, cloud and security.Combining unmatched experience and specialized skills across more than 40 industries, we offer Strategy and Consulting, Technology and Operations services, and Accenture Song— all powered by the world’s largest network of Advanced Technology and Intelligent Operations centers. We embrace the power of change to create value and shared success for our clients, people, shareholders, partners and communities.Visit us at www.accenture.com
  

**What would you do?** "You will need to assist employees in completing the I\-9 form, ensuring it is accurate, timely, and compliant. Use Form I\-9 to verify the identity and employment authorization of individuals hired for work in the United States. All U.S. employers are required to complete this form for every person they hire, including both citizens and noncitizens. The form must be completed by both the employee and the employer (or an authorized representative). The employee must attest to their employment authorization and provide acceptable documents that prove their identity and employment eligibility. The employer must review these documents to confirm they appear genuine and relate to the employee and then record the information on the Form I\-9\. Employee Service \- HR Delivery involves the execution and management of HR services and processes for employees. This includes tasks like payroll processing, benefits administration, onboarding, and handling employee records. The goal is to ensure that HR services are delivered efficiently and accurately. Effective HR delivery supports employee needs and helps maintain smooth HR operations. It is essential for ensuring a positive employee experience and organizational efficiency. Process and strategy of providing and managing human resources services and information to employees within an organization. This encompasses various aspects, including employee support, benefits administration, onboarding, payroll, and other HR related functions.  

**What are we looking for?** • This role requires a dedicated individual who can effectively navigate a dynamic environment while providing exceptional support to employees completing their I\-9 forms. • Handle back\-to\-back virtual calls with employees and authorized agents, ensuring a smooth scheduling process. • Over 3 years of prior HR customer service experience preferred. • Be available to assist employees during scheduled appointments, providing guidance on I\-9 form completion. • Demonstrate flexibility in managing high volumes of appointments, adjusting schedules as necessary to accommodate employee needs. • Prioritize tasks effectively to ensure timely completion of I\-9 forms. • Excellent phone etiquette. • Exceptional verbal and written communication skills. • Strong interpersonal skills. • Ability to remain calm and polite in stressful situations. • Outstanding organizational and multitasking abilities. • Willingness to collaborate with customers and management to address any issues. • Commitment to acting with integrity, professionalism, and confidentiality when handling sensitive information. • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills. • Eagerness to dive into a high\-volume workload in a remote environment.
  

**Roles and Responsibilities:** • Conduct virtual meetings with employees and their authorized agents to validate original documents. • Ensure that the Form I\-9 is accurately completed according to Federal USCIS guidelines and processed in a timely, compliant manner. • Coordinate with new hires to collect I\-9 supporting documentation, verify its authenticity, and ensure it falls within the list of acceptable documents. • Ensure that I\-9s are completed within the first day of employment or as specified by USCIS guidelines. • Follow up and resolve any I\-9s requiring further verification (e.g., SSA TNC, DHS TNC, human error). • Assist in maintaining and auditing I\-9s to achieve 100% completion for all new hires and reverifications. • Support People Operations team initiatives and contribute ideas to enhance processes. • Provide exceptional customer service. • Maintain confidentiality of information. • Perform other duties as needed. • Establish and maintain positive relationships with customers by using encouraging language and anticipating their needs."


  

Any Graduation

description:
Position Description  

We’re Hiring at CGI for our GCC \- Right Here in Hyderabad!  

Join us at the intersection of technology, finance, and innovation. You will be working to support the Financial Services Group, one of the top\-tier financial institutions in the U.S. You’ll help shape digital solutions for a global enterprise—from the ground up.  

This is more than a job. It’s your opportunity to:  

* Work on cutting\-edge technologies
* Collaborate with global teams
* Build a career with purpose and impact


Ready to build the future of banking? Let’s talk.  

Position Description:  

  

Job Title: Talent Acquisition Specialist \- Recruiter Contractor  

Position: Recruiter / Talent Acquisition Specialist (Contractor)  

Experience: 4\-7 years  

Category: Human Resources  

Shift: 11AM\-8PM  

Main location: India, Telangana, Hyderabad  

Position ID: J0426\-1794  

Employment Type: 6 Months Contract  

  

Job Overview:  

CGI is looking for a talented and motivated Recruiter with strong expertise in Sourcing and Stakeholder management to build and manage scalable, efficient, and reliable data pipelines and infrastructure. You’ll play a key role in transforming raw data into actionable insights, working closely with data scientists, analysts, and business teams.**Your future duties and responsibilities**


End\-to\-End Recruitment  

Manage complete recruitment lifecycle from requisition gathering to onboarding.  

Handle sourcing, screening, interviewing coordination, salary negotiation, and offer closure.  

Work on multiple positions simultaneously with focus on quality and turnaround time.  

Understand business requirements and align recruitment strategies accordingly.  

Ensure timely delivery against hiring targets and SLAs.  

Sourcing \& Talent Mapping  

Source candidates through job portals, LinkedIn, internal databases, employee referrals, and networking channels.  

Build strong talent pipelines for niche and volume hiring requirements.  

Conduct market mapping and competitor analysis for critical skill hiring.  

Utilize innovative sourcing techniques to identify passive candidates.  

Screening \& Candidate Assessment  

Conduct initial HR screening to assess technical fit, communication skills, cultural fit, and salary expectations.  

Validate candidate experience, notice period, compensation, and availability.  

Coordinate technical interviews and collect interview feedback from panels.  

Maintain high standards of candidate evaluation and documentation.  

Stakeholder Management  

Partner closely with hiring managers, business leaders, and interview panels.  

Provide regular hiring updates, recruitment metrics, and pipeline status.  

Drive hiring discussions and influence decision\-making with data\-driven insights.  

Ensure smooth coordination between business, HR operations, and candidates.  

Offer Management \& Negotiation  

Handle salary discussions and negotiate compensation within approved budgets.  

Manage offer rollout, approvals, and joining formalities.  

Engage with candidates during notice period to ensure successful onboarding.  

Handle offer decline scenarios and improve candidate conversion ratio.  

Recruitment Operations \& Reporting  

Maintain accurate recruitment data in ATS and internal tracking systems.  

Prepare recruitment dashboards and status reports.  

Ensure compliance with recruitment processes and policies.  

Support process improvement initiatives to enhance hiring efficiency.

**Required qualifications to be successful in this role**


Required Skills  

Strong experience in Full Life Cycle Recruitment  

Expertise in sourcing and screening methodologies  

Hands\-on experience in interview coordination and scheduling  

Strong stakeholder management and communication skills  

Experience in offer negotiation and candidate engagement  

Ability to manage multiple requirements under tight timelines  

Strong understanding of recruitment metrics and reporting  

Experience working with ATS and recruitment tools  

Excellent interpersonal and relationship management skills

**Together, as owners, let’s turn meaningful insights into action.**  

  

Life at CGI is rooted in ownership, teamwork, respect and belonging. Here, you’ll reach your full potential because…  

  

You are invited to be an owner from day 1 as we work together to bring our Dream to life. That’s why we call ourselves CGI Partners rather than employees. We benefit from our collective success and actively shape our company’s strategy and direction.  

  

Your work creates value. You’ll develop innovative solutions and build relationships with teammates and clients while accessing global capabilities to scale your ideas, embrace new opportunities, and benefit from expansive industry and technology expertise.  

  

You’ll shape your career by joining a company built to grow and last. You’ll be supported by leaders who care about your health and well\-being and provide you with opportunities to deepen your skills and broaden your horizons.
  

  

Come join our team—one of the largest IT and business consulting services firms in the world.

title: Workforce Optimization, Associate 2
description:
**Purpose of the Role**


Support the end\-to\-end execution of global Workforce Optimization (WO) / Reduction in Force (RIF) processes. Ensure timely, accurate, and compliant delivery of workforce reduction activities while supporting impacted employees and minimizing operational and regulatory risks.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Workforce Optimization Process Execution**  

Support the preparation, validation, and execution of workforce impact files and notification cycles. Ensure timelines, data accuracy, and process adherence throughout the lifecycle.
* **Process Governance \& Compliance**  

Follow established Employee Relations and RIF governance frameworks, ensuring compliance with country\-specific labor laws and internal policies. Flag risks and escalate issues proactively.
* **Data \& Case Management**  

Review employee data related to workforce reductions (terminations, exits, transitions) and coordinate updates across HR systems (e.g., Workday, ticketing tools). Maintain accuracy and confidentiality of sensitive information.
* **Stakeholder Coordination**  

Work closely with HR Business Partners, Employee Relations, Payroll, Benefits, Finance, and Legal teams to support smooth execution of workforce reduction activities.
* **Employee Support Coordination**  

Assist in addressing employee queries and ensure appropriate routing of causes related to separations, grievances, or benefits during RIF cycles.
* **Operational Excellence**  

Adhere to defined SLAs and support tracking of key metrics (accuracy, timeliness, exceptions). Contribute to process improvements and stabilization of files early in the cycle.
* **Technology \& Tools Usage**  

Use HR systems, trackers, and digital tools effectively to manage workflow. Support adoption of automation and standardized templates.

**Qualifications \& Experience**

* 2–5 years of experience in HR operations, Employee Relations, or workforce lifecycle processes
* Exposure to RIF / restructuring / workforce optimization processes is preferred
* Basic understanding of labor law and compliance requirements
* Experience in global or multi\-country environments is an advantage
* Familiarity with Workday, ticketing tools, and MS Excel

**Key Skills**

* Strong attention to detail and data accuracy
* Ability to manage timelines in a high\-pressure, deadline\-driven environment
* Good stakeholder coordination and communication skills
* Problem\-solving mindset with ability to escalate risks appropriately
* High level of confidentiality and professionalism

title: Senior Talent Acquisition Partner
description:
**Who is USP?**



The U.S. Pharmacopeial Convention (USP) is an independent scientific organization that collaborates with the world’s leading health and science experts to develop rigorous quality standards for medicines, dietary supplements, and food ingredients. At USP, we believe that scientific excellence is driven by a commitment to fairness, integrity, and global collaboration. This belief is embedded in our core value of Passion for Quality and is demonstrated through the contributions of more than 1,300 professionals across twenty global locations, working to strengthen the supply of safe, high\-quality medicines worldwide.

  



At USP, we value inclusive scientific collaboration and recognize that attracting diverse expertise strengthens our ability to develop trusted public health standards. We foster an organizational culture that supports equitable access to mentorship, professional development, and leadership opportunities. Our partnerships, standards, and research reflect our belief that ensuring broad participation in scientific leadership results in stronger, more impactful outcomes for global health.

  



USP is proud to be an equal employment opportunity employer (EEOE) and is committed to ensuring fair, merit\-based selection processes that enable the best scientific minds—regardless of background—to contribute to advancing public health solutions worldwide. We provide reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities and uphold policies that create an inclusive and collaborative work environment.

  


**Brief Job Overview**

Senior Talent Acquisition Partner is a key mission enabler at USP and we’re seeking an exceptional recruiter to join our team. Our new team member will lead their hiring managers through the full lifecycle of recruiting for a variety of professional, technical, scientific, and administrative positions. Primary responsibilities involve deep partnership and with business leaders and hiring managers to effectively source, recruit, evaluate, interview, and select top Acquisition/HR projects that will strengthen USP offerings and branding as an employer of choice.

  


**How will YOU create impact here at USP?**



As part of our mission to advance scientific rigor and public health standards, you will play a vital role in increasing global access to high\-quality medicines through public standards and related programs. USP prioritizes scientific integrity, regulatory excellence, and evidence\-based decision\-making to ensure health systems worldwide can rely on strong, tested, and globally relevant quality standards.

  



Additionally, USP’s People and Culture division, in partnership with the Equity Office, invests in leadership and workforce development to equip all employees with the skills to create high\-performing, inclusive teams. This includes training in equitable management practices and tools to promote engaged, collaborative, and results\-driven work environments.

  



The Sr. TA Partner has the following responsibilities:


* Conducts full lifecycle recruiting for assigned searches beginning with a strategy meeting with the hiring manager to discuss process and strategic sourcing approach
* Creates an effective sourcing strategy based on business needs and identify candidates through standard and creative methods
* Evaluates the resumes/profiles of prospective candidates and determines degree of skill match; recommends or declines appropriately and forwards qualified short\-listed candidate resumes to the hiring manager for review.
* Tracks candidate activity from initial resume submittal to hire in the applicant tracking system (ATS);
* Coordinates receiving and evaluating of interview feedback and advises hiring manager in the final selection process.
* Collaborates with the HRBP, Compensation \& Benefits and others as needed in establishing salaries.
* Checks references, verifies educational credentials, and coordinates background investigation of selected candidate; negotiates and makes verbal and written offers of employment.
* Works with colleagues to prepare weekly reports to monitor recruitment activity, tracks vacant positions, recruiting strategies/sources, and costs.
* Support in designing and executing employer branding initiatives to position the organization as an employer of choice, leveraging digital platforms and recruitment marketing tools.
* Analyze market trends and competitor practices to continuously refine talent attraction and branding strategies.


Additional roles and responsibilities include:


* Work on visually appealing and informative quarterly Dashboards and to be presented to the Leadership.
* Share Weekly Recruitment reports with the Leadership
* Work on Contract agreements and payments with various vendors as and when required
* Align and ensure the Headcount report is in alignment with Global HR and Finance teams.
* Ensure that all Job Portals and third\-party verification contracts are up to date and be the single point of contact for recruitment needs
* Ensure Talent acquisition is always Audit Compliant.
* Support on designing Recruitment policies and Manuals when required. Identifies processes and practices for continuous improvement and champions appropriate changes as needed.

  


**Who is USP Looking For?**



The successful candidate will have a demonstrated understanding of our mission, commitment to excellence through inclusive and equitable behaviors and practices, ability to quickly build credibility with stakeholders, along with the following competencies and experience:


* Master's Degree/Post Graduate Diploma (Full\-Time) in Human Resource Management from a business school is preferred, with 10 years of professional recruiting experience to include leadership and strategic project experience.
* Demonstrated full\-lifecycle recruitment experience working in corporate or agency environments.
* Experience in cold calling, candidate development and directly sourcing candidates from a variety of media including standard sourcing tools (social networks, corporate websites, general job boards, professional associations, agencies, college postings and alumni organizations, open houses) to build candidate pipelines
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office is required, as is familiarity with applicant tracking systems (ATS)


**Additional Desired Preferences**


* Recruitment experience within Pharmaceuticals and/or health care life sciences, biotechnology industry.
* Experience in behavioral and/or competency\-based interviewing techniques
* Advanced ability to understand complex requirements and effectively communicate with hiring managers and candidates
* Strong partnership and relationship building skills with the ability to adjust to multiple changing, and often competing, priorities
* Ability to help build a pipeline of diverse candidate to help company achieve DEIB goals
* Excellent time management, communication, and project management skills
* Superior verbal and written communication skills
* Must be able to work independently as well as in a team environment
* Strong technology orientation and skills related to social networking, sourcing techniques.
* Experience working with HRIS systems, UltiPro/UKG is a plus

  


**Supervisory Responsibilities**

  



Nil

  


**Benefits**

  



USP provides the benefits to protect yourself and your family today and tomorrow. From company\-paid time off and comprehensive healthcare options to retirement savings, you can have peace of mind that your personal and financial well\-being is protected.

  



Note: USP does not accept unsolicited resumes from 3rd party recruitment agencies and is not responsible for fees from recruiters or other agencies except under specific written agreement with USP.

At USP, we value inclusive scientific collaboration and recognize that attracting diverse expertise strengthens our ability to develop trusted public health standards. Our partnerships, standards, and research reflect our belief that ensuring broad participation in scientific leadership results in stronger, more impactful outcomes for global health.

  



USP is proud to be an equal employment opportunity employer (EEOE) and is committed to ensuring fair, merit\-based selection processes that enable the best scientific minds—regardless of background—to contribute to advancing public health solutions worldwide. We provide reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities and uphold policies that create an inclusive and collaborative work environment.

  


**Brief Job Overview**

  




The Employee Relations Manager is responsible for fostering a positive work environment by managing employee relations programs, resolving workplace issues, and ensuring compliance with labor laws and company policies. This role serves as a trusted advisor to management and employees, promoting fairness, consistency, and engagement across the organization strengthening the compliance culture.

Additionally, USP’s People and Culture division, in partnership with the Equity Office, invests in leadership and workforce development to equip all employees with the skills to create high\-performing, inclusive teams. This includes training in equitable management practices and tools to promote engaged, collaborative, and results\-driven work environments.

  



The Employee Relations Manager has the following responsibilities:

  


* Investigate and lead the people\-related issues such as: behavior/conduct concerns, corrective actions for policy violations, employee grievances, and workplace conflicts in a timely and confidential manner.
* Liaise with labor offices and regulatory authorities to ensure compliance with statutory requirements and manage audits or inspections.

* Anchor / support the compliance awareness sessions \& training on policies, risk management practices, and other emerging or specific issues to promote consistent understanding across teams.

  


**Who is USP Looking For?**



The successful candidate will have a demonstrated understanding of our mission, commitment to excellence through inclusive and equitable behaviors and practices, ability to quickly build credibility with stakeholders, along with the following competencies and experience:


* Masters Degree/Post Graduate Diploma/Masters in Social Work (Full\-Time) in Human Resource Management.

* Excellent interpersonal and communication skills**.**

Nil
