title: Software Engineer -Backend
description:
* Are you curious, excited by experimentation and always looking to innovate?
* Do you want to work in embedded payments where you can keep learning and developing whilst getting hands\-on experience?
* Do you want to have the opportunity to play an important role in a rapidly growing and exciting Fintech business?


 If so, we would love to connect and collaborate!
   

  

 We want to hire ambitious, and value\-adding talent into Modulr, one of the fastest growing payments businesses in the UK and Europe. Modulr is experiencing significant growth, and in this role you will work in a cross\-functional team who are asked to solve a problem, rather than be handed a task to do. This is an excellent opportunity to work in a high\-growth environment with a fast\-paced and collaborative culture where you will have great opportunities to work on challenging problems.
   

  

**About Us**
 At Modulr, our vision is a world where all businesses are powered by embedded payments. Modulr enables businesses, from SMEs to Enterprise, initially across the UK and Europe to efficiently pay\-in, collect and disburse funds instantly via a range of payment schemes, accounts, and card products.
   

  

 We have created an industry\-leading API platform with comprehensive online tools and access, to meet the demands of daily business payments. We have two routes to market. Our Core Business Payments product allows customers in any sector to connect to us and our expanding network of accounting and payroll platforms, including Sage, Xero, BrightPay and IRIS to automate payments. Our Vertical Solutions targets a growing range of industry verticals which directly connect their IT platforms to our APIs and webhooks. We solve complex payment problems for hundreds of clients in a range of industries, including Travel, Lending, Wage Advance, and Investment \& Wealth.
   

  

 We are deeply integrated into the payment eco\-system. In the UK, we are direct participants of Faster Payments and Bacs. Modulr hold settlement accounts at the Bank of England. Our payment network connectivity includes CHAPS, Open Banking, SEPA, SWIFT and account issuance in multiple currencies. We are principal issuing members of Visa and Mastercard schemes across UK and Europe.
   

  

 Our regulatory permissions and governance structure are the foundations of our business. We are regulated and supervised as an Authorised Electronic Money Institution (AEMI) in the UK by the Financial Conduct Authority and in the Netherlands by De Nederlandsche Bank.
   

  

 Our founding team has a wealth of experience in the payments industry and growing successful businesses. Modulr is backed by the venture arms of payments giants PayPal and FIS, as well as growth investors Blenheim Chalcot, General Atlantic, Frog Capital and Highland Europe.
   

  

 Modulr now has over 400 employees spread globally across offices in London, Edinburgh, Amsterdam, Mumbai and Pune.
   

  

**Modulr values**
* Building the extraordinary; going that extra mile.
* Owning the opportunity; be passionate and proud of the time you invest.
* Move at pace; reach goals faster whilst supported on your career journey.
* Achieve it together, working collaboratively and being a Modulite.


**The Team**
 At Modulr we are focused on building autonomous squads that are focused on working in
   

  

 the best possible way. We operate in a tribes and squad model with each area focused on
   

  

 a particular growth area. Each squad is small and cross\-functional. We have big ambitions and have many interesting challenges ahead.
   

  

**Summary**
 In this role you will design, build, and evolve the next generation of Modulr’s event\-driven payments platform. You’ll work across the full engineering lifecycle—from shaping technical approaches to delivering production\-grade software—within a squad that values ownership, excellence, and continuous improvement.
   

  

 Specific duties
   

  

**Engineering \& Architecture**
* Design and develop backend services using Java (17\+) or similar OO languages.
* Build and evolve microservices and distributed, event\-driven components in a cloud\-native environment.
* Contribute to architectural patterns that support throughput, resilience, reliability, and observability.
* Design clean, well\-documented RESTful APIs and service contracts.
* Work with relational data stores, especially PostgreSQL, and contribute to data modelling.


 Distributed Systems \& Reliability
   

  

* Engineer solutions for concurrency, idempotency, fault tolerance, retries, and high availability.
* Improve system performance, reduce latency, and identify bottlenecks across services.
* Build systems with strong observability—logs, metrics, tracing—ensuring issues can be diagnosed quickly.


**Quality \& Testing**
* Develop comprehensive automated tests using frameworks such as JUnit, Mockito, Cucumber.
* Participate in design and code reviews, helping raise engineering standards across the team.
* Advocate for code quality, maintainability, and long\-term technical health.


 DevOps, Cloud \& Tooling
   

  

* Use and improve deployment pipelines and operational tooling (Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, AWS services).
* Contribute to internal frameworks, shared libraries, and engineering best practices.
* Help shape the evolution of our platform toward a more flexible, modern architecture.


 Collaboration \& Delivery
   

  

* Work in an agile environment, contributing to planning, design discussions, and iterative delivery.
* Collaborate across squads to shape technical solutions that span multiple systems.
* Document best practices, reference architectures, and design approaches others can rely on.


**About You**
 You’re an engineer who thrives in a fast\-paced, high\-growth environment and enjoys solving complex, system\-level problems. You bring:
   

  

* Expertise in Java or another OO language with willingness to work in Java.
* Strong understanding of OOP, design patterns, and distributed systems fundamentals.
* Experience building and operating microservices in production.
* Ability to reason about concurrency, performance, and system behaviour under load.
* Clear, proactive communication and a collaborative, team\-first mindset.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills supported by sound engineering judgement.
* Ability to manage complexity, balance competing priorities, and deliver high\-quality work.
* A growth mindset—you enjoy learning, improving, and helping others grow.
* A self\-starter attitude with a passion for ownership and continuous improvement.


**ModInclusion**
 At Modulr, we are working hard to build a more positive diverse and inclusive culture that helps everyone to feel they belong and can truly bring their whole self to work. Not only is it the right thing to do for everyone in the Modulr team, it’s also the right thing to do for our business, the community we operate in and attracting future talent. As part of our approach, we actively welcome applications from candidates with diverse backgrounds.

title: Software Engineer, Payments
description:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.
   

  

**The Community You Will Join**
* The Regional Payments team is the engine driving Airbnb’s global growth through deep local understanding. We believe that to truly belong anywhere, guests need a frictionless checkout experience with the payment options they know and trust.


 Our mission is to unlock regional growth by tailoring the payment journey to local needs. From offering the right mix of local payment methods to powering affordability initiatives like installment plans and partner campaigns, we build the platform capabilities that make booking an Airbnb accessible and seamless for everyone. By optimizing the guest checkout experience and understanding regional nuances, we directly drive the company's topline growth and market penetration.
   

  

**The Difference You Will Make** 
**Deep Cross\-Functional Collaboration:** 
 Partner closely with Product, Finance, Data, and other XFN stakeholders to define market\-level technical strategies and deliver high\-impact features.
   

  

* 
+ Drive Topline Growth: Take end\-to\-end ownership of engineering projects that directly impact the company’s Gross Booking Value (GBV) and growth by optimizing regional checkout conversion funnels.
+ Elevate the Guest Checkout Experience: Architect and build solutions that offer the right payment options at the right time, minimizing friction and maximizing payment approval rates for guests around the world.
+ Unlock Affordability \& Partnerships: Design robust backend capabilities to support region\-specific partner campaigns, installment plans, and targeted discounts, making travel more affordable while accelerating business growth.
+ Architect \& Execute: Drive the technical design, architecture, and implementation of region\-first builds, balancing custom local needs with the sustainability of our global payments platform.


**A Typical Day**
* Take end\-to\-end ownership of backend services and APIs (primarily in Java), from architectural design and coding to deployment and maintenance.
* Build and integrate local payment methods, affordability features (like installments), and promotional campaign logic, tailoring our systems to diverse consumer expectations.
* Analyze input and health metrics (e.g., checkout conversion funnels, payment success rates) to turn data insights into actionable engineering improvements that drive GBV.
* Collaborate with Finance and Product to align technical execution with Airbnb’s broader business strategy, ensuring we deliver strong business efficiency and ROI on partner campaigns.
* Actively monitor product/service health, participate in on\-call rotations, and proactively identify areas to reduce tech debt and improve system reliability over time.
* Foster a collaborative and inclusive engineering culture, sharing knowledge, participating in code reviews, and occasionally mentoring peers


**Your Expertise** 
  

  

* 
+ 3 to 6 years of industry software engineering experience in big tech companies, with a proven track record of end\-to\-end ownership of projects and system architecture.
+ Proficiency in backend development, primarily in Java (our core stack), with the ability to navigate full\-stack environments or learn new languages as needed.
+ B.Tech/BE in Computer Science, MIS, or equivalent technical qualification.
+ Payments Knowledge is a Plus: Experience with payment networks, checkout funnels, promotional campaigns, or affordability products (e.g., Buy Now Pay Later, installments) is highly desired, but a strong willingness to learn is just as valuable.
+ Experience building and scaling reliable web applications, specifically focusing on optimizing user funnels, conversion rates, and driving growth metrics.
+ Strong ability to navigate ambiguity by proactively seeking guidance, distilling complex requirements, and designing scalable solutions.
+ Excellent communication skills—capable of writing detailed technical design documents and collaborating effectively with both technical and non\-technical XFN partners (e.g., Finance, Product, Marketing).


**Our Commitment To Inclusion \& Belonging**
 Airbnb is committed to working with the broadest talent pool possible. We believe diverse ideas foster innovation and engagement, and allow us to attract creatively\-led people, and to develop the best products, services and solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.
   

  

 We strive to also provide a disability inclusive application and interview process. If you are a candidate with a disability and require reasonable accommodation in order to submit an application, please contact us at: reasonableaccommodations@airbnb.com. Please include your full name, the role you’re applying for and the accommodation necessary to assist you with the recruiting process.
   

  

 We ask that you only reach out to us if you are a candidate whose disability prevents you from being able to complete our online application.

title: Software engineer
description:
**WHY WE WILL LOVE YOU** 




  





 We set the digital agenda to keep IKEA leading in an exciting and fast\-moving environment. We drive the development, provision and operation of our digital products and services through the use of new and existing technology and agile delivery methods to deliver at pace. We are building, integrating and using software to solve complex problems. At the same time, we provide a home for digital skills to both develop and extend the technical, people and business skills needed to ensure continuous development and growth of our digital capability. To fulfill our IKEA vision, “a better everyday life for the many people, ” we need to ensure that the software solutions we create, and use are sound and sustainable for both our customers and co\-workers at large. The People Domain We enable Ingka and our people to grow sustainably, through modern \& efficient human resource technology, leading the group’s digital agenda in sub\-domains involving Talent, Total Rewards, People Management and People Planning.
 



  









  





 You’re a frontend engineer who knows how to ship clean, fast, and reliable user experiences. You build components that scale, automate your testing, and care deeply about accessibility, performance, and maintainability. You’re collaborative, direct, and unafraid to ask questions or challenge assumptions. You help others level up, and you’re driven by delivering value, not chasing perfection for its own sake.
   

 You’ll work deeply within one core portal, so you need to understand its users, its flows, and its constraints. You make clear decisions, align with the right stakeholders, and communicate your reasoning so the portal keeps moving forward with purpose.
   

 Preferred technical skills
   

 5\+ years of professional experience building modern web applications
   

 Deep expertise in React, component architecture, state management (Redux, Zustand, Recoil, or similar), and hooks
   

 Strong command of TypeScript and clean, maintainable frontend code
   

 Solid experience with design systems, reusable components, and accessibility standards (WCAG)
   

 Modern styling approaches (CSS Modules, Tailwind, Styled Components, etc.)
   

 Proven ability to build high\-performance UIs
   

 Experience consuming and designing REST and GraphQL APIs
   

 Automated testing: Jest, React Testing Library, Playwright/Cypress
   

 CI/CD pipelines and modern deployment workflows
   

 Knowledge of edge runtimes, CDN optimisations, caching strategies
   

 Comfortable with observability: logging, monitoring, debugging client issues
   

 Understanding of security best practices for frontend apps (XSS, CSP, OAuth flows, etc.)
   

  

 A day in your life with us
   

  

 We’re a unique company that gives you space to fit in and enables you to make use of your skills. Our systems are being used by over 170,000 co\-workers and serve over 4 billion customers globally!
   

 We’re in the midst of the transformation from legacy monoliths to an event\-driven cloud architecture. You wouldn’t have dealt with as many orders as go through our system (and if you have – talk to me!), so scalability becomes second nature, for both performance and cost.There are heaps of challenges in front of us, but we’re prepared and look forward to becoming truly agile with modern architecture – and maybe with your help. We’re not chasing shareholder value; we want to help the many people to have a better everyday life. Order Management – you might know it, or you might have no clue! Either is fine, as we’ll help you to get an understanding and find your ways around creating, executing, releasing, and deviating orders. This won’t get boring thanks to the many different flows and integrations in our omni\-channel setup! We aim to have driven, empowered agile teams who understand priorities and how to come to agreements with other teams and domains. We’re all in this together and we try to help others and share our knowledge often. We want to become the best in class – yes, that’s a lofty goal, but why aim for less? If you feel the same then you’ll fit right in, come and help us push boundaries! We have values and we live them – they’re all important and I’m happy to share them with you in more detail, but these stand out for me:
   

 Togetherness, Simplicity, leading by example, and different with a meaning – get in touch and I can explain in detail!
 



  





**OUR TEAM WITHIN IKEA** 




  





 We’re the ones who make it possible for people to have a smarter life at home and a hassle\-free and rewarding shopping experience. Together we work to find new digital solutions for every business need to help make IKEA a great and efficient place to work. We like to think of ourselves as innovative and modern, and we believe that nothing would actually work without us.

title: Python & Machine Learning Developer - Director - Software Engineer
description:
Python \& ML Developer \- Director \- Software Engineering
   

  

 Profile Description
   

  

 We are looking for a skilled Python \& Machine Learning Developer to build scalable data\-driven solutions and enhance existing applications within our technology ecosystem.
   

  

 FRRPE\_Tech
   

  

 In the Technology division, we leverage innovation to build the connections and capabilities that power our Firm, enabling our clients and colleagues to redefine markets and shape the future of our communities.
   

  

 Operations Technology
   

  

 Operations Technology develops and maintains systems in support of Morgan Stanley's global Operations , including (but not limited to) Settlements, Confirmations, Regulatory Reporting, Position Keeping, Corporate Actions processing and other post\-trade functions. Operations Technology is a global organization that is client\-focused and functionally aligned. Our organization is built to support our clients functional, regional and business\-facing requirements while delivering innovative technology and ensuring plant and processing stability. The Firm operates at scale with up to 40 million trades processed on peak volume days and hundreds of billions of dollars of daily settlements with activity ongoing in multiple countries and currencies across the globe. There is a great breadth of financial products that our Operations plant handles across equity and fixed income, from cash products to complex derivatives and loans.
   

  

 Software Engineering
   

  

 This is a Director position that develops and maintains software solutions that support business needs.
   

  

 Morgan Stanley is an industry leader in financial services, known for mobilizing capital to help governments, corporations, institutions, and individuals around the world achieve their financial goals.
   

  

 At Morgan Stanley India, we support the Firm’s global businesses, with critical presence across Institutional Securities, Wealth Management, and Investment management, as well as in the Firm’s infrastructure functions of Technology, Operations, Finance, Risk Management, Legal and Corporate \& Enterprise Services. Morgan Stanley has been rooted in India since 1993, with campuses in both Mumbai and Bengaluru. We empower our multi\-faceted and talented teams to advance their careers and make a global impact on the business. For those who show passion and grit in their work, there’s ample opportunity to move across the businesses for those who show passion and grit in their work.
   

  

**What You’ll Do In The Role**
 We are looking for a skilled Python \& Machine Learning Developer to build scalable data\-driven solutions and enhance existing applications within our technology ecosystem. The ideal candidate brings strong hands on experience in Python, core ML algorithms, data processing libraries, and CI CD workflows. You will own development tasks end to end from requirement analysis to production deployment\-while collaborating closely with cross\-functional teams.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Analyze, troubleshoot, and resolve issues in existing Python code and ML workflows.
   

  

 Develop clean, efficient, and maintainable Python code for new and existing applications.
   

  

 Own assigned tasks end to end: requirement gathering, design, implementation, testing, and production rollout.
   

  

 Build, tune, and evaluate ML models (supervised, unsupervised, classification, clustering).
   

  

 Collaborate across teams and contribute throughout the SDLC documentation, deployment, and ongoing support.
   

  

 Work with Autosys, Git GitHub, CI CD pipelines, Unix systems, and SQL databases as part of daily development.
   

  

**What You’ll Bring To The Role**
 Mandatory Skills
   

  

* Strong Python development experience (debugging and writing optimized code)
* Supervised \& Unsupervised ML, Classification models, K Means clustering
* Model evaluation \& performance tuning
* NumPy, Pandas, SciPy, scikit learn, Matplotlib
* Autosys, Git, GitHub, CI CD (Jenkins)
* Unix/Linux commands, SQL


 Good to Have
   

  

* Snowflake
* Java Perl
* Angular
* Azure Cloud
* GenAI tools (e.g., Copilot)


**What You Can Expect From Morgan Stanley**
 At Morgan Stanley, we raise, manage and allocate capital for our clients – helping them reach their goals. We do it in a way that’s differentiated – and we’ve done that for 90 years. Our values \- putting clients first, doing the right thing, leading with exceptional ideas, committing to diversity and inclusion, and giving back \- aren’t just beliefs, they guide the decisions we make every day to do what's best for our clients, communities and more than 80,000 employees in 1,200 offices across 42 countries. At Morgan Stanley, you’ll find an opportunity to work alongside the best and the brightest, in an environment where you are supported and empowered. Our teams are relentless collaborators and creative thinkers, fueled by their diverse backgrounds and experiences. We are proud to support our employees and their families at every point along their work\-life journey, offering some of the most attractive and comprehensive employee benefits and perks in the industry. There’s also ample opportunity to move about the business for those who show passion and grit in their work.
   

  

 To learn more about our offices across the globe, please copy and paste https://www.morganstanley.com/about\-us/global\-offices into your browser.
   

  

 Morgan Stanley is an equal opportunities employer. We work to provide a supportive and inclusive environment where all individuals can maximize their full potential. Our skilled and creative workforce is comprised of individuals drawn from a broad cross section of the global communities in which we operate and who reflect a variety of backgrounds, talents, perspectives, and experiences. Our strong commitment to a culture of inclusion is evident through our constant focus on recruiting, developing, and advancing individuals based on their skills and talents.

title: Software Development Engineer 1
description:
**Company Overview**
 WEX is an innovative global commerce platform and payments technology company looking to forge the way in a rapidly changing environment, to simplify the business of doing business for customers, freeing them to spend more time, with less worry, on the things they love and care about. We are journeying to build a consistent world\-class user experience across our products and services and leverage customer\-focused innovations across all our strategic initiatives, including big data, AI, and Risk.
   

  

****Team Overview****
 Risk Platform’s agile engineering teams build the services, system integrations and analytic tools that enable WEX products and business lines to make smart risk decisions at scale as they grow. Major platform systems include credit decisioning, credit portfolio management, fraud detection, risk data analytics, compliance, and collections. Risk Platform engineers address the needs of our business partners by designing, building and deploying scalable, observable solutions utilizing modern, cloud\-based service architectures and leveraging WEX’s world\-class AI and big data platforms.
   

  

****Position Summary****
 We are looking for a highly motivated and highly potential entry level Engineer to join our Risk Engineering team to make big business impacts and grow your area.
   

  

 This is a really exciting time to be in the Risk Engineering team at WEX. Wex has sophisticated business and products empowering a wide variety of customer businesses. Data generated from these production systems, applications, and platforms are rich and complex. As one of the most valuable assets of Wex, the data provides huge potential values for our customers and business. It’s the Risk team’s responsibility to build Risk, platforms, systems, and tools to clean, process, enrich, and optimize the core company data, and make them easy and efficient to use to enable Wex customers and internal teams to generate customer and business values. We build value added data products for Wex customers too. We leverage advanced technologies from the industry to ensure our efficiency and effectiveness, including modern big data technologies and AI technologies.
   

  

 We have challenging problems with huge business impact potentials for you to work on and grow. We also have a strong team with highly talented and skillful engineers and leaders to support, guide, coach you.
   

  

 If you dream to be a strong engineer who can solve tough problems, generate big impacts, and grow fast, this is a great opportunity for you!
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Collaborate with stakeholders to learn about our customers biggest challenges.
* Learn and practice design, test, code, and instrument new data products/systems/platforms at small to medium complexity level.
* Learn ways to effectively measure, inspect, and drive decisions using data.
* Learn and develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines using tools such as GitHub Actions.
* Learn and implement Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using tools like Terraform, including provisioning and managing cloud\-based data infrastructure.
* Practice software development with TDD and BDD, Microservice and Vertical Slice Architectures.
* Learn to support live data products/systems/platforms, promote proactive monitoring, rapid incident response, and continuous improvement.
* Learn to analyze existing systems and processes to identify bottlenecks and opportunities for improvements.
* Learn from your peers, foster continuous learning within your team and organization.
* Learn our team’s process and best practices, and apply them to given tasks with help from peers and your manager. Make sure to understand customer/business problems you try to solve with these tasks, and your design and implementation can actually solve these problems in an effective, reliable, and sustainable way.
* Partner with and assist your peers on completing tasks.
* Focus on continuous learning of new technologies.
* Proactively seek reviews from senior engineers on your work to ensure quality.
* Learn and build reliable, secure, efficient, and easy to use big data platforms and tools at scale for supporting all kinds of data transferring, ingestion, processing, serving, delivery, consumption, and data governance needs.
* Learn and build systems, platforms, data pipelines, and tools for E\-2\-E data life cycle, including data ingestion, cleaning, processing, enrichment, optimization, and serving by leveraging the Data platform. It’s our responsibility to deliver high quality, rich, easy to understand \& use data for external and internal purposes. For these, you will learn and build data quality measurement \& monitoring techniques and systems, metadata and data catalog, Master Data Management, etc.
* Learn and master common big data technologies, tools, and software packages, including proper integrations with Wex systems and proper execution in an engineering way.
* Learn data modeling techniques and use them to design/implement efficient and easy to use data models and structures.


**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field. OR demonstrable equivalent deep understanding, experience, and capability.
* 1\-2 years of experience in software engineering is a plus.
* Strong problem\-solving skills, excellent communication and collaboration skills.
* Capable of designing a good solution for a small/medium scale problem or component.
* Strong implementation skills using languages like Java, C\#, Golang, \& Python, including coding, automated testing, measurement and monitoring.
* Good understanding of data ingestion, cleaning, processing, enrichment, serving, quality assurance techniques and tools, such as data pipeline development, SQL \& relational algebra, DBs, ELT.
* Some knowledge of data warehousing concepts and dimensional modeling.
* Passionate about keeping up with modern technologies and design. Interested in data and data processing.
* Strong willingness and capability to learn new technology and tools quickly when needed. Passionate about keeping up with modern technologies and design. Interested in data, big data technology, cloud technology.
* Passionate about understanding and solving customer/business problems.

description:
**Our Mission**
**SPAN is enabling electrification for all ⚡**
 We are a mission\-driven company designing, building, and deploying products that electrify the built environment, reduce carbon emissions, and slow the effects of climate change.
   

  

* Decarbonization is the process to reduce or remove greenhouse gas emissions, especially carbon dioxide, from entering our atmosphere.
* Electrification is the process of replacing fossil fuel appliances that run on gas or oil with all\-electric upgrades for a cleaner way to power our lives.


**At SPAN, We Believe In**
* Enabling homes and vehicles powered by clean energy
* Making electrification upgrades possible
* Building more resilient homes with reliable backup
* Designing a flexible and distributed electrical grid


**The Role**
 We are seeking a Web engineer with experience building complex web applications in React to help build and evolve SPAN's web platform. You'll join our software engineering team in Bangalore, bringing your expertise in React as we design, implement, and scale the web experiences that power SPAN's products — from homeowner\-facing dashboards to enterprise platforms and internal tools.
   

  

 You'll work closely with engineers across mobile, cloud, device software, and QA, as well as product and design. Your work will directly shape how homeowners, installers, utilities, and internal teams interact with the SPAN ecosystem.
   

  

 What You'll Work On
   

  

* SPAN Home On\-Premise — A locally\-hosted dashboard that runs directly on the SPAN panel, giving homeowners real\-time visibility into their home energy usage, solar production, and battery storage.
* Enterprise \& Utility Platforms — Web applications that enable electric utility companies and other enterprise customers to manage fleets of SPAN devices, monitor grid programs, and derive insights at scale.
* Internal Tools — Purpose\-built applications that empower teams across support, manufacturing, operations, and business development to move faster and work more effectively.


**Responsibilities**
* Design and develop high\-performance web applications that drive new and improved features of the SPAN system.
* Deliver customer\-facing features for homeowners, installers, and electric utility companies.
* Build internal tools that enable support, manufacturing, and business teams to be successful.
* Collaborate with engineers across multiple domains — mobile, cloud, firmware, and QA — to complete full\-stack projects.
* Leverage the wealth of data the SPAN panel generates to create delightful, data\-rich user experiences.
* Integrate with external datasets and services while maintaining reliability and performance.
* Use test\-driven development and engineering best practices to ship with confidence.


**About Role**
 Required Qualifications
   

  

* 2–6 years of experience in web software development, with meaningful experience building production applications in React.
* Comfort working across the stack when needed, collaborating with backend and platform engineers to deliver end\-to\-end features.
* Experience with end\-to\-end and component testing frameworks such as Playwright and Cypress.
* Strong skills in representing data through charts, graphs, and interactive visualizations.
* Proficiency working in a shared codebase using source control (Git), linting, code review, and CI/CD practices.
* Strong JavaScript experience and a willingness to work with (or learn) TypeScript.
* Familiarity with client–service communication patterns such as REST, gRPC, and real\-time messaging (e.g., MQTT, Ably, WebSockets).
* Experience working closely with design teams to build shared component libraries and maintain a cohesive design system.


**Bonus Qualifications**
* Experience with Internet of Things (IoT) products or systems with a hardware component (e.g., AWS IoT, embedded device communication).
* Familiarity with complex graphing and visualization libraries such as D3 or Recharts.
* Experience with on\-premise or locally\-hosted web applications, including offline\-first patterns.
* Close collaboration with a mobile engineering team.
* Familiarity with energy, cleantech, or utility industry domains.
* Experience with Agile/Scrum methodologies.

 Our

This international collaboration fosters innovation, learning, and growth, while helping us achieve our bold mission of electrifying homes and advancing clean energy solutions worldwide.

title: Junior Backend Developer (TypeScript + AI)
description:
**About the role** 

 We're hiring a backend developer to own the engineering side of our B2B cold email and lead generation operation. You'll build scrapers, LLM workflows, and the systems that send personalized outreach at scale.
 



  




**Read this first** 

 Before you apply, please check if this role is actually for you. We've been getting too many wrong applications.
 



 This is
 **not** 
 a QA, SDET, or test automation role. If your work involves Selenium, Cypress, Playwright tests, TestNG, JUnit, Postman collections, or anything with "testing" in your job title, this role is not for you. The "automation" in this role means business workflow automation, like "when X happens, automatically do Y" across cold email and lead gen systems.
 



 This is
 **not** 
 a Zapier or Make.com role. You will write TypeScript every day.
 



 This is
 **not** 
 a Python or ML role. The entire codebase is TypeScript and Node.js. We use AI through API calls to OpenAI and Anthropic, we don't train models. If you're a Python developer or ML engineer, this isn't the right fit unless you have serious TypeScript experience.
 



 This is
 **not** 
 a senior role. Budget is ₹16 LPA max. If you earn more than that today, please don't apply.
 



 This is
 **not** 
 a generic backend role. We need someone who knows cold email and outbound. If you've never heard of Smartlead, Instantly, or Apollo, this isn't the role.
 



  




**What we do** 

 We run cold email campaigns for B2B clients. We find target companies, find decision makers in them, write personalized emails using AI, and send them through warmed up inboxes. All of this is code, not manual work.
 



**Stack: TypeScript, Node.js, n8n, Postgres, OpenAI, Anthropic, Apify, Playwright, plus the usual cold email tools (Smartlead, Instantly, Apollo, Clay).** 




**Note: while we use AI heavily, this is API integration work, not model training. If you're looking for an ML engineering role, this isn't a fit.** 




  




**What you'll do** 

 Build and maintain the systems that run our pipeline. Specifically:
 


* Scrapers that find target companies and pull contact details of decision makers
* LLM workflows that write personalized emails using real signals about the prospect
* A dashboard to monitor inbox placement, bounces, and domain health across clients
* Triggers that fire outreach when something interesting happens (new hire, funding, tech change)
* Eval suites that score LLM output quality so we can change prompts and models without breaking results



  




**Who you are** 

 You've worked in or around cold email before. Maybe at a lead gen agency, maybe a sales tech startup, maybe as a freelancer for outbound teams. The exact title doesn't matter. What matters is that you understand how cold email actually works and you can write code.
 



 You should know:
 


* TypeScript well enough to ship production code
* SQL and Postgres
* How to call OpenAI or Anthropic APIs and handle their quirks
* Basic scraping with Apify, Playwright, or Puppeteer
* n8n or a similar tool, used for real things, not just demos
* Cold email fundamentals: deliverability, warmup, SPF, DKIM, DMARC, bounce dynamics



 If you don't know all of these, that's fine, but you should know most of them.
   




**How hiring works** 
1. A 45 minute call with the founder
2. A paid 2 week trial in our actual repo
3. Offer based on the trial

title: HR Intern
description:
**Job Title:** 
 HR Intern / Executive Assistant to Founder's Office (Full\-time \| On\-site)
   

  

**Experience:** 
 0\-1 Years (Freshers with high energy are welcome)
   

  

**Company:** 
 Marketing Mojito
   

  

**About Marketing Mojito:** 
 Marketing Mojito is a full\-stack digital marketing agency built for business transformation. Here, you won't be "just an employee." You'll build brands from scratch, run end\-to\-end campaigns, and watch your ideas go live. With our learning\-first culture, you'll pick up the skills that matter, strategy, performance, content, design and analytics, while owning real outcomes. Come for the challenge; stay for the growth.
   

  

**The Vibe:** 
 Marketing Mojito is a high\-energy zone. We don't do "slow corporate HR" or boring back\-office admin. We are looking for a
 **People Person \& Operator** 
 who can spot talent from a mile away and keep the agency's heartbeat strong. You will be the bridge between the Founders and the team, ensuring that we hire the best, work efficiently, and actually enjoy the process.
   

  

**The Mission:** 
 You won't just "file papers" here. You will be the gatekeeper of our culture and the right hand to the leadership. Your mission is to build the team (Recruitment), keep the team happy (Culture), and help the Founders focus on growth by handling the operational chaos.
   

  

**What You'll Actually Do**
* The Talent Scout: You are the first filter. You will screen CVs, cold\-call candidates to assess their "vibe" and communication skills, and arrange interviews with the leadership.
* Pipeline Builder: You won't just wait for applications. You will actively tie up with institutes and colleges to build a steady pipeline of interns and freshers.
* Founder's Office Ops: You will handle miscellaneous, high\-priority tasks from the Founders' office. This requires research, coordination, and the ability to get things done without a manual.
* Chief Fun Officer: You own the vibe. You will organize office parties, birthdays, and team\-building events. If the office is quiet, it's your job to fix it.
* The Watchtower: You will keep an eye on team performance, daily attendance, and discipline to ensure the agency runs like a well\-oiled machine.


**You Bring**
* 0\-1 Year of Experience / High\-Potential Fresher: You might be new, but you are hungry to learn how a business is built.
* The Gift of Gab: You are not afraid to pick up the phone and talk to anyone—from a nervous intern candidate to a college placement officer.
* Organizational Ninja: You can manage the Founders' calendars, interview schedules, and office spreadsheets without losing track.
* High EQ: You understand people. You know how to be firm regarding attendance/performance but fun regarding culture/parties.


**Why Marketing Mojito?**
* Direct Mentorship: You work directly with the Founders/CEO. You will learn the secrets of running a business.
* Real Impact: You aren't a cog in the wheel. The people you hire will shape the future of the agency.
* Culture: We value output over hours. We work hard in Chembur, but we celebrate wins properly.

title: Senior Change Manager - ISC & MEA OU
description:
Welcome to Haleon. We’re a purpose\-driven, world\-class consumer company putting everyday health in the hands of millions. In just three years since our launch, we’ve grown, evolved and are now entering an exciting new chapter – one filled with bold ambitions and enormous opportunity.  

  

Our trusted portfolio of brands – including Sensodyne®, Panadol®, Advil®, Voltaren®, Theraflu®, Otrivin®, and Centrum® – lead in resilient and growing categories. What sets us apart is our unique blend of deep human understanding and trusted science.  

  

Now it’s time to fully realise the full potential of our business and our people. We do this through our Win as One strategy. It puts our purpose – to deliver better everyday health with humanity – at the heart of everything we do. It unites us, inspires us, and challenges us to be better every day, driven by our agile, performance\-focused culture.

**About the role**


The Senior Change Manager is crucial in shaping how people experience and contribute to change across Haleon. The role enables, coordinates and executes our strategic programmes, owning the local change strategy and roadmap within an assigned Operating Unit or Function to ensure a coherent change experience.


The role will focus on the people side of change \- identifying, preparing, and equipping our colleagues to adopt changes in ways of working, roles, operating models, business processes, systems, technology, culture and more. It will report into the Change Management CoE Director (Centre of Excellence) and support a collaborative effort to drive change excellence at scale. This role involves significant stakeholder engagement and strategic change partnering to coordinate activities and act as a bridge between programmes and local teams on change. It will require close collaboration across a variety of stakeholders to scope, understand, localize and implement changes and cultivate a local change network.


This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced individual to join a leading global organization with an exciting transformation agenda. We are seeking individuals with demonstrable experience and passion for designing and executing strategic change locally, as well as contributing to developing Haleon’s broader transformation capability.

**Key responsibilities**

**Change Strategy \& Planning**

* Drive the execution of strategic transformation initiatives landing in assigned Operating Unit or Function by developing a change strategy and actionable roadmap.
* Understand changes impacting the assigned Operating Unit or Function by conducting change diagnostics (e.g., impact assessments) and identifying targeted change interventions.
* Ensure alignment to Haleon’s culture strategy throughout change planning and execution, embedding behavioural shifts for true adoption.

**Change Execution \& Adoption**

* Proactively support the delivery and adoption of change, including facilitating workshops, defining success metrics, assessing change effectiveness, measuring adoption and coordinating local knowledge management plans.
* Partner with Programmes to develop local business readiness criteria ahead of going\-live with change initiatives.
* Hold programme and business leads to account for leader\-led change execution.

**Stakeholder Engagement \& Communication**

* Anticipate stakeholder needs and potential areas of resistance to drive change outcomes, proactively identifying targeted mitigations.
* Coordinate change activities across relevant stakeholders and teams (HR, Communications, Programmes, Capability Leads, L\&D, etc.), acting as a bridge between Programmes and local teams
* Develop and oversee the implementation of local communications and engagement plans, including mapping key stakeholders, agreeing the engagement approach with business leaders and HR, and tailoring programme change narratives for local needs.

**Change Capability Building**

* Build a holistic change capability strategy and plan for assigned Operating Unit or Function, ensuring alignment to the enterprise skills framework.
* Develop and execute the change learning plan and curriculum with subject matter experts, partnering with Programme leads, Capability Leads, and HR to identify training needs and ensure appropriate training plans are in place, including measuring effectiveness.
* Coach and upskill business leaders on change management, holding them to account for role modelling change and culture and driving uptake in their Operating Unit or Function.
* Contribute to continuous improvement and knowledge sharing through the change management community of practice.

**Change Measurement, Risk \& Benefits Management**

* Review and report on change outcomes and benefits, grounded in metrics, with clear return on investment and linked to business outcomes.
* Identify, document and support the mitigation of key change management risks within the assigned Operating Unit or Function, working effectively across workstreams to implement interventions and resolve issues.

 **Qualifications and Skills:**

* Proven track record of executing change programmes within complex, matrixed environments, demonstrating ability to operate effectively across diverse, global teams.
* Proficiency with portfolio\-level change management including prioritization, sequencing and operating across interdependent transformations.
* Ability to translate an enterprise\-level change strategy and roadmap into an executable and measurable change and adoption plan for local deployment.
* Strong understanding of change management best practice, including tools, techniques and their practical implementation.
* Ability to effectively influence and navigate across a broad ecosystem of business stakeholders including Leaders and Line Managers, as well as fellow capability areas e.g. HRBPs, L\&D, responsible for collectively delivering change.
* Strong communication and relationship\-building skills, with the ability to simplify complex messages on change and present to business leaders.
* Strong problem solving and planning skills, with the ability to work through ambiguity and adapt the delivery approach in a changing environment.

**Preferred**

* PROSCI and/or APMG Change Practitioner certification preferred but not essential.
* Strong business acumen and understanding of business operations and operating model components, including structure, governance, processes and ways of working and ability to frame the change strategy within wider business objectives.
* Demonstrated ability to coach sponsors, cultivate change and culture champions and drive business accountability for change.
* Solid understanding of how people experience change and the drivers of change, with experience of embedding mindset and culture shifts across teams to sustain organizational and behavioral change.
* Strong data fluency with the ability to leverage analytics and insights to drive adoption, and proficiency with change management, collaboration, and digital adoption tools.

  

**Job Posting End Date**

  


2026\-05\-24**Equal Opportunities**
-----------------------


Haleon are committed to mobilising our purpose in a way that represents the diverse consumers and communities who rely on our brands every day. It guides us in creating an inclusive culture, where different backgrounds and views are valued and respected – all in support of understanding and best serving the needs of our consumers and unleashing the full potential of our people. It’s important to us that Haleon is a place where all our employees feel they truly belong.
  

  

During the application process, we may ask you to share some personal information, which is entirely voluntary. This information ensures we meet certain regulatory and reporting obligations and supports the development, refinement, and execution of our inclusion and belonging programmes that are open to all Haleon employees.
  

  

The personal information you provide will be kept confidential, used only for legitimate business purposes, and will never be used in making any employment decisions, including hiring decisions.

**Adjustment or Accommodations Request**
----------------------------------------


If you require a reasonable adjustment or accommodation or other assistance to apply for a job at Haleon at any stage of the application process, please let your recruiter know by providing them with a description of specific adjustments you are requesting. We’ll provide all reasonable adjustments to support you throughout the recruitment process and treat all information you provide us in confidence.

**Note to candidates**
----------------------


The Haleon recruitment team will contact you using a Haleon email account (@haleon.com). If you are not sure whether the email you received is from Haleon, please get in touch.

title: Senior Associate Supply Chain Compliance Management (Amgen External Planning)
description:
India \- Hyderabad
JOB ID: R\-243158 LOCATION: India \- Hyderabad WORK LOCATION TYPE: On Site DATE POSTED: May. 07, 2026 CATEGORY: Supply Chain
**HOW MIGHT YOU DEFY IMAGINATION?**


If you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. At Amgen, our shared mission—to serve patients—drives all that we do. It is key to our becoming one of the world’s leading biotechnology companies. We are global collaborators who achieve together—researching, manufacturing, and delivering ever\-better products that reach over 10 million patients worldwide. It’s time for a career you can be proud of.

**Senior Associate, Compliance Management (Amgen External Planning)**

**What you will do**


Let’s do this! Let’s change the world! In this vital role you will be part of the External Planning and Delivery Team, which is responsible for strategy and execution of all aspects of supply chain supporting our external manufacturing network.


The Senior Associate Amgen External Planning (AXP) reports to the Business Performance Manager of Supply Planning at the Amgen India, Hyderabad site. In this role, the Senior Associate Supply Chain Compliance is responsible for leading and maintaining compliance infrastructure for the External Planning organization ensuring that all GMP and non\-GMP documentation, training, and procedural requirements are established, maintained, and continuously improved to support operational excellence. This individual will serve as the compliance lead for the External Supply team, owning Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), Deviation and Change Controls, training governance, inspection readiness support, and adherence to internal Amgen policies and global regulatory requirements. This role will require a close partnership with Amgen External Supply, Global / Regional / Site Supply Chain, Global Distribution, and External Quality.


AXP is a critical component of Amgen’s Global Supply Chain, responsible for enabling reliable, efficient, and agile planning and delivery operations for Amgen’s CMO\-sourced products. The Senior Associate, based at Amgen’s Hyderabad site, will be a key member of this team and a foundational contributor to the External Planning work center, supporting the business performance and continuous improvement of planning operations. The role requires strong knowledge of GMP environments, document management systems, and cross\-functional collaboration within a highly regulated biopharmaceutical supply chain.

**Responsibilities:**

*Compliance \& SOP Governance*

* Own and manage all team SOPs (GMP and non\-GMP), work instructions, and guiding documents.
* Lead periodic SOP reviews, revisions, and lifecycle management in alignment with Amgen quality systems.
* Ensure alignment of team procedures with global policies, regulatory requirements, and CMO oversight standards.
* Coordinate cross\-functional reviews and approvals of procedural documents.
* Maintain document control and ensure inspection readiness at all times.
* Monitor and report performance metrics (e.g., cycle time, aging, on\-time closure); escalate overdue items.
* Monitor and report (SOP, training, regulatory commitments, deviations and change management) trending and provide leadership with insights and action plans for improvement.

*Training Management*

* Own and track all team training requirements (GMP and non\-GMP).
* Manage training completion, driving closure of overdue items.
* Partner with Quality and HR to ensure accurate training curricula and assignment.
* Develop training materials and support onboarding of new team members.
* Prepare compliance dashboards and periodic status reports.

*Regulatory \& Audit Support*

* Support internal and external audits and inspections related to External Supply operations and documentation practices.
* Track and manage compliance commitments, CAPAs, and action items for the team.
* Ensure proper documentation and archival of audit\-related records.
* Partner with Quality Assurance to ensure inspection readiness across the External Planning function.

*Deviation \& Change Control Management*

* Own and manage deviations and change control records across AXP supply chain operations.
* Ensure timely initiation, routing, and closure in accordance with procedures and timelines.
* Maintain accurate, complete, and compliant records within quality systems.
* Support workflow execution through coordination, tracking, and documentation updates.
* Ensure audit readiness with complete, accurate, and inspection\-ready records.

*Continuous Improvement*

* Monitor adherence to established procedures and identify compliance gaps.
* Drive process improvements to simplify documentation, training tracking, and governance workflows.
* Support risk assessments and change management activities impacting External Planning.

*Key Skills \& Competencies*

* Strong attention to detail and compliance mindset
* High level of ownership and accountability
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment
* Proactive problem\-solving skills
* Strong stakeholder management and collaboration skills

**What we expect of you**


We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The professional we seek is a leader with these qualifications.

**Basic Qualifications:**
-------------------------

* Any degree and 5\-9 years’ supply chain experience in GMP\-regulated pharmaceutical / biotechnology industry, or related business fields


In addition to meeting above requirements, you must have at least 2 years’ experience working in teams, projects, and programs. This experience may run concurrently with the required GMP\-regulated experience referenced above.

**Preferred Qualifications:**
-----------------------------

* Experience in Supply Chain, External Manufacturing, or Quality within a GMP environment.
* Strong knowledge of GMP documentation practices and quality systems.
* Experience managing SOPs and document control systems.
* Familiarity with document management systems and training compliance tracking.
* Experience supporting audits or regulatory inspections.
* Strong organizational and project management skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to operate independently while partnering cross\-functionally.
* Proficiency in MS Office and document management systems.

title: Talent Acquisition Specialist II
description:
Talent Acquisition Specialist II
Syneos Health® is a leading fully\-integrated life sciences services organization built to accelerate customer success. We partner with innovators at every point across the drug development and commercialization continuum, helping them navigate complexity, anticipate change and accelerate progress.
  

  

Every day we perform better because of how we work together, as one team, each the best at what we do. We bring together talented experts across a broad spectrum of business critical corporate functions. Every role plays an essential part in enabling our customers to achieve their goals. Our teams are agile, collaborative, and committed to delivering—for each other, for our customers, and ultimately for the people who rely on the services we support.
  

Discover what your 25,000 future colleagues already know:
  

  

Why Syneos Health
  

* We are passionate about developing our people, through career development and progression; supportive and engaged line management; technical and therapeutic area training; peer recognition and total rewards program.
* We are committed to building an inclusive culture – where you can authentically be yourself. Central to this is our purpose – Driven to Deliver – which captures the passion of our colleagues to show up each day and shape solutions that have the ability to dramatically impact someone’s life.
* We are continuously building the company we all want to work for and our customers want to work with. Why? Because we know that when we bring together smart colleagues from across the world, we can shape the future of healthcare, driving impact for customers and defining the pace of patient progress.
**Job Responsibilities**

**Job responsibilities**  

* In conjunction with all of Talent Acquisition, creates a deep and diverse talent pool to service resourcing requirements across multiple business units.
* Collaborates directly with hiring managers to understand business and skill set requirements to build a comprehensive strategic hiring plan by setting the vision, strategy, and goals to ensure current and future resource demands are met.
* As a strategic partner to your hiring managers, provide expertise in market insights, talent landscape, and an understanding of talent needs to establish expectations and build a collaborative approach with your customers to meet demands.
* Ensure customer satisfaction by providing regular updates to hiring managers and setting expectations on the hiring process per requisition or department, or both, as required.
* Utilize appropriate sourcing channels (including applicant tracking system, candidate relationship management system, job boards, advertising, networking, employee referral program) to identify qualified candidates.
* Monitor recruitment sourcing methods and provide recommendations to improve applicant attraction. Suggests innovative solutions to sourcing challenges and competitive intelligence from those efforts.
* Offers creative solutions to sourcing hard to fill requisitions in collaboration with the business.
* Responsible to manage full cycle recruiting process to include but not limited to: complete initial screening interview of potential candidates and reject non\-relevant applications, prepare candidate profile for hiring manager following interview screen, submit short listed candidates to hiring managers for review, conducts candidate debrief session after interviews are completed and extends verbal offers of employment to successful candidates.
* Ensures data accuracy within Applicant Tracking System.
* Initiates and maintains open communication with hiring managers and Human Resources (HR) colleagues in meeting recruiting needs.
* May create collateral HR materials for trade shows, professional organization meetings, and career fairs. May attend trade shows, professional organization meetings and career fairs.
* May provide training and coaching activities for Talent Acquisition Specialists.
* Performs other job\-related duties as assigned
**Qualifications \- External**

**What we’re looking for**  

Basic Qualifications
  

* Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent experience
* Experience as a Talent Acquisition Specialist / Recruiter in a corporate or agency environment
* Proven track record in direct sourcing and managing an end\-to\-end recruiting process required
* Demonstrated leadership skills
* Strong business acumen and demonstrated ability to think and influence strategically
* Proven track record in utilizing creative recruitment techniques and measurement of results
* Ability to work well with multi\-functional team and with all levels within organization
* Strong problem solving, influencing, negotiating, facilitating and partnership skills required
* Ability to effectively engage and build relationships with line management, employees, and HR team at all levels
* Excellent organizational skills and ability to effectively manage multiple demands without missing deadlines
* Strong time management skills and able to work independently
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook).
* Strong written and oral communication skills
* Strong customer services skills
* Strong attention to detail and an ability to maintain confidentiality
Preferred Qualifications
  

* Experience as a full cycle Talent Acquisition Specialist / Recruiter supporting a CRO or in the Pharmaceutical industry
* Experience working in Workday
* Experience with a CRM
**Get to know Syneos Health**

Over the past 5 years, we have worked with 94% of all Novel FDA Approved Drugs, 95% of EMA Authorized Products and over 200 Studies across 73,000 Sites and 675,000\+ Trial patients.


No matter what your role is, you’ll take the initiative and challenge the status quo with us in a highly competitive and ever\-changing environment. Learn more about Syneos Health.  

  



http://www.syneoshealth.com


**Additional Information**

Equivalent experience, skills, and/or education will also be considered so qualifications of incumbents may differ from those listed in the Job Description. description:
About the Opportunity
  
The Services Consultant is responsible for all phases of a new client coming onto Dayforce’s system or an existing client upgrading to a new Dayforce processing product. They work in a project team to provide clients with effective solutions that are aligned to our commitment of reliable, repeatable and quality implementation practices.
  
  

What you'll get to do
  
* Ability to translate business process requirements into configuration requirements for the Dayforce Solution purchased with differing levels of complexity.
* Will work in conjunction with Project Manager and Project Team in the completion of an implementation.

* Experience working with North American clients and vendors a benefit

description:
Why N\-able:

At N\-able, we’re not just helping businesses be secure —we’re redefining what it means to be cyber resilient. Our end\-to\-end platform blends AI\-powered capabilities and flexible tech stacks, so customers can manage, secure, and recover with confidence. But the real power behind it all? Our people. We’re a global crew of N\-ablites, who love solving complex problems, sharing knowledge, and delivering solutions that actually make a difference. If you're into meaningful work, fast growth, and a team that’s got your back, you’ll be surrounded by people who believe in what they do—and in you.  

  

The Payroll Specialist ensures accurate, timely payroll for India and, when required, other APAC or International countries. The role requires a good knowledge of Indian payroll rules, strong attention to detail, and a collaborative approach. The ideal candidate will thrive in a dynamic, fast‑growing, and globally distributed organisation
What You'll Do:
**Payroll Processing**
----------------------

* Manage monthly payroll for India, ensuring accuracy and compliance with company policies and statutory requirements. Support with other APAC payrolls as required.
* Validate and input payroll data including new hires, terminations, compensation changes, leave, incentives, and deductions.
* Review gross‑to‑net calculations and reconcile payroll outputs.

**Statutory Compliance (India)**
--------------------------------

* Ensure full statutory compliance including PF, ESI, PT, LWF, and Income Tax (TDS).
* Prepare and support statutory filings and ensure timely remittance of all statutory payments.
* Monitor updates to payroll legislation and implement process changes as required.

**Vendor \& Stakeholder Management**
------------------------------------

* Work closely with external payroll vendors to ensure timely and accurate delivery of services.
* Provide complete and accurate payroll inputs and review vendor outputs in detail.
* Serve as a point of contact for HR, Finance, and employees on payroll\-related matters.

**Audit \& Controls**
---------------------

* Support the Senior Manager – Payroll with internal and external audits by preparing documentation and explaining payroll processes.
* Maintain strong internal controls to ensure data accuracy, confidentiality, and compliance.
* Assist with monthly reconciliations, variance analysis, and exception reporting

**Process Improvement \& Projects**
-----------------------------------

* Identify opportunities to improve payroll efficiency, automation, and accuracy.
* Participate in payroll system implementation, updates, and global process improvement initiatives.
* Contribute to cross\-training efforts and support APAC payroll processing when required


What You'll Bring:
### **Professional Experience**

* 2–3 years of hands\-on payroll processing experience within India or APAC countries.
* Experience within a multinational or shared service environment is an advantage.
* Proven experience working with payroll vendors (e.g., ADP, BSR \& Co., KPMG, or equivalent).

### **Technical Skills**

* Strong understanding of Indian payroll legislation and statutory requirements.

title: Variable Compensation Associate
description:
**About this role:**

The Variable Compensation Associate plays a crucial role within our VC Care team, supporting the administration of worldwide Sales, Consulting, Conference, and Specialist Compensation Plans. You will assist commission\-eligible associates with compensation\-related inquiries, disputes, and escalations, provide education and training on compensation details, and perform recurring monthly processes as well as ad\-hoc reporting and analysis regarding bookings data, revenue performance, commission earnings, and annual sales awards attainment. This position requires strong analytical skills, exceptional customer service, and proficiency in Excel.


**What you'll do:**

* Complete recurring manual tasks for processes not systematically automated, frequent use of Excel, SQL, and SaaS commission applications
* Maintain commission application by performing data inputs, validation, and data quality checks on both imports and exports
* Assist commission\-eligible associates with inquiries related to commission, compensation, quota, earnings, and related topics via multiple channels (email, chat, etc.)
* Engage with Sales Associates to explain and support their understanding of commission calculations, adjustments, and payments
* Conduct thorough research and analysis to resolve inquiries, investigating anomalies to determine root causes and propose solutions
* Review monthly commission payments, confirm calculations by reconciling data to source systems, and sign\-off on payment integrity
* Process adjustment requests according to established documentation
* Generate ad\-hoc sales reports and analyses for leadership and business partners as needed
* Deliver formal and ad\-hoc training sessions to commission\-eligible associates
* Collaborate and coordinate among financial, sales, and operational departments
* Participate in testing system enhancements as required
* Drive continuous improvement by supporting initiatives, taking ownership of responsibilities, and meeting department SLAs, goals, and objectives
* Coordinate and complete additional projects as requested

**What you'll need:**

* 1 year of relevant experience, professional development, relevant college coursework, or specialized certifications
* Proficiency in basic Excel functions including VLOOKUP, pivot tables, data filtering and sorting, and strong data analytical skills
* Understanding of SQL, basic query writing, and use of pre\-written templates is a plus
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, effective listening skills, and the ability to support a high volume of inquiries in a fast\-paced environment
* Strong problem\-solving skills, curious mindset, and ability to resolve complex inquiries with available resources
* Comfortable working with large data sets from multiple sources

* Flexibility and adaptability to manage ambiguity, unexpected changes, and foster continuous improvement

We hire remarkable people who collaborate and win as a team. Together, our singular, unifying goal is to deliver results for our clients.


Our teams are inclusive and composed of individuals from different geographies, cultures, religions, ethnicities, races, genders, sexual orientations, abilities and generations.


We invest in great leaders who bring out the best in you and the company, enabling us to multiply our impact and results. This is why, year after year, we are recognized worldwide as a great place to work.


**Gartner is the world authority on AI**

At Gartner, you’ll join a company at the very center of the AI revolution. Gartner has proactive, objective guidance throughout clients’ AI journeys. We set the standard for how organizations leverage artificial intelligence to drive meaningful impact. You’ll have access to unmatched resources, expertise, and technology, and play a key role in helping Gartner and our clients innovate and grow as we leverage AI to transform business and technology landscapes.


It’s an exciting time to be at Gartner, with limitless opportunities to make a real impact, grow your skills, and build a lasting, meaningful career in a field that’s reshaping the way we operate. If you’re passionate about AI and want to be part of a team that’s guiding the leaders who shape the world, Gartner is the place for you.

Gartner offers world\-class benefits, highly competitive compensation and disproportionate rewards for top performers.


In our hybrid work environment, we provide the flexibility and support for you to thrive — working virtually when it's productive to do so and getting together with colleagues in a vibrant community that is purposeful, engaging and inspiring.

* Strong business acumen and demonstrated ability to think and influence strategically
* Proven track record in utilizing creative recruitment techniques and measurement of results
* Ability to work well with multi\-functional team and with all levels within organization
* Strong problem solving, influencing, negotiating, facilitating and partnership skills required
* Ability to effectively engage and build relationships with line management, employees, and HR team at all levels
* Excellent organizational skills and ability to effectively manage multiple demands without missing deadlines
* Strong time management skills and able to work independently
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook).
* Strong written and oral communication skills
* Strong customer services skills
* Strong attention to detail and an ability to maintain confidentiality

Preferred Qualifications  

* Experience as a full cycle Talent Acquisition Specialist / Recruiter supporting a CRO or in the Pharmaceutical industry
* Experience working in Workday
* Experience with a CRM

One of the world’s largest employers with locations in more than 100 countries, McDonald’s Corporation has corporate opportunities in Hyderabad. Our new office in Hyderabad will bring together knowledge across business, technology, analytics, and AI, accelerating our ability to deliver impactful solutions for the business and our customers across the globe.

**Department Overview**
-----------------------


McDonald’s currently has an exciting opportunity for a talented and experienced Manager, Talent Attraction, Delivery to. The Manager, Talent Attraction Delivery (McHire) will lead the design, execution, and continuous improvement of global recruiting platform for restaurant. This role ensures that recruiting activities are efficient, consistent, and aligned with enterprise\-wide talent strategies, while delivering a seamless experience for candidates and hiring managers.

**Duties**
----------

* Collect, evaluate, and prioritize market\-specific recruiting needs to inform global roadmap planning and delivery
* Define and maintain the overall ATS platform roadmap, ensuring alignment across markets and functions.
* Oversee day\-to\-day restaurant recruiting operations processes for the platform across markets.
* Monitor, measure, and improve process efficiency, service delivery, and compliance with policies and regulations globally.
* Evaluate operational metrics / reporting to track performance and inform decision\-making.

* Support change management and training efforts to embed new processes and tools across the organization.

ADB Safegate is the market leader in Airfield Solutions, with a presence in 2,300 airports and 40 offices worldwide. We're a European product company establishing an engineering centre in Hyderabad.

A dynamic, flexible, and proactive approach to work, with the ability to pivot quickly as the Labs' priorities evolve

* Detail\-oriented with strong problem\-solving skills.

Adaptable and open to change in a fast\-paced environment.

* Be part of a global organization (1500\+ employees) driving innovation in aviation and Employee \#1 in HR at our new office ADB Safegate Labs
* Unique opportunity to build the HR function for a new development hub from the ground up, offering a direct line to regional leadership and the chance to shape a world\-class engineering hub
* Competitive salary, benefits, and career growth opportunities.
A collaborative and flexible work culture that values your contributions.

title: HR Executive
description:
Role Overview

This is an executional HR role with end\-to\-end responsibility for the moving parts of recruitment, onboarding, employee records, and office operations. You will work directly with the CEO, with senior oversight on strategic and policy decisions.

You will own the process, not just support it. The right person for this role is detail\-oriented, follows up without being asked, and treats discretion as non\-negotiable.

Key Responsibilities

**Recruitment Coordination (50%)**

* Post jobs on Naukri, LinkedIn, Cutshort, Indeed, and other platforms against approved JDs
* Screen incoming CVs against role\-specific checklists provided by hiring managers
* Schedule interviews and coordinate between candidates and the hiring panel
* Maintain candidate pipelines and trackers in our CRM (Bitrix24 — training provided)
* Coordinate offer letter rollout, joining documentation, and pre\-joining engagement
* Conduct reference checks for shortlisted candidates

**HR Operations (30%)**

* Maintain attendance, leave records, and employee data
* Coordinate monthly payroll inputs with the finance team
* Manage onboarding paperwork: offer letters, joining kits, ID and tool access setup
* Manage exit formalities: relieving letters, full and final settlements, experience certificates
* Maintain employee records, contracts, and HR documentation
* Coordinate with our external compliance consultant on PF, ESI, and statutory filings

**Office and Administration (20%)**

* Office vendor coordination (housekeeping, supplies, courier, IT support)
* Travel and accommodation booking when required
* General administrative support to leadership
* Maintaining office systems and supplies

Required Skills and Experience

* 1–2 years of HR or HR coordinator experience in a corporate or consultancy setting
* Working knowledge of Naukri, LinkedIn, MS Excel, and Google Workspace
* Strong written and spoken English
* Highly organized with strong attention to detail
* Comfortable being trained on a CRM\-based hiring pipeline (Bitrix24\)
* Graduate in any discipline (HR specialization preferred but not mandatory)
* Stable career trajectory — we are looking for someone who joins with intent to stay and grow with the company

Preferred (Good to Have)

* Exposure to bulk hiring (sales or operations roles)
* Experience with at least one HRMS tool (Keka, Zoho People, GreytHR, or similar)
* Familiarity with statutory compliance basics
* Vendor coordination or office administration experience

Pay: ₹10,000\.00 \- ₹20,000\.00 per month
