title: IT Recruiter
description:
About Corvi Technologies
  
Corvi Technologies is a growing technology services company working closely with startups, product companies, and fast\-scaling technology organizations. We specialize in delivering high‑quality technical talent across modern engineering and digital stacks.
  
We are looking for a strong, hands‑on IT Recruiter who comes strictly from an IT staffing / recruitment consultancy background and has proven experience hiring for startup and product‑based companies.
  
**Note:** This position is not suitable for candidates with only corporate HR or internal talent acquisition experience.
  
Role Summary
  
As an IT Recruiter at Corvi Technologies, you will handle end‑to‑end technical recruitment for startup and product clients. You will be responsible for sourcing, screening, coordinating interviews, closing positions, and ensuring timely onboarding. This role requires strong sourcing skills, technical hiring exposure, urgency, and ownership.
  
Mandatory Criteria (Please Read Carefully)
  
* 2 to 5 years of experience strictly from an IT recruitment consultancy or staffing firm
* Hands‑on experience hiring for startup and/or product‑based companies
* Experience working on direct client requirements
* Corporate HR / internal TA profiles will not be considered


Key Responsibilities
  
* Manage the complete IT recruitment lifecycle: sourcing, screening, interviewing, offer negotiation, and onboarding
* Handle multiple technical requirements simultaneously in a fast‑paced environment
* Source candidates using LinkedIn, Naukri, ATS, job portals, referrals, and advanced Boolean searches
* Conduct detailed screening covering technical skills, communication, stability, and role fit
* Coordinate interviews, gather feedback, and drive fast closures
* Maintain strong candidate pipelines and market intelligence
* Meet weekly and monthly hiring targets with consistent quality
* Build long‑term relationships with active and passive candidates


Technical Hiring Exposure Required
  
Candidates should have experience recruiting for roles such as:
  
* Software Engineers (Java, .NET, Python, Node.js, Frontend, Full Stack)
* Product Engineers
* Cloud, DevOps, and SRE professionals
* Data Engineers and Data Scientists
* QA, Automation, and Mobile Developers
* Other modern technology roles as required


Required Skills and Attributes
  
* Strong understanding of technical roles, stacks, and hiring terminology
* Excellent sourcing and Boolean search skills
* Target‑driven and closure‑oriented mindset
* Strong communication and negotiation abilities
* Comfortable working in high‑pressure, startup‑style recruitment environments
* High ownership, accountability, and self‑motivation


What We Offer
  
* Fully remote opportunity within India
* Competitive compensation with performance‑based incentives
* Exposure to startup and product‑based clients
* Fast‑paced, high‑learning work environment
* Quick decision‑making and visible impact

* Expertise in advanced Boolean and/or Semantic searching

* Outstanding attention to detail
* Resourceful, with exceptional problem\-solving skills
* Enjoying working in a fast\-paced environment
* Ability to maintain confidential information

description:

The Staff / Junior Accountant – Accounts Payable is an entry\-level position within our International Accounting Shared Services team based in Pune. This role is ideal for a fresh or early\-career finance professional who is eager to build a strong foundation in AP operations while supporting our global subsidiaries across 20\+ international entities.


You will work under the guidance of the AP Manager and Senior Accountants and will be an integral part of the Pune AP team, which manages Expenses auditing, invoice processing, vendor payments, and compliance for Forescout's international operations. This is a hybrid role requiring a minimum of 3 days per week from our Pune (Balewadi) office.

**Routine Responsibilities**

* **Expense Auditing:** Review, validate against Forescout's Travel, Entertainment \& Expense Policy and internal guidelines, and process employee out\-of\-pocket expense reimbursements and corporate credit card transactions. This includes:
* Verifying receipts for the charges incurred
* Confirming business purpose and appropriate manager approvals
* Flagging non\-reimbursable or policy\-non\-compliant items
* Ensuring expense reports are actioned within the stipulated SLA
* Identifying anomalies — duplicate submissions, missing receipts, personal charges on corporate cards, weekend or unusual\-pattern expenses — and escalating to the AP Manager or Controller
* **Invoice Processing:** Review, validate, and process vendor invoices including 2\-way and 3\-way PO matching, ensuring accuracy of supplier details, PO numbers, bank account details, invoice numbers, and invoice dates.
* **Exception Tracking:** Maintain exception trackers for invoice discrepancies and ensure all exceptions are actioned within SLA timelines.
* **Vendor Query Resolution:** Respond to vendor and employee queries received via email and ticketing systems within agreed SLA; escalate unresolved issues to senior team members.
* **Payment Support:** Assist in preparation of weekly payment batches for vendor bills and employee expense reports across international entities.
* **Compliance:** Perform all transactional tasks in compliance with Forescout's internal control procedures and AP guidelines.
* **Documentation:** Maintain process exception logs for knowledge retention and audit readiness.
* **Reconciliation Support:** Assist senior accountants with vendor statement reconciliations and month\-end close activities.
* **Follow\-up:** Follow up with internal requisitioners (via calls, emails, or tickets) to seek hold approvals on invoices as per AP guidelines.

**Non\-Routine Responsibilities**

* Participate in process improvement initiatives to enhance AP workflow efficiency.
* Support implementation of updated AP policies and procedures.
* Assist with internal and external audit queries related to AP transactions.
* Learn and operate ERP systems (Oracle) for invoice and payment processing.


**What You Will Bring To Forescout**

**Education**

* **Minimum:** Bachelor's degree in Commerce (B.Com), Accounting, or Finance
* **Preferred:** M.Com or MBA (Finance) is a plus

**Experience**

* **0–3 years:** of experience in Accounts Payable, Finance \& Accounting, or a related field
* **Freshers:** with strong academic background and internship/articleship experience are encouraged to apply
* **Exposure:** to international AP processes (US, UK, EMEA, APAC) is an advantage

**Skills \& Competencies**

* Basic understanding of the Procure\-to\-Pay (P2P) cycle and AP processes
* Familiarity with ERP systems such as Oracle, SAP, COUPA or NetSuite (any one)
* Proficiency in MS Excel — data entry, basic formulas, and exception tracking
* Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain high accuracy in high\-volume environments
* Good written and verbal communication skills in English for vendor and stakeholder correspondence
* Ability to work independently on assigned tasks and escalate issues proactively
* Team player with a willingness to learn and take on new responsibilities

**Behavioral Attributes**

* Self\-motivated, hardworking, and able to work under pressure during month\-end close periods
* Integrity and accountability in handling sensitive financial data
* Flexible and adaptable to shift timings (role may require 2:00 PM – 11:00 PM IST shift to align with global operations)

**What Forescout Offers You**
Our visionary leadership team fosters an environment that encourages professional growth and development. We champion a diverse and inclusive culture that cultivates collaboration and innovation, where our team can make a global impact on security while working with industry\-leading technology. We take pride in offering a competitive total compensation package. If you have a strong work ethic, are visible and lean in, you will be recognised. We are in growth mode and there is a ton of opportunity at Forescout. Apply now to find out more!**More About Forescout**
Forescout Technologies, Inc., a global cybersecurity leader, continuously identifies, protects and helps ensure the compliance of all managed and unmanaged cyber assets – IT, IoT, IoMT and OT. For more than 20 years, Fortune 100 organisations and government agencies have trusted Forescout to provide vendor\-agnostic, automated cybersecurity at scale.
The Forescout Platform delivers comprehensive capabilities for network security, risk and exposure management, and threat detection and response. With seamless context sharing and workflow orchestration via ecosystem partners, it enables customers to more effectively manage cyber risk and mitigate threats. Learn more at **www.Forescout.com**.**Our Mission**
To continuously identify, protect, and ensure the compliance of all cyber assets across the modern organisation.**Our Vision**
A world where every cyber asset is seen, secure and compliant.**Our Cultural Values*** Cyber Obsessed – We are curious about technology, and we are innovative and passionate about solving big programs.
* Customer Driven – We listen, we learn, and we make it right.
* Collaborative, without Ego – No one succeeds alone. We strive to be the humble person that people want to work with.
* Relentless – We're smart, determined, and find a way. We figure stuff out.
* One Team – We all work together, and we all win together.

**Our DEI Statement**
At Forescout, we are committed to fostering a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace. We believe that diversity of background, experiences, and perspectives leads to innovation, creativity, and better decision making. We strive to create an environment where all team members feel valued, respected, and empowered. We actively promote equal opportunities and fair treatment for all individuals, regardless of their race, religion, colour, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other characteristic protected by law. By embracing Diversity, Equity and Inclusion, we aspire to build a successful culture where we work together and win together as One Team.***NOTE TO EMPLOYMENT AGENCIES:****We value the partnerships we have built with our preferred vendors. title: Computer Operator
description:
A Computer Operator manages, monitors, and maintains an organization's computer systems, networks, and hardware to ensure optimal performance and uptime. They perform data entry, run regular backups, troubleshoot hardware/software issues, and maintain operational logs. Typically, a high school diploma is required, with experience in office software and system administration. \[1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6]**Key Responsibilities and Duties**

* **System Monitoring:** Overseeing data processing equipment, mainframes, and network performance in data centers or server rooms.
* **Maintenance:** Performing routine maintenance on peripherals like printers and scanners, and troubleshooting malfunctions.
* **Data Management:** Ensuring data backups are performed consistently and storing data according to company procedures.
* **Support \& Documentation:** Resolving user queries, assisting IT staff with debugging, and logging errors or system events.
* **Data Entry:** Entering, updating, and maintaining accurate information in databases. \[1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9]

**Required Skills and Qualifications**

* **Technical Proficiency:** Knowledge of Windows/UNIX/Linux operating systems and proficiency in software tools such as MS Office (Excel, Word).
* **Attention to Detail:** High accuracy in data entry and monitoring.
* **Troubleshooting:** Ability to identify and resolve hardware/software glitches quickly.
* **Communication:** Ability to follow written and oral instructions and work with a team.
* **Experience:** Often requires 1–2 years of experience in computer operations or data center environments

Job Types: Full\-time, Part\-time, Fresher

Pay: ₹17,666\.60 \- ₹31,622\.42 per month

title: Junior Executive - HR
description:
**Position Overview**

The Junior Executive – Human Resources is an entry\-to\-mid level position based at the Head Office. The incumbent will work closely with the HR Manager and the broader HR team to support the full spectrum of HR operations, including recruitment, onboarding, employee records management, payroll coordination, performance management, and compliance. This role provides excellent exposure to both the strategic and transactional dimensions of HR in a dynamic trading environment.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1\. Talent Acquisition \& Recruitment**

* Coordinate end\-to\-end recruitment activities including drafting job postings, screening resumes, scheduling interviews, and maintaining candidate pipelines for head office and store\-level roles.
* Liaise with department heads to understand manpower requirements and prepare requisition documentation.
* Manage relationships with recruitment agencies, job portals, and campus placement partners.
* Conduct initial telephonic/in\-person screening interviews for junior and mid\-level vacancies.
* Prepare offer letters, appointment letters, and coordinate pre\-joining formalities.

**2\. Onboarding \& Induction**

* Facilitate structured onboarding programmes for new joiners, ensuring a smooth transition into the organisation.
* Coordinate induction schedules, prepare orientation materials, and liaise with IT, Admin, and Finance for new hire setup.
* Track probation periods and ensure timely confirmation reviews are conducted.

**3\. Employee Records \& HRIS Management**

* Maintain accurate and up\-to\-date employee records in the Human Resource Information System (HRIS) including personal data, employment history, leave balances, and documentation.
* Ensure timely filing and safekeeping of all physical and digital employee files in compliance with data protection policies.
* Generate periodic HR reports on headcount, attrition, absenteeism, and other key metrics for management review.

**4\. Payroll \& Attendance Coordination**

* Assist in monthly payroll processing by collating attendance data, leave records, overtime, and variable pay inputs from departments.
* Coordinate with Finance for payroll disbursement and resolve salary\-related queries from employees.
* Maintain accurate leave management records and administer the leave management system.

**5\. Performance Management**

* Support the annual and mid\-year performance appraisal cycle by circulating forms, tracking submissions, and maintaining appraisal records.
* Assist in preparing performance improvement plans (PIPs) documentation and follow\-up scheduling.
* Coordinate 360\-degree feedback collection and analysis as directed by the HR Manager.

**6\. Employee Relations \& Engagement**

* Serve as a first point of contact for employee queries related to HR policies, benefits, and procedures.
* Assist in planning and executing employee engagement initiatives, welfare programmes, team\-building events, and recognition activities.
* Support grievance handling processes by documenting complaints, scheduling hearings, and maintaining confidentiality.
* Assist in conducting exit interviews and compiling attrition analysis reports.

**7\. Training \& Development**

* Coordinate training needs identification (TNI) exercises in liaison with department heads.
* Organise internal and external training programmes including scheduling, logistics, vendor coordination, and post\-training feedback collection.
* Maintain a training calendar and track training hours, certifications, and skill development records.

**8\. Statutory Compliance \& HR Administration**

* Assist in ensuring compliance with applicable labour laws including the Shops \& Establishments Act, PF, ESI, gratuity, and other statutory requirements relevant to the footwear trading sector.
* Support audits and inspections by preparing required documentation and reports.
* Draft HR communications including notices, circulars, memos, and policy updates.
* Coordinate with legal counsel for documentation related to employment contracts and disciplinary matters.

**9\. General HR Administration**

* Maintain the HR department's filing systems, correspondence logs, and internal communication records.
* Support the HR team in special projects, policy reviews, and process improvement initiatives as assigned.
* Coordinate inter\-departmental HR activities between head office and branch/store locations.

**Qualifications \& Educational Requirements**

**Minimum Qualification**

Bachelor's Degree (B.Com, BBA, B.A. or equivalent)

**Preferred Qualification**

MBA / PGDM in Human Resources Management, or MSW (Master of Social Work) with HR specialisation

**Experience**

0–3 years of relevant HR experience. Freshers with strong academic records and internship experience are encouraged to apply.

**Certifications (Desirable)**

SHRM\-CP, HRCI, or any recognised HR certification; Working knowledge of labour law compliance

**Skills \& Competencies**

**Technical / Functional Skills**

* Working knowledge of HR processes including recruitment, payroll, and performance management.
* Proficiency in MS Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) — Excel skills including VLOOKUP, pivot tables, and basic data analysis are essential.
* Familiarity with HRIS platforms (e.g., SAP HCM, Darwinbox, Zoho People, GreytHR, or similar).
* Basic understanding of Indian labour laws including PF, ESI, Gratuity, Shops \& Establishments Act, and the Employment Exchange Act.
* Ability to draft professional HR communications, circulars, and policy documents.

**Behavioural / Soft Skills**

* Strong communication skills — both written and verbal — with the ability to interact effectively with employees across all levels.
* High degree of confidentiality, integrity, and professional ethics.
* Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities simultaneously.
* Attention to detail and accuracy in maintaining records and preparing reports.
* Proactive, self\-motivated attitude with a willingness to learn and adapt.
* Team player with a collaborative approach to working within a cross\-functional environment.
* Empathy and interpersonal sensitivity when dealing with employee concerns and grievances.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

**KPI**

**Target**

Time\-to\-Fill (Recruitment)

≤ 30 working days per vacancy

Onboarding Completion Rate

100% within defined schedule

≥ 98% accuracy, zero payroll errors

Training Coordination

100% of planned programmes executed on schedule

HR Records Accuracy

Attrition Reporting

Monthly reports submitted within 5th of each month

**Working Conditions \& Benefits**

**Work Environment**

* Standard office environment at the Head Office.
* Five\-day working week with flexibility during peak recruitment or payroll cycles.
* Occasional travel to warehouse or retail store locations for HR audits, inductions, or employee engagement activities.

**Compensation \& Benefits**

* Competitive fixed CTC commensurate with qualifications and experience.
* Performance\-linked variable pay reviewed annually.
* Statutory benefits: PF, ESI, Gratuity as applicable.
* Health insurance (self \+ dependents) and group life insurance.
* Paid annual leave, casual leave, and sick leave as per company policy.
* Staff purchase discount on company footwear brands.

title: Factory Manager
description:
**Role:** Factory Manager (Day Shift \& Night Shift)  
**Department:** Production  
**Location:** Factory (Mathura)  
**Reporting To:** Plant Head / Director / MD

Role Purpose

To ensure disciplined, efficient, and uninterrupted factory operations across shifts, with strong control over production, manpower, safety, and issue resolution, especially during sensitive operational situations.

Key Responsibilities1\. Production Management

* Ensure achievement of daily and monthly production targets
* Monitor line efficiency, output, and wastage
* Take immediate corrective actions in case of delays or breakdowns

2\. Manpower Management

* Ensure labour attendance, discipline, and productivity
* Handle worker concerns proactively to prevent escalation
* Coordinate with HR for grievances, absenteeism, and conflicts
* Maintain accountability across shifts

3\. Shift Operations Management

* Ensure smooth shift handover with proper communication
* Avoid production loss during shift transitions
* Maintain continuity of operations between day and night shifts

4\. Crisis and Situation Handling

* Act as the first point of control during disputes or disruptions
* Prevent production stoppage due to mismanagement
* Escalate critical issues to management in a timely manner

5\. Quality and Compliance

* Ensure adherence to quality standards
* Maintain hygiene, safety, and compliance on the shop floor
* Prevent production\-related customer complaints

6\. Cross\-functional Coordination

* Coordinate with Purchase, Logistics, HR, and Maintenance
* Ensure material availability and dispatch alignment

KRAs (Key Result Areas)1\. Production Efficiency and Target Achievement

* Consistent achievement of production targets
* Reduction in downtime and wastage

2\. Workforce Discipline and Stability

* Controlled and disciplined workforce
* Minimal conflicts and disruptions

3\. Shift Management Effectiveness

* Seamless shift handovers
* No production variance due to poor coordination

4\. Crisis Prevention and Control

* Early identification of risks
* Effective handling of labour and operational issues

5\. Quality and Compliance Adherence

* Maintenance of product quality standards
* Compliance with safety and hygiene norms

6\. Coordination and Reporting

* Effective inter\-department coordination
* Timely and accurate reporting to management

KPIs (Key Performance Indicators)1\. Production KPIs

* Percentage achievement of daily production targets
* Line efficiency percentage
* Downtime hours per shift

2\. Manpower KPIs

* Labour attendance percentage
* Absenteeism and attrition rate
* Number of labour complaints or escalations

3\. Discipline KPIs

* Number of incidents (conflicts, stoppages)
* Issue resolution turnaround time

4\. Shift KPIs

* Shift handover error count
* Production variance between day and night shifts

5\. Quality KPIs

* Rejection percentage
* Number of production\-related customer complaints
* Batch failure rate

6\. Crisis Management KPIs

* Number of escalations to senior management
* Response time for critical issues

Day vs Night Shift Role ClarityDay Shift Factory Manager

* Production planning and scheduling
* Coordination with HR, Purchase, Logistics, and Maintenance
* Labour engagement and issue prevention
* Material readiness and vendor coordination
* Daily reporting and review

Night Shift Factory Manager

* Execution of production plan
* Maintaining discipline on the shop floor
* Immediate handling of issues during shift
* Escalation only in critical cases
* Maintaining logs for next\-day review

Mandatory Control Systems

* Shift Handover Register
* Record production status, issues, and labour concerns
* Daily Reporting System
* Production, manpower, and incident reporting
* Authority Clarity
* Factory Managers must have defined decision\-making authority on the shop floor

Interested candidates can send their resumes to 7303084408

description:
**About PhonePe Limited:**
 Headquartered in India, its flagship product, the PhonePe digital payments app, was launched in Aug 2016\. As of April 2025, PhonePe has over 60 Crore (600 Million) registered users and a digital payments acceptance network spread across over 4 Crore (40\+ million) merchants. PhonePe also processes over 33 Crore (330\+ Million) transactions daily with an Annualized Total Payment Value (TPV) of over INR 150 lakh crore.
   

  

 PhonePe’s portfolio of businesses includes the distribution of financial products (Insurance, Lending, and Wealth) as well as new consumer tech businesses (Pincode \- hyperlocal e\-commerce and Indus AppStore Localized App Store for the Android ecosystem) in India, which are aligned with the company’s vision to offer every Indian an equal opportunity to accelerate their progress by unlocking the flow of money and access to services.
   

  

**Culture:**
 At PhonePe, we go the extra mile to make sure you can bring your best self to work, Everyday!. And that starts with creating the right environment for you. We empower people and trust them to do the right thing. Here, you own your work from start to finish, right from day one. PhonePe\-rs solve complex problems and execute quickly; often building frameworks from scratch. If you’re excited by the idea of building platforms that touch millions, ideating with some of the best minds in the country and executing on your dreams with purpose and speed, join us!
   

  

**About:** 
 Phonepe is the leader in the UPI based payments in India with a market share of more than 47%. Our goal is to make payments so easy, safe and universally accepted that people never feel the need to carry cash or cards again. We believe India is at the cusp of a new mobile revolution, which will change the way we manage our money on the go. We see ourselves facilitating this change, through technology and dogged customer centricity. PhonePe went live in 2016 and till date has got over 600 mn registered users and 38 mn merchants. PhonePe has forayed into diverse areas with its offerings in all fintech segments including insurance, lending, mutual funds and stock broking. In 2024, PhonePe also launched Indus AppStore \- its own native Android\-based mobile app\-store built for Indian consumers providing app discovery and content in 12 Indian languages.
   

  

**Job Objective:** 
 Seeking a detail\-oriented HR Compliance Specialist for supporting the day\-to\-day operations related to various statutory compliances along with maintaining records, supporting inspections, and communicating with employees.
   

  

**Responsibilities:**
* Regulatory Compliance:


 Coordinate with various internal and external stakeholders to ensure compliance with all statutory requirements pertaining to the labour laws .
   

  

 Ensure response to notices from the Government departments and submission of required data and timely filing of returns under various statutes help from PhonePe’s compliance partners.
   

  

 Coordination in preparation and dispatch of letters/ responses to notices received from the respective Government authorities/ departments.
   

  

 Maintain MIS for tracking various compliance related activities (dues, submissions, TAT, etc). Generating reports on compliance status, risks, issues and closures internal reviews.
   

  

* PF related Coordination and Employee Support:


 Handle and resolve PF related queries from employees in line with the prevalent guidelines.
   

  

 Supporting employees in submitting e\-JDs for correction of PF records.
   

  

 Guiding employees to file grievances on PF portal for resolution pending at departments.
   

  

 Ensuring compliances to PF e\-KYC and E\- nomination requirements by following up the respective employees.
   

  

 Assisting the nominees in filling and submitting death related claims.
   

  

* ESIC related Coordination and Employee Support:


 Ensuring timely and accurate monthly ESIC registrations and filings.
   

  

 Maintaining and updating the mandatory ESIC records, including registers and Form\-6, for ensuring 100% audit readiness for statutory inspections.
   

  

 Supporting employees with benefits and claims (sickness, maternity, accident reports) by coordinating with local ESIC offices (through the Compliance Partner) to ensure compliance.
   

  

* Documentation and Record\-Keeping:


 Maintain meticulous records of all compliance\-related activities \- registers, notices, responses, filings, and communications pertaining to the various statutes as required.
   

  

 Ensure that employee records and documentation are maintained as per statutory and audit requirements.
   

  

**Capabilities \& Requirements:**
* Bachelor's / Master’s degree in Human Resources, Labour Laws, Social work or related field.
* Knowledge of Labour Laws, regulations, guidelines, and procedures required for Compliances.
* 1 to 2 year experience in handling statutory and labour laws compliances (including PF and ESIC). Exposure in handling compliances for large headcount (\>5000\) is preferred.
* Experience in handling PF matters and PF employer portal will be a plus.
* Attention to detail and accuracy in record keeping, ability to handle confidential information.
* Exhibit high execution rigour with ability to work independently.


**PhonePe Full Time Employee Benefits (Not applicable for Intern or Contract Roles)**
* Insurance Benefits \- Medical Insurance, Critical Illness Insurance, Accidental Insurance, Life Insurance
* Wellness Program \- Employee Assistance Program, Onsite Medical Center, Emergency Support System
* Parental Support \- Maternity Benefit, Paternity Benefit Program, Adoption Assistance Program, Day\-care Support Program
* Mobility Benefits \- Relocation benefits, Transfer Support Policy, Travel Policy
* Retirement Benefits \- Employee PF Contribution, Flexible PF Contribution, Gratuity, NPS, Leave Encashment
* Other Benefits \- Higher Education Assistance, Car Lease, Salary Advance Policy

 The Europe Onboarding Lead has responsibilities for leading the Onboarding team in the Bangalore Delivery Centre. This includes people management responsibilities and key deliverables in areas of process transformation execution, program implementation, key stakeholder management. They should coach and enable the team to enhance skills, create an environment encouraging creativity and innovation and foster a culture of inclusion and diversity.
   

  

**Your Role And Responsibilities**
 As an Onboarding
 **Lead/SME** 
 you will oversees the design, execution, and continuous improvement of the onboarding experience for new hires. This role ensures alignment with organizational goals, drives standardization across regions, manages the onboarding team, and ensures a seamless, engaging, and compliant transition for every new employee.
   

  

* Strategic Planning \& Program Management
* Standardize onboarding processes across regions or business units.
* Align onboarding practices with business goals, company culture.
* Define key performance indicators (KPIs) and track onboarding success metrics such as completion rates, feedback scores, and retention.
* Lead continuous improvement initiatives, incorporating feedback from stakeholders and new hires.
* Team Leadership \& Operations Management
* Lead, mentor, and guide a team of Onboarding Specialists.
* Allocate resources efficiently to manage onboarding volume across multiple locations.
* Conduct regular team reviews to ensure quality, consistency, and process adherence.
* Foster a culture of collaboration, accountability, and customer\-centricity within the team.
* Stakeholder \& Cross\-Functional Collaboration
* Partner with Talent Acquisition, HR Business Partners, Payroll, IT, and Facilities to ensure readiness for every new hire.
* Liaise with external vendors when required.
* Serve as a key point of contact for leadership on all onboarding\-related updates and escalations.
* Process Excellence \& Compliance
* Ensure onboarding documentation, verification, and processes comply with company policies and legal requirements.
* Drive process automation and digital transformation to enhance efficiency.
* Maintain data integrity across HR systems and onboarding platforms.
* Audit onboarding activities periodically to ensure consistency and quality.
* Employee Experience \& Engagement
* Design and deliver a positive and memorable new hire experience.
* Monitor and act on onboarding survey results to continuously improve experience.
* Reporting \& Analytics
* Develop and maintain onboarding dashboards for leadership review.

* Change Management \& Continuous Improvement

 Master's Degree

* Proficiency in HRIS platforms and onboarding tools ( SuccessFactors, Service now).
* Analytical mindset with data\-driven decision\-making
* Empathy, customer orientation, and adaptability

title: Recruitment Coordinator
description:
Role Summary:
 



  





 The Recruitment Coordinator will support end\-to\-end recruitment execution by assisting with job postings, resume screening, interview coordination, offer\-stage tracking, and onboarding logistics. This role ensures smooth hiring operations through effective coordination, documentation, timely communication, and accurate reporting.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities:
 



  





 Recruitment Execution Support
 



 •Assist in drafting, formatting, and updating Job Descriptions based on hiring manager requirements
 



 •Maintain standardized job posting templates and ensure uniform employer branding
 



 •Post job openings on LinkedIn, Naukri, and other identified job boards
 



 •Track job posting performance and maintain job posting trackers
 



  





 Resume Screening \& Sourcing Support
 



 •Support the HR Manager with first\-level CV screening for junior to mid\-level roles
 



 •Source profiles from job portals as per role requirements
 



  





 Interview Scheduling \& Coordination
 



 •Schedule interviews with internal panelists and external candidates
 



 •Send calendar invites and confirm availability with all stakeholders
 



  





 Job Description:
 



 •Share interview guidelines and JD with panelists prior to interviews
 



 •Follow up post\-interview to ensure timely feedback collection
 



 •Send interview confirmations, reminders, and feedback communications to candidates
 



 •Ensure candidates are informed of recruitment timelines and next steps
 



 •Coordinate logistics for in\-person, virtual, or assessment\-based interviews
 



  





 Offer \& Post\-Offer Coordination
 



 •Collect and verify documents required for offer processing and background verification (BGV)
 



 •Maintain trackers for candidates at offer and post\-offer stages

 •Share offer letters with selected candidates and track acceptance status

 •Attention to detail and strong follow\-up skills

title: Office & HR Coordinator
description:
**Our Craft**
 Edrington’s vision is to give more by crafting exceptional ultra\-premium spirit brands. The Macallan is our central focus, supported by Highland Park and The Glenrothes in the single malt category. Our portfolio is completed with Brugal rum from the Dominican Republic, Wyoming Whiskey in the American Whiskey category and Valdespino sherry from Jerez in Spain. Edrington also has a strategic partnership with No.3 London Dry Gin.
   

  

 Our principal shareholder is a charitable trust, so we were built to make a world of difference. Discover a place where values define our culture. The home of exceptional brands, where people and teams thrive.
   

  

**Our Blend Of Benefits**
* Competitive Salary
* 23 days holiday, plus 7 days casual leave plus 4 Giving More volunteer days
* Provident fund contributions
* Private medical insurance
* Life Insurance
* Personal Accident Insurance
* 24/7 support for you and your loved ones to counselling, life coaching and information on financial, mental, and physical wellbeing
* Experience our exceptional brands with a generous annual product allowance
* Embrace work\-life harmony with hybrid working, 26 weeks’ paid maternity, paternity and adoption leave, and up to five paid carers leave days a year


**Embrace Excellence**
 This position acts as the first point of contact for visitors to the Edrington India office either in person through reception or over the telephone.  The role holder will be an Edrington ambassador by delivering an exceptional office coordination services to all visitors, guests and colleagues arriving and departing the office.
   

  

 The role holder will also support the HR Advisor and Compliance Officer in providing HR and administration service for Edrington India. Based in Gurgaon, the role reports to the Compliance Officer with a dotted line to the HR Advisor, based in Dubai.
   

  

 The role will predominantly support office administrative tasks such as event coordination, managing the visitor log and note taking during leadership team meetings however, the role will also be the first point of contact for India\-related HR queries and support the HR Advisor in ensuring all HR processes are fully compliant with India employment laws and local regulations.
   

  

**Make an Impact**
* Act as Front of House lead, managing visitors, reception activity, office facilities, meeting rooms, travel support, events, and overall workplace experience.
* Coordinate office administration and records, including databases, deliveries, invoicing, stationery, catering, and general operational support.
* Provide administrative support to HR and senior leadership, including diary management, expenses, note‑taking, and deputising for the HR Advisor when required.
* Maintain accurate HR systems and employee records (including Employee Central), ensuring data privacy, governance, and quality standards are met.
* Support India HR and labour compliance, maintaining statutory documentation, filing returns, supporting inspections, and liaising with authorities.
* Assist with employment lifecycle administration, including onboarding documentation, payroll inputs, benefits queries, and compliant exit processes.
* Support HR policy administration and local compliance reviews, ensuring alignment with Central and State legislation in India.
* Contribute to employee engagement, wellbeing, DE\&I, Giving More initiatives, and local learning and development activities.
* Build strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders, supporting recruitment for junior roles and effective day‑to‑day HR operations.


**Your Talent And Skills**
 We’re looking for a confident and highly organised Office Coordinator with experience in a customer‑focused environment and a proven ability to manage multiple priorities with flexibility and attention to detail. You’ll be a strong communicator, comfortable working with stakeholders at all levels, and able to take ownership of tasks while maintaining a professional, helpful, and polished approach. Experience supporting HR systems or carrying out basic HR administration is important, with any knowledge of Indian employment or compliance legislation an advantage. Above all, you’ll have a strong work ethic, excellent customer service skills, and the discretion required to handle sensitive information.
   

  

 We’ve put together some criteria that we think is important for this role, but don’t worry if your experience and expertise isn’t an exact match. If you feel that you can add value to our role and to Edrington more broadly, we would welcome your application and be eager to learn more about you.
   

  

 \*Applications close 21st May 2026 at midnight\*
   

  

**A Place For Everyone**
 We’re proud of our inclusive culture – where unique experiences, ideas and perspectives are celebrated. We want everyone to feel respected and empowered to contribute to our success.
   

  

 Get involved. From colleague networks like Balance, Pride and Kick\-Start to inclusion allies and DE\&I champions, we encourage our people to be curious, get involved and help us make change happen.

 your work makes a difference.
   

  

 At Baxter, we believe every person—regardless of who they are or where they are from—deserves a chance to live a healthy life. This role ensures consistency in HR processes, compliance with policies and local labor laws, and smooth execution of core HR activities such as employee data management, payroll coordination, benefits administration, and employee support.

title: Insights & client Success
description:
Role DNA \-
 



 This role is designed for someone early in their career who brings structure, ownership, and intellectual seriousness to every piece of work they touch. Alongside insight delivery, you'll support account management and contribute to solution design — but execution quality is the core. The ideal person here isn't looking for hand\-holding; they want early ownership and the chance to work at the intersection of research, AI, and client delivery.
 



  





**WHAT PROBLEM ARE THEY TRYING TO SOLVE?** 




 A platform automates data collection, analysis, and report generation — but the final mile requires human judgment, quality control, and structured communication to make outputs usable for demanding clients. The Associate is that last mile. As it scales its client base across consulting and PE firms globally, they need people who can maintain delivery quality at volume. The Associate also serves as a key feedback loop — working closely with clients and ML/product teams to identify where the platform needs to evolve and how new solutions should be designed.
 



  





**MUST HAVES** 



* 1–3 years in a research, consulting, analytics, or strategy role — or an exceptional fresher with demonstrably strong structured thinking
* Strong written and verbal communication; able to present clearly and professionally to clients at consulting or PE firms
* High ownership mentality — follows through without being chased, treats output quality as a personal standard
* Structured problem\-solver: can take an ambiguous brief, break it down, and deliver something coherent and well\-argued


1. Comfortable working with technology platforms and picking up new tools quickly — this is an AI\-powered product environment


* Genuine intellectual curiosity — wants to understand the 'why' behind a research question, not just complete the task



  





**STRONG SIGNAL** 



* Background in primary or secondary research, market intelligence, or data analytics
* Has produced client\-facing deliverables — decks, reports, briefs — even in an internship context
* Has worked with or alongside product or tech teams
* Comfortable synthesizing large datasets or qualitative inputs into a coherent narrative
* Experience with business terminology and comfort discussing commercial or strategic context with clients
* Prior exposure to B2B client environments — research firms, consulting, SaaS, or enterprise services
* Has contributed to building a process, template, or playbook, even at a junior level
* Fast learner with a track record of stepping up quickly in early roles



  





**WHAT DOES SUCCESS LOOK LIKE IN 60–90 DAYS?** 




**30 Days** 




 Has completed platform onboarding and can independently navigate Teamroom for core insight workflows. Has shadowed at least 2–3 client interactions and can articulate the brief, the output, and the client's expectations for each active engagement.
 



  





**60 Days** 




 Is delivering insight outputs with limited supervision, with quality that meets client expectations. Has flagged at least one process improvement or platform gap based on hands\-on experience. Is contributing meaningfully to client communication with appropriate polish.
 



  





**90 Days** 




 Is a trusted execution owner on assigned engagements. Can manage the end\-to\-end delivery of an insight workstream from brief to client output. Has contributed to at least one solution design or platform codification discussion. Is seen internally as a reliable, high\-ownership member of the team.

description:
Job description:
   

  

 Job Description
 
  

**Role** 




 The purpose of the role is to manage delivery of a project driving operations and delivery governance, ensuring right talent supply chain to optimize customer satisfaction and cost of delivery
 


 ͏
 
**Do** 




 \- Delivery Management
   

 \- Ensure seamless delivery of the projects 
   

 \- Deploy optimum project delivery structure post transition/ migration phase by evaluating the budget, costs, risks and staffing requirement 
   

 \- Create quarterly project charter with well\-defined weekly project trajectory as per the project specifications \& requirements and ensure 100% adherence in terms of schedule, quality, efforts and costs 
 



  

 \- Ensure 100% compliance to Project SLAs, information security protocols and etc (all customers contractual obligations)
   

 \- Monitor and take appropriate actions on internal and external audit findings to ensure no major non\-compliance/ deviation from the SLA
   

 \- Liaise between customer and internal technical delivery team to drive project health by adhering to organizational norms of project metrics
   

 \- Drive various project related audits like quality, customer, ISO etc and ensure zero non\-compliance
   

 \- Conduct periodic cadence with the quality team to take proactive measures to resolves issues/ possible escalations
   

 \- Conducts periodic cadence with Workforce Management Group (WMG) to ensure 100% fulfillment as per the program/ project requirement
   

 \- Regularly audit quality (QA) status of delivery and engage QA team to ensure adherence to Quality Assurance standards and processes
   

 \- Maintain project structure in Confluence \& SAP in line with prevailing business requirements and norms
   

 \- Ensure expected ramp down (ERD) compliance as committed in MSA
 



 \- Client Relationship Management
   

 \- Engage with client to deploy opportunities to deploy multiple solutions within/ across SLs to create a stronger value proposition for clients
   

 \- Conduct regular customer connects (meetings/ visits/ video\- conference) and participate in Management Review Meetings (MRM) with client management/engagement managers to understand customers current and future needs and seek feedback to improve delivery methodology/ timelines/ resource allocation
 



 \- Identify and close early warnings on a project to avoid any customer escalations
   

 \- Plan and conduct Quarterly Business Reviews (QBR) along with DMs/ ADH with the client management/ leadership team to drive improvement actions and mine for a new portfolio/ opportunity within the account
   

 \- Design and monitor project performance dashboards/ reports with the clients periodically
 



 \- Delivery governance across the project
   

 \- Create weekly/ monthly/ quarterly MIS and reports to monitor and track overall project
   

 \- Conduct periodic reviews with the delivery team on operational, quality and fulfillment parameters and new idea generation \& its implementation on existing projects

 \- Escalate any deviations from the project charter to the delivery managers in terms of schedule, effort, cost, infrastructure from the project charter and minimize process exceptions and such deviations from the actual project plan

 \- Provide inputs to delivery leadership team on overall delivery performance parameters (project heath, utilization, realization etc) at project/ program level during reviews highlighting any critical project escalations and potential risks

 \- Interact and engage with tools team to bring in new tools in the project to automate certain pointers/ elimination of any noise in the project
 



 \- Innovation Focus
   

 \- Brainstorm with the team to identify improvement opportunities and initiatives to further improve quality, delivery speed and productivity parameters
   

 \- Drive value adds and BVMs; ensure management showcases them to customer in MRM \& QBR to drive growth
 



 \- Plan and conduct periodic idea campaigns to generate new solutions to the problems/ define better ways of working
 



 \- Drive and deploy Knowledge Management and sharing 
   

 \- Contribute in internal knowledge sharing initiatives at Wipro by driving internal training sessions, best practices, learnings, value adds and BVMs and deploys best practices in various projects within own account
   

 \- Deploy the Wipro's knowledge management portal across the account and monitor \& track trainings

 \- Demand forecasting in line with business requirements 
   

 \- Anticipate attrition and ensure right talent supply chain to deliver the project
   

 \- Spearhead quarterly demand forecasting and resource planning aligned to project requirements
 



  

 \- Create and deploy a workplan to fulfil the required demand from all the talent channels including external (lateral, contractors etc) hiring in coordination with WMG/ CWMG and Talent Acquisition team
   

 \- Anticipate new skills/ upcoming technologies required to deliver the project and ensure the team is trained or right talent is inducted into the project as per the skill requirements
 



 \- Drive 100% compliance on trainings and upskilling requirements 
   

 \- Prioritize and identify essential and upcoming technical skills required across programs/ projects to facilitate and drive right supply chain
   

 \- Drive towards 100% mandatory training compliance for the target population within an account
 



 \- Plan and drive rotations for seed positions and ensure replacement plan to be arrived ahead of rotations

title: Presales Trainee
description:
**Pre\-Sales Trainee**


Location: **Mumbai**


Employment Type: **Full\-Time \| 5 Days a Week**


Who Should Apply: **Freshers \& Early\-Career Candidates (0\-1 Year)**


Probation Period: **6 Months, followed by confirmation as Pre\-Sales Associate**

  


**About the Role**


If you have been thinking \- I want to work in tech, but coding all day is not exactly my vibe \- this role was built for you. As a Pre\-Sales Trainee at Leapswitch, you will sit right at the intersection of technology and people: talking to real businesses, understanding their challenges, and presenting cloud solutions that genuinely help them.


You will work closely with our Sales and Technical teams, getting hands\-on exposure to products like CloudJiffy, CloudPe.com, and Bare\-Metal Servers. No prior experience required, just curiosity and a willingness to grow fast.

  


**What You'll Do**


* Join customer discovery calls to understand what problems businesses are trying to solve.
* Learn to present and demo our cloud products \- CloudJiffy, CloudPe.com, and Bare\-Metal Servers \- in a way that clicks for non\-technical buyers.
* Help build customised proposals, solution documents, and cost estimates tailored to each client.
* Support the team in preparing RFPs and RFI responses \- you will learn the full pre\-sales cycle.
* Coordinate with internal tech teams to get customer queries resolved quickly.
* Assist in proof\-of\-concept activities, guided by senior team members.
* Stay updated on trends in cloud computing, hosting, and virtualization.

  


Who We're Looking For


**You do not need to check every box \- but here is what will help:**


* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT, Engineering, or a related field (final year students may also apply).
* Freshers welcome \- internship or trainee experience in sales, tech support, or cloud is a bonus, not a must.
* Basic awareness of cloud concepts, servers, or networking \- even if self\-taught.
* Good communication skills \- written and verbal.
* Curious, proactive, and comfortable (or excited to become) in a customer\-facing role.

  


**Good to Have**


* Basic knowledge of Linux, Windows Server, or any cloud platform (AWS, GCP, Azure \- even beginner\-level counts).
* Interest in solution selling, customer interaction, and technical consulting.
* Ability to simplify complex technical concepts for a non\-technical audience.
* Strong analytical thinking and problem\-solving attitude.

  


**Probation \& Growth Path**


The role begins with a 6\-month probation period. We will evaluate your growth, communication, and role suitability. Perform well and you are confirmed \- with a clear path forward.


**Trainee \-\> Pre\-Sales Associate \-\> Senior Pre\-Sales**


**Why Join Leapswitch?**


* Real work from Day 1 \- customer calls, proposals, and demos within your first few weeks.
* Hands\-on exposure to live cloud products used by businesses across India.
* Mentorship from senior team members on demos, discovery, and deal strategy.
* Fast\-paced culture where good ideas are welcomed regardless of experience level.
* A defined growth path in a high\-demand domain \- cloud pre\-sales skills open doors everywhere.

title: Sales Development Representative | IT Services | Remote 2+ Years Experience
description:
We are hiring an experienced Sales Development Representative — IT Services to support international client prospecting, lead generation, and business development for the USA and UK markets.
 



  





 This is a full\-time remote role for candidates who have hands\-on experience in IT services sales, B2B lead generation, cold outreach, LinkedIn prospecting, email campaigns, and appointment setting.
 



  





 The ideal candidate should be able to identify potential clients, reach out to decision\-makers, qualify business opportunities, and support the sales pipeline for services such as web development, mobile app development, AI solutions, SaaS development, CRM, ERP, cloud, DevOps, and custom software development.
 



  





**\# Key Responsibilities** 





 \-
 
 The selected candidate will be responsible for:
 




 \-
 
 Identifying and researching potential clients in the USA and UK markets.
 




 \-
 
 Generating qualified B2B leads for IT services and software development projects.
 




 \-
 
 Finding decision\-makers such as CEOs, founders, CTOs, product heads, operations heads, and business owners.
 




 \-
 
 Creating targeted prospect lists using LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Apollo, Crunchbase, Google, directories, company websites, and other lead generation tools.
 




 \-
 
 Running outbound campaigns through LinkedIn, cold email, and calling.
 




 \-
 
 Writing professional outreach messages, follow\-up emails, and introductory business communication.
 




 \-
 
 Qualifying prospects based on business need, budget, timeline, and decision\-making authority.
 




 \-
 
 Scheduling meetings or discovery calls for the senior sales / business development team.
 




 \-
 
 Maintaining CRM records, follow\-up status, lead notes, and pipeline updates.
 




 \-
 
 Understanding client requirements at a basic level and mapping them to suitable IT services.
 




 \-
 
 Collaborating with internal teams to prepare basic proposals, pitch documents, or service presentations when required.
 




 \-
 
 Meeting weekly and monthly lead generation, outreach, and appointment\-setting targets.
 



  





  





**\# Mandatory Requirements** 





 \-
 
 Minimum 2 years of experience in SDR, business development, lead generation, inside sales, or client acquisition.
 




 \-
 
 Previous experience in an IT services / software development company is mandatory.
 




 \-
 
 Proven experience in generating leads for international markets, preferably USA and UK.
 




 \-
 
 Strong understanding of IT services such as web development, mobile apps, SaaS, AI, CRM, ERP, cloud, or custom software.
 




 \-
 
 Excellent spoken and written English communication.
 




 \-
 
 Experience with LinkedIn outreach, cold emailing, prospect research, and CRM tools.
 




 \-
 
 Ability to work independently in a remote environment.
 




 \-
 
 Comfortable working with targets, follow\-ups, and sales performance metrics.
 




 \-
 
 Candidates without IT services sales or lead generation experience will not be considered.
 



  





  





**\# What We’re Looking For** 




**We are looking for someone who is:** 





 \-
 
 Confident in speaking with international prospects.
 




 \-
 
 Experienced in outbound sales and B2B prospecting.
 




 \-
 
 Skilled at finding the right decision\-makers.
 




 \-
 
 Comfortable with USA and UK client communication.
 




 \-
 
 Strong in follow\-ups and relationship building.
 




 \-
 
 Able to understand basic client pain points and identify service opportunities.
 




 \-
 
 Self\-motivated, disciplined, and result\-oriented.
 




 \-
 
 Able to work remotely without constant supervision.
 




 \-
 
 Professional in written communication, especially emails and LinkedIn messages.
 



  
 



  





**\# Services You Will Prospect For** 




**The candidate will help generate business opportunities for services such as:** 





 \-
 
 AI and Generative AI solutions
 




 \-
 
 Web application development
 




 \-
 
 Mobile app development
 




 \-
 
 Custom software development
 




 \-
 
 SaaS product development
 




 \-
 
 CRM development
 




 \-
 
 ERP development
 




 \-
 
 Cloud and DevOps services
 




 \-
 
 E\-commerce platforms
 




 \-
 
 Healthcare, finance, real estate, education, logistics, and retail software solutions
 



  





    
 



**\# Who Should Apply** 




**Apply if you have:** 





 \-
 
 At least 2 years of experience in IT sales, SDR, lead generation, or business development.
 




 \-
 
 Worked with international clients or international prospecting campaigns.
 




 \-
 
 Experience generating leads for software development or IT services companies.
 




 \-
 
 Strong English communication and confidence in outreach.
 




 \-
 
 A target\-driven mindset.
 




 \-
 
 The ability to work remotely with discipline and ownership.
 



  





**\# Who Should Not Apply** 




**Please do not apply if:** 





 \-
 
 You are a fresher.
 




 \-
 
 You do not have experience in IT services sales or lead generation.

 You are not comfortable with outbound outreach.

 You are not comfortable working with targets.

 Salary will be based on experience, communication skills, and proven lead generation performance.

title: Apprentice-IT
description:
**What You’ll Do**
 We are looking for a motivated AI/ML Engineering graduate to join our Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning (AIML) team. This role is ideal for a fresher with a strong academic foundation in AI/ML who is eager to apply theory to real world business problems under mentorship.
   

  

 You will work closely with senior AI/ML engineers, data scientists, and platform teams to build, experiment with, and operationalize machine learning solutions on enterprise scale data platforms.
   

  

* Assist in building and training machine learning models for structured and unstructured data use cases
* Perform data analysis, preprocessing, and feature engineering on large datasets
* Support experimentation using AutoML and custom ML approaches
* Evaluate model performance and assist in tuning for accuracy and robustness
* Work with AI/ML platforms and tools for model development and experimentation
* Collaborate with engineers and analysts to understand business problems and translate them into ML tasks
* Document experiments, learnings, and model outcomes clearly
* Follow best practices for responsible AI, data governance, and security


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (B.E./B.Tech) with specialization in:
* Artificial Intelligence
* Machine Learning
* Data Science
* Computer Science (with strong AI/ML coursework)


**Skills**
* Strong fundamentals in:
* Machine Learning algorithms
* Statistics and linear algebra
* Data structures and basic algorithms
* Working knowledge of Python
* Familiarity with ML libraries such as:
* scikit learn
* TensorFlow or PyTorch (basic exposure is sufficient)
* Basic understanding of SQL and working with datasets


 Good to Have (Not Mandatory)
   

  

* Exposure to:
* Cloud platforms (Azure / AWS / GCP)
* Data platforms like Snowflake
* ML lifecycle concepts (training, evaluation, deployment)
* Academic or personal projects involving:
* Predictive modeling
* NLP or computer vision
* Time series forecasting
* Familiarity with notebooks, Git, or basic MLOps concepts


 What You Will Learn
   

  

* End to end AI/ML use case development in an enterprise environment
* Working with real production scale datasets
* Model experimentation, evaluation, and promotion practices
* AI/ML platform tools and best practices
* How ML solutions are governed, monitored, and scaled

title: Network Engineer – L2
description:
**Make an impact with NTT DATA**
 Join a company that is pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We are renowned for our technical excellence and leading innovations, and for making a difference to our clients and society. Our workplace embraces diversity and inclusion – it’s a place where you can grow, belong and thrive.
   

  

**Your day at NTT DATA**
 As a Networking Managed Services Engineer (L2\) at NTT DATA, you'll take on a developing engineering role where your main goal is to ensure our clients' IT infrastructure and systems remain operational. You'll achieve this by proactively monitoring, identifying, investigating, and resolving technical incidents and problems. You'll work closely with our clients and internal teams to ensure that services are restored swiftly, in line with our service level agreements (SLAs).
   

  

 Your day will revolve around reviewing client requests and tickets, applying your technical expertise to resolve them efficiently and effectively. You'll be the go\-to person for second\-line support, handling incidents and requests of medium complexity. In addition to your daily tasks, you'll have opportunities to contribute to exciting project work from time to time.
   

  

 You'll proactively monitor work queues, execute operational tasks, and update tickets with the actions you've taken. Identifying, analysing, and logging issues before they escalate will be a key part of your role. You'll communicate with other teams and clients to provide support and ensure that changes are executed with clear risk identification and mitigation plans.
   

  

 As part of the shift handover process, you'll highlight key tickets and upcoming critical tasks for the next shift. When needed, you'll escalate tickets to ensure the right focus from our Centres of Excellence (CoE) and other teams. Collaborating with our automation teams, you'll work on optimizing efforts and automating routine tasks, all while coaching our Service desk and L1 teams in both technical and behavioural skills.
   

  

 You'll also establish monitoring for client infrastructure, leading and managing initial client escalations for operational issues. Contributing to the change management process, you'll log change requests, execute approved maintenance activities, and audit incident and request tickets for quality. Your insights will drive trend analysis reports, identifying tasks suitable for automation to reduce tickets and optimize efforts. You might also support disaster recovery functions and other related tasks as needed.

description:

 CSpace Web Solutions Pvt. Ltd. specializes in IT security and delivering robust Infrastructure as a Service and IP Network solutions. The company is committed to protecting digital assets around the clock with its fully managed services. By prioritizing security, CSpace Web Solutions ensures optimal performance and reliability for its clients. * Monitor, maintain, and troubleshoot routers, switches, firewalls, and related services; resolve L2 escalations with clear updates and handoffs.

* Strong troubleshooting under pressure; methodical packet/path/layer approach.

* Awareness of regulatory/compliance context for ISPs; willingness to follow policy strictly.
* Excellent communication and documentation; customer\-aware execution.
* Comfortable in a fast\-paced startup where priorities shift with clear ownership for your tasks.

 , you will design, support, and maintain enterprise LAN environments, including switching, VLANs and redundancy, to ensure stable and secure network connectivity.
   

  

 You will work closely with the Network Operations team to
 **monitor, troubleshoot and resolve LAN incidents** 
 , and you will participate in an
 **On\-Call rotation** 
 to provide timely support for network outages and critical issues outside business hours.
   

  

 You will track DPMO (Defects Per Million Opportunities) to reduce repeat LAN problems and improve overall network reliability.
   

  

 You will also support LGW (LAN Get Well) activities by assisting in the replacement of End‑of‑Life (EOL) network devices, helping keep the LAN environment stable, secure and up to date.
   

  

 This role requires strong troubleshooting skills, hands‑on experience with enterprise switches, Multicast, routing protocol and the ability to work effectively in a team‑based environment.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Support day‑to‑day LAN network operations across campus, clinic and hospital environments.
* Participate in On\-Call rotation to troubleshoot and restore LAN outages and critical incidents.
* Monitor LAN health using operational dashboards and alerts, act on configuration compliance gaps.
* Responsible for access‑layer stability, with strong knowledge of STP/RSTP/MST, root‑bridge design, and rapid resolution of loop and convergence issues in campus LANs
* Troubleshoot Layer‑2 and Layer‑3 LAN issues including VLANs, trunking, STP, port‑channels, and access connectivity.
* Drive DPMO improvements by identifying recurring issues and reducing repeat network defects.
* Execute LGW (LAN Get Well) activities focused on EOL device replacement across access, distribution and core layers.
* Perform IOS upgrades, hardware refreshes, and switch lifecycle activities aligned with standards.
* Plan and execute maintenance window changes, including cutovers, migrations, and post‑change validation.
* Create and follow MOPs, perform port mapping, and coordinate with field/CTS/EUS teams during site work.
* Ensure configuration standardization and compliance across LAN devices.
* Support incident management, RCA and problem management with clear documentation and communication.
* Collaborate with LAN Engineering, Wireless, Security and Service Desk teams to maintain stable and reliable LAN services.
* Use SolarWinds to monitor switch availability, performance, alerts, and inventory; ensure LAN devices are properly onboarded and monitored.
* Support network segmentation initiatives, including VLAN‑based segmentation and coordination with Cisco ISE enforcement for access control and policy compliance.
* Implement and maintain DCFC LAN standards, ensuring switch configurations, design, and segmentation align with approved enterprise and clinical network guidelines.
* Identify and automate repetitive LAN operational tasks using Python, Ansible, or similar scripting tools to improve efficiency, consistency, and reliability across campus access‑layer environments.


**What would your day look like?**
* Start the day by reviewing LAN health and alerts in SolarWinds, ensuring switches across campuses, clinics, and hospitals are online and compliant.
* Respond to incidents and service requests, troubleshooting Layer‑2 and Layer‑3 LAN issues such as VLANs, trunking, STP, and access connectivity.
* Own access‑layer health, proactively managing STP/RSTP/MST and responding quickly to any campus LAN loop or convergence events.
* Work with Wireless and Security teams to resolve connectivity and network segmentation issues, including VLAN placement and Cisco ISE enforcement.
* Perform proactive operational work, analysing recurring issues and contributing to DPMO reduction to improve network reliability.
* Execute planned maintenance activities, including IOS upgrades, hardware refreshes, and LGW (LAN Get Well) EOL device replacements.
* Prepare and follow MOPs, coordinate with CTS/EUS field teams, perform cutovers, and validate network stability after changes.
* Ensure LAN configuration standardization and DCFC standards are followed across the environment.
* Participate in On\-Call support as needed, restoring service during after‑hours outages and handing off updates clearly to the team.
* Develop automation scripts (Python/Ansible) to eliminate repetitive LAN operational tasks and improve run‑time efficiency.


**Who are we looking for?**
* Bachelor’s or equivalent in Engineering/Technology.
* 3–5 years total experience in enterprise networking/operations, with:
+ 3\+ years hands\-on experience on LAN protocols.
+ 3\+ years with EOL device replacements
+ 2\+ years with Cisco ISE, multicast and routing protocols.

* Engineer who has good Knowledge of L2/L3 networking: VLANs, STP/MST, LACP/Port‑Channel, OSPF/BGP, HSRP/VRRP, QoS, ACLs/NAT.
* hands‑on LAN engineer who owns day‑to‑day campus access‑layer stability across campuses, clinics, and hospitals.
* An engineer comfortable responding to incidents and service requests, troubleshooting Layer 2 and Layer 3 LAN issues including VLANs, trunking, STP, and access connectivity
* A strong owner of the access layer, proactively managing STP/RSTP/MST and responding quickly to loop or convergence events to minimize user impact.
* A proactive Engineer who analyses recurring issues, contributes to DPMO reduction and continuously improves LAN reliability.
* An engineer experienced in planned maintenance and lifecycle activities, including IOS upgrades, hardware refreshes, and EOL (LGW) device replacements.
* A disciplined Engineer who ensures LAN configuration standardization and DCFC standards are consistently followed.
* A team member willing to participate in On\-Call support, restore service during after‑hours outages, and provide clear handoffs and documentation.
* An engineer who identifies and automates repetitive LAN operational tasks using Python, Ansible or similar scripting tools to improve efficiency, consistency, and reduce manual errors.

description:
**Network Engineer**
 Job Family: Infrastructure \& Cloud Engineering
   

  

 Job Profile:
   

  

 Level: P2
   

  

**OUTGROWN YOUR OWN BACKYARD? COME PLAY IN OURS.**
 At Columbia, we’re as passionate about the outdoors as you are. And while our gear is available worldwide, we’re proud to be based in the Pacific Northwest, where natural wonders are our playground.
   

  

 Every product we make and every task we undertake is inspired by the famous words of our founder, Gert Boyle: “It’s perfect. Now make it better.” As pioneers of relentless improvement, we are constantly evolving.
   

  

 We believe the outdoors is ours to protect and strive to keep our planet healthy. We believe in empowering people to experience the outdoors to the fullest.
   

  

 And we believe in you.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As a
 **Network Engineer** 
 within our India
 **Global Capability Center (GCC)** 
 , you will partner with global infrastructure and cloud engineering teams to operate, monitor, and support Columbia Sportswear’s enterprise, datacenter, and cloud networks. This role is focused on
 **reliable day\-to\-day operations** 
 ,
 **incident response** 
 , and continuously improving service quality through
 **runbooks** 
 and
 **automation** 
 .
   

  

 This role requires strong technical fundamentals, clear English communication skills, and the ability to collaborate effectively across time zones with international stakeholders. You will work alongside senior engineers and network architects to execute standard changes, troubleshoot issues, and help deliver stable, secure connectivity for our global business operations.
   

  

 The position blends
 **network operations** 
 ,
 **observability** 
 , and
 **automation** 
 . You will help create and maintain
 **runbooks** 
 , build automations with
 **Ansible** 
 and
 **infrastructure as code** 
 , and support monitoring and alerting with tools such as
 **LogicMonitor** 
 . Experience with
 **Grafana** 
 is a plus.
   

  

 You will also participate in a shared on\-call rotation to support critical global network events.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Monitor global network health and respond to alerts and incidents, following established procedures and escalating when appropriate.
* Build, maintain, and continuously improve runbooks for incident response, standard changes, and recurring operational tasks.
* Operate and enhance network monitoring and alerting to improve observability across enterprise, datacenter, and cloud environments (e.g., LogicMonitor; Grafana is a plus).
* Perform day\-to\-day network administration including configuration changes, validation, and documentation in accordance with change management processes.
* Troubleshoot connectivity, routing, and application\-impacting network issues across on\-premises, cloud, and hybrid environments.
* Develop and maintain automation using Ansible and infrastructure as code (IaC) practices to reduce manual effort and improve consistency.
* Partner with senior engineers and architects on maintenance, expansion, and modernization initiatives by executing assigned work and providing operational feedback.
* Contribute to continuous improvement by identifying recurring issues and proposing monitoring, runbook, and automation enhancements.
* Prepare clear technical documentation for audiences with varying levels of technical knowledge.
* Engage in vendor and circuit provider coordination as needed for troubleshooting and service restorations.
* Participate in global on\-call rotations for Priority 1 and Priority 2 incidents.
* Work flexibly with occasional evening or early morning meetings aligned to global time zones.


**What You Bring**
* Bachelor's degree in computer science, Engineering, Information Technology, or equivalent experience.
* 3\+ years of experience supporting enterprise, cloud, and/or datacenter networking in an operational or engineering role.
* Ability to communicate clearly and professionally in English—both written and spoken—while working daily with international teams.
* Strong troubleshooting skills across network and application layers, with a structured approach to incident response.
* Demonstrated ability to document procedures and create runbooks that improve team consistency and speed of resolution.
* Self\-motivated, proactive, and committed to continuous learning and skill enhancement.
* Experience working in global teams or distributed engineering environments is preferred.
* Experience with Palo Alto firewall and SD\-WAN products is preferred.


**What You Know**
* Hands\-on experience building automation using Ansible (playbooks, roles, inventories) and applying infrastructure as code (IaC) practices to network operations.
* Experience supporting and maintaining multi\-site corporate networks and datacenter environments, including routine changes and break/fix work.
* Experience with enterprise monitoring and alerting tools (e.g., LogicMonitor).
* Ability to create, maintain, and improve operational documentation and runbooks, including validation steps and rollback plans.
* Solid understanding of network fundamentals and architecture (routing, switching, firewalling) and the operational trade\-offs of common designs.
* Ability to work effectively in a GCC model supporting global technology operations.


**Bonus Skills**
* Experience with Grafana (dashboards, visualization, and alerting) and related observability practices.
* Experience working with Arista switches and routers.
* Professional certifications such as CCNA / CCNP (or equivalent vendor neutral certifications).
* Experience in cloud networking in AWS, Azure, or GCP with a focus on Azure.


*This job description is not meant to be an all\-inclusive list of duties and responsibilities, but constitutes a general definition of the position's scope and function in the company.*

description:

 Tarento is a fast\-growing technology consulting company headquartered in Stockholm, with a strong presence in India and clients across the globe. We specialize in digital transformation, product engineering, and enterprise solutions, working across diverse industries including retail, manufacturing, and healthcare. Our teams combine Nordic values with Indian expertise to deliver innovative, scalable, and high\-impact solutions.
   

  

 We're proud to be recognized as a
 **Great Place to Work** 
 , a testament to our inclusive culture, strong leadership, and commitment to employee well\-being and growth. At Tarento, you’ll be part of a collaborative environment where ideas are valued, learning is continuous, and careers are built on passion and purpose.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We welcome students from design and visual communication backgrounds to intern with our design team as part of their academic internship requirement. Whether you are here for a summer internship, an industry internship, a graduation project, or simply exploring opportunities in the design field, you will work alongside experienced designers on real projects — getting hands\-on exposure to UX, UI, and visual design in a professional product environment. Regardless of the internship type, you will work on real design problems, receive structured mentorship, and leave with a stronger portfolio and a clearer sense of what product design looks like in practice.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Contribute to end\-to\-end product design work — from understanding user problems and mapping flows to designing interfaces that are both functional and visually considered
* Think through design decisions in context — who the user is, what they are trying to do, and how the interface supports or hinders that
* Create visual assets and graphic design elements aligned with brand and design system guidelines
* Participate in design reviews and critique sessions, contributing your perspective and receiving structured feedback
* Support documentation and handoff preparation

* Students currently enrolled in B.Des, B.FTech, BFA, or equivalent design programs
* Open to students from NIFT, NID, design schools, and visual communication programs

**What We Are Looking For**
* A design portfolio or academic project work that shows you can think through a problem, not just style a screen

* Some awareness of product context — understanding that design exists within a larger product, business, and user ecosystem
* Basic understanding of UX principles — layout, hierarchy, user flows, and usability
* Graphic design sensibility — typography, colour, and visual composition
* Working knowledge of Figma or Adobe Creative Suite
* Willingness to learn, take feedback, and iterate fast


**What You Get**
* Hands\-on experience contributing to real product and client design challenges
* Mentorship from senior designers and design leads who care about craft and thinking equally
* Exposure to structured product design processes, critique culture, and professional design workflows
