 Senior Technical Writer
   

  

**Location:** 
 Bengaluru \& Chennai, India
   

  

**Department:** 
 Technical Communication Center of Excellence
   

  

**Company:** 
 Xylem Water Solutions India Private Limited, Global Capability Center, Bangalore
   

  

**About Xylem**
 Xylem is a leading global water technology company committed to solving the world’s most challenging water issues through innovation. Our mission is to enable sustainable, efficient water use and management for communities, industries, and the environment.
   

  

**About The Position**
 As a Senior Technical Writer at Xylem, you will be part of the Global Technical Communication Center of Excellence, responsible for developing world\-class customer documentation (Hardware/Software). You will author and manage content within a Component Content Management System (CCMS), collaborating closely with Project Coordinators and Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) globally. Your work will support customers of Xylem products and systems through clear, accurate, and user\-focused documentation such as Installation and Operation Instructions, Service Manuals, and other technical publications.
   

  

 As you grow in this role, you will have opportunities to contribute to continuous improvement projects, process optimization, and training initiatives within Xylem’s documentation ecosystem.
   

  

**About The Technical Communication Center Of Excellence**
 A global team of technical information specialists responsible for developing customer product information across Xylem’s product portfolio. The team focuses on intelligent content reuse using XML\-based technologies, ensuring all publications are customer\-centric, reusable, and globally consistent across multiple outputs, channels, and languages.
   

  

 Prominent collaterals include Installation and Operation Instructions, Datasheets, Quick Guides, UI Guides, and UX Guides, Technical specifications etc.
   

  

 The team consists of a Content Development (Production) Team, a Localization Team, and a Documentation Systems Team.
   

  

**About The Team In Bengaluru \& Chennai (GCC)**
 The Global Capability Center (GCC) in Bengaluru \& Chennai serves as a shared service; resources supporting Xylem’s global product portfolio — including pumps, turbines, monitoring and control systems, and water analysis equipment. The team contributes to product design, development, testing, and technical documentation to deliver innovative and reliable water technology solutions.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Content Development
   

  

* Develop reusable, structured technical content aligned with Xylem’s authoring guidelines, information model, and style guide.
* Conduct task analysis (TA) and prepare annotated topic lists (ATL).
* Create and maintain Topics, Chaptermaps, Bookmaps, and metadata within the CCMS.
* Produce and maintain illustrations, graphics, and photo\-realistic renderings.
* Ensure the completion of review cycle and software\-assisted checks for grammar, style, and terminology.
* Initiate translation requests and coordinate translation reviews.
* Communicate release updates to stakeholders via designated channels.
* Contribute to the development of the CCMS structure, templates, and information model.
* Participate in initiatives to enhance documentation quality, workflow efficiency, and content governance.


**Required Qualifications**
 Education
   

  

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering (Mechanical, Electronics, Aeronautical, Computer Science, or equivalent field).


**Experience**
* 4–6 years of professional experience as a Technical Writer (Senior level) in an international, English\-language environment.
* Proven expertise in DITA XML authoring and single\-sourcing practices.
* Basic experience creating technical illustrations in vector or raster formats.


 Skills and Competencies
   

  

 Core Skills
   

  

* Excellent command of written and spoken English.
* Strong analytical, organizational, and documentation skills.
* Detail\-oriented, structured, and dependable on meeting deadlines.
* Effective communicator with global, cross\-functional teams.
* Familiarity with Simplified Technical English (STE) and style guides such as the Microsoft or Chicago Manual of Style.
* Understanding of DDLC, SDLC, and Agile workflows.
* Knowledge of single sourcing, metadata management, and conditional profiling.


 Technical Skills
   

  

* Proficiency in DITA XML and CCMS platforms such as Astoria On\-Demand or AEM.
* Skilled in XML editors such as Oxygen XML Editor or Arbortext Editor.
* Experience with terminology and content quality tools such as Acrolinx.
* Proficiency with illustration tools (Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop, Creo Illustrate, Keyshot).
* Experience with collaboration tools like JIRA and Confluence.
* Understanding of content publishing pipelines and localization workflows.
* Working knowledge of XML\-based formats and related technologies (XQuery, metadata tagging).
* Interest in GenAI and automation using Python or similar programming languages is desirable.


 Assessment Process
   

  

* Candidates will complete a writing and structuring test to demonstrate technical English and content organization skills.
* Successful candidates will advance to subsequent interview rounds with technical and hiring teams


 Join the global Xylem team to be a part of innovative technology solutions transforming water usage, conservation, and re\-use. Our products impact public utilities, industrial sectors, residential areas, and commercial buildings, with a commitment to providing smart metering, network technologies, and advanced analytics for water, electric, and gas utilities. Partner with us in creating a world where water challenges are met with ingenuity and dedication; where we recognize the power of inclusion and belonging in driving innovation and allowing us to compete more effectively around the world.

The four LEAD behaviours are: L \- Listen and be authentic, E \- Energise and inspire, A \- Align across the enterprise, D \- Develop others..

 To be successful as a Business Analyst, you should have experience with:

title: JavaScript Developer
description:
**JavaScript Developer :**
 Dassault Systemes' ENOVIA is the world's leading solution for collaborative product development and lifecycle management. Deployed by global leaders such as Honda, Toyota, Boeing, and Airbus — across 12 industries spanning mobility, aerospace, life sciences, and infrastructure — it manages the complete journey of a product from concept to end\-of\-life.
   

  

 The ENOVIA India R\&D team designs and builds the next generation of PLM solutions on cloud. Our products directly influence how the world's manufacturers design, validate, change, and realize complex products. We work in an AI\-augmented engineering model: leverage AI tools to accelerate delivery; human engineers provide the domain judgment, architectural oversight, and quality validation that AI cannot replace.
   

  

 As a JavaScript Developer in ENOVIA India, you will design, develop, and maintain web applications and features that are central to how the world's leading organizations manage their product lifecycle. Working closely with Application and Product Managers, you will build consistent, high\-quality applications by creating reusable components using standard JavaScript (ES6\+), HTML5, and CSS3\.
   

  

 You will leverage AI coding assistants to accelerate development of UX components and features while applying your own judgment to validate, refine, and extend the output. You should understand where AI assistance is genuinely useful in JavaScript development and where human review is irreplaceable to validate generated output for correctness, cross\-browser compatibility, and security.
   

  

 You will also collaborate with stakeholders to resolve dependencies, break down work, and contribute to functional and performance tests.
   

  

**Role Description \& Responsibilities**
* Define, develop, and maintain ENOVIA web applications' features and components, with a focus on performance, accessibility, reusability and cross\-browser correctness.
* As part of an AI\-enabled SDLC, leverage AI coding assistants for development, code reviews, and test case generation, while ensuring the quality and safety of AI\-generated output.
* Build consistent, reusable JavaScript components using standard vanilla JavaScript (ES6\+), HTML5, and CSS3
* Collaborate with Product Managers to translate product requirements into implementations.
* Resolve technical issues through debugging, research, and investigation — creating new and innovative ways to improve platform applications
* Debug complex issues across a distributed team environment; work closely with customer\-facing teams on production issues.
* Mentor junior engineers; share knowledge on both JavaScript best practices and effective AI tool workflows.
+ PLM / Domain Skills
- Development exposure to ENOVIA or equivalent PLM platforms
- Awareness of PLM domain concepts: BOM, Engineering Change Management, Product Configuration, Document Management
- Industry exposure: automotive, aerospace, manufacturing, life sciences, infrastructure (nice to have)

+ AI Skills
- Demonstrated use of AI coding assistants (Copilot, Cursor, ChatGPT) in real workflow
- Critical review of AI\-generated code: logic errors, security risks, XSS vulnerabilities, incorrect async patterns, edge cases, style
- Effective prompt writing and iterative refinement of AI output
- AI for non\-code tasks: requirement drafting, test case generation, documentation

+ Software Engineering Skills
- CS fundamentals: data structures, algorithms, OOD, design patterns — applied to applications in production
- Strong system thinking skills to design and build responsive, scalable, and maintainable JavaScript applications
- Understanding of browser security fundamentals
- Strong debugging and root\-cause analysis across distributed codebases
- Understanding of Cloud environments and CI/CD pipelines
- DevOps practices and basic SQL

+ JavaScript Skills
- Strong JavaScript proficiency — ES6 and later: Promises, async/await, modules, classes, destructuring, event handling, DOM manipulation and AMD (require.js).
- Knowledge of Java, JUnit, or server\-side integration patterns for collaborating effectively with backend teams
- Good knowledge of Client\-Server architectures and RESTful API design

+ Collaboration \& Soft Skills
- Good team spirit and interpersonal skills.
- Excellent written, Verbal, Communication skills, Analytical skills \& Business thinking.
- Adaptability, ability to learn faster, to be independent, responsible and diligent


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering from a reputed institution.
* 3–5 years of professional experience in JavaScript and Web technologies in an enterprise software company or product organisation.


**What's In It For You**
* Work at the intersection of deep PLM domain expertise and AI\-augmented engineering; a rare combination that will define the highest\-value development of the decade.
* Contribute to products used by global industry leaders across 12 sectors, directly influencing how major manufacturers design and build the products we all use.
* Grow in an environment that values engineering craft, domain curiosity, and AI fluency equally; not just raw coding.
* Collaborate with engineering colleagues across the globe as part of a world\-class PLM organization.
* Be part of a team actively shaping how AI is integrated into enterprise product engineering \- from the inside.


 Inclusion statement
   

  

 As a game\-changer in sustainable technology and innovation, Dassault Systèmes is striving to build more inclusive and diverse teams across the globe. We believe that our people are our number one asset and we want all employees to feel empowered to bring their whole selves to work every day. It is our goal that our people feel a sense of pride and a passion for belonging. As a company leading change, it’s our responsibility to foster opportunities for all people to participate in a harmonized Workforce of the Future.

title: HR Head
description:
**Job Description – HR Head** 




**Position Details** 




**Position Name: HR Head** 




**Location: IIT Kanpur, Kalyanpur** 




**Reports to: PIC\-IFACET** 




  





**About IFACET** 




 IFACET is a Section 8 company established to drive industry\-oriented education, training, skilling, consulting, and outreach initiatives associated with Indian Institute of Technology Kanpur.
 



 IFACET aims to create a professionally managed, self\-sustaining ecosystem for continuing education, executive learning, industry engagement, digital learning platforms, and strategic institutional initiatives. The organization operates with startup\-like agility while adhering to the governance and compliance framework applicable to Section 8 entities under the Companies Act, 2013\.
 



  





**Role Summary** 




 The HR Head will be a founding leadership role responsible for establishing and scaling the complete Human Resources function for IFACET from the ground up.
 



 This role extends beyond conventional HR operations and requires a strategic builder mindset. The incumbent will lead the design and implementation of people strategy, organisational architecture, governance frameworks, talent systems, compensation structures, culture\-building initiatives, and scalable HR processes aligned with a high\-growth, mission\-driven organisation.
 



 The role demands the ability to bridge academic ecosystems with professional corporate execution models while enabling agility, institutional excellence, and operational scalability.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. HR Strategy \& Organisational Design** 



* Design and implement the end\-to\-end HR strategy aligned with IFACET’s long\-term vision and growth roadmap
* Develop organisational structures, reporting hierarchies, workforce planning frameworks, and role definitions
* Establish scalable HR systems and people practices suitable for a rapidly growing institution
* Partner with leadership on organisational effectiveness and transformation initiatives



  





**2\. Talent Acquisition \& Workforce Build\-Out** 



* Lead end\-to\-end recruitment strategy for leadership, academic, technical, consulting, digital, and operational roles
* Build talent acquisition processes, employer branding initiatives, and hiring pipelines
* Develop onboarding and induction frameworks for rapid scaling
* Create a high\-performance, mission\-driven workforce from inception



  





**3\. Policy, Governance \& Compliance** 



* Draft and implement HR policies, employee handbooks, service rules, and code of conduct frameworks
* Ensure compliance with:
* Companies Act requirements applicable to Section 8 companies
* Labour laws and statutory regulations
* Payroll and employment compliance requirements
* Establish governance mechanisms aligned with Board oversight and institutional structures
* Develop grievance redressal and disciplinary frameworks



  





**4\. Compensation \& Benefits Framework** 



* Design competitive compensation structures suitable for a high\-performance not\-for\-profit environment
* Benchmark compensation across academia, startups, consulting, and industry ecosystems
* Develop performance\-linked incentive structures and retention frameworks
* Create contractual models for consultants, project staff, adjunct professionals, and full\-time employees



  





**5\. Performance Management \& Culture Building** 



* Develop and implement a robust Performance Management System (PMS)
* Define KPIs and outcome frameworks across functions
* Build a culture focused on:
* Ownership
* Agility
* Accountability
* Institutional excellence
* Innovation and impact
* Drive leadership development and succession planning initiatives



  





**6\. HR Systems \& Digital Infrastructure** 



* Set up and operationalize HRMS and digital HR tools covering:
* Recruitment
* Payroll
* Performance tracking
* Employee lifecycle management
* Attendance and leave systems
* Ensure scalability and process automation for future organizational growth



  





**7\. Employee Engagement \& Institutional Culture** 



* Build a strong institutional identity and employee experience framework for IFACET
* Design engagement initiatives for a diverse workforce comprising academic, corporate, consulting, and operational professionals
* Foster collaboration between institutional and industry stakeholders
* Build policies supporting a flexible workforce and project\-based engagement models



  





**8\. Stakeholder Management** 



* Work closely with senior leadership and institutional stakeholders
* Act as a bridge between academic systems and professional execution models
* Support organisational decision\-making through HR analytics and workforce insights



  





**Desired Qualifications \& Experience** 




**Educational Qualifications** 



* MBA / PGDM in Human Resources from a reputed institution
* Additional qualifications in Labour Law, Organisational Development, or HR Analytics will be preferred



  





**Experience** 



* 8–12\+ years of progressive experience in HR leadership roles
* Demonstrated experience in:
* Building HR functions from scratch
* Startup or new organisation setup
* High\-growth or transformation environments
* Exposure to education, consulting, skilling, research, or knowledge\-sector organisations will be highly desirable



  





**Desired Competencies** 



* Strategic thinking and an institution\-building mindset
* Strong understanding of HR governance and compliance frameworks
* Experience in workforce scaling and organisational transformation
* Strong interpersonal and stakeholder management capabilities
* Ability to work in dynamic and evolving environments
* High ownership orientation and execution capability
* Strong communication and leadership skills



  





**Application Process** 




 Interested candidates may apply by submitting their CV and relevant details on or before
 



**18th May 2026 (5:30 PM IST).** 




  





**Equal Opportunity Statement** 




 IFACET is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering innovation, diversity, inclusion, and impact.

title: Assistant Manager- Talent Consulting EY- Parthenon
description:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
   

  

 We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
   

  

 Join EY and help to build a better working world.
   

  

**Talent Consultant\- Supervising Associate**
 If you are looking for a challenging and rewarding career experience as a Talent Consultant in a high\-growth organization, we have a role here. At EY GDS we value wellbeing, curiosity, and agility as an individual. We create teams of inspiring, teaming, and belonging. We care for our business, society, and client. Our purpose is building a better working world. Does that resonate with you? We look forward to working with you.
   

  

**The opportunity**
 You will be responsible for supporting the Talent agenda for a business unit in EY GDS and will be the key point of contact for employees, counselors (managers) and business unit leadership on a range of talent\-related matters. You will drive and implement the engagement agenda, work closely with other members of the team to provide change leadership, increase workforce capability and talent management. You will build a deep understanding of business unit direction and Talent related topics/issues to ensure successful implementation of key projects and processes.
   

  

 You will need to be collaborative, influential, and work across functions to execute on attracting, assimilate, develop, engaging and retain key talent. You will drive project management for various HR (Human Resource) initiatives, including Workforce Planning, Performance Management, Talent transformation, Talent Development and Reward \& Recognition etc
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Support the Strategic Talent Consultant in designing a sustainable and scalable engagement framework for the business unit and take ownership for the delivery
* Provide support to the business leaders and counsellors in the implementation of engagement initiatives across the business unit
* Anticipate issues and needs within the business unit and address these effectively
* Provide insight on people issues, particularly ER (Employee Relations) cases within business unit, provide a robust point of view on business decisions and their impact upon people
* Ensure that all necessary people management and development activity required to support the business unit is delivered in the most professional and effective manner
* Execute innovative HR programs
* Ensure resolution of HR related issues and handle these effectively within the given timeline, involving the Employee Relation Talent function where required or expected
* Facilitate change and support the implementation and successful adoption of special projects and initiatives in the business unit, for example: Performance Management, Talent transformation, Talent Development and Reward exercises
* Ensure compliance to local regulations and manage risks (e.g., performance management risk)


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Strong business acumen and commercial awareness, ability to develop clear, actionable plans in support of an overall business unit strategy
* Ability to engage and influence others, with good change management skills and a desire to act as a change agent
* Strong clients focus with the ability to build good relationships with multiple stakeholders across the organisation at all levels
* Strong Employee Relations experience of complex disciplinary, grievance and performance management activities, especially with employees in senior management/leadership level
* Develop strong relationship with other Talent Centre of Excellence teams to ensure that centrally developed products and initiatives meet the requirements of the business unit
* Ability to work with ambiguity and build consensus across diverse, often global, groups


**To qualify for the role, you must have**
* Graduate or a post graduate qualification in a Business or Human Resource discipline is desirable.
* 6\-8 years of proven HR generalist experience (e.g., performance management, employee relations
* Relevant working experience in delivering / managing talent initiatives


**Ideally, you’ll also have**
* Experience working in a consulting organization or in a similar professional services environment
* Experience of working in a cross\-border, virtual environment would be beneficial


**What We Look For**
* Keen interest to invest time for self\-learning, seeking opportunities to work on cross\-functional HR projects
* Working collaboratively in a team environment
* A self\-starter, independent\-thinker, curious and creative person with desire and passion


**What We Offer**

 About Company
 



 A venture\-backed startup founded in 2023, revolutionizing spacecraft components for low\-earth\-orbit satellites. The company makes high\-quality space hardware more accessible by delivering essential ADCS components faster and at lower prices than traditional suppliers.
 



 You'll join a dynamic seed\-stage team of engineers on a mission to modernize the space component supply chain. The team includes hardware\-focused professionals with experience in high\-volume scaleups, collaborating across US and Bengaluru operations to build the future of commercial space technology.

 You'll develop and deploy machine learning models that run on GPU hardware aboard satellites in low\-earth\-orbit missions. You'll have the unique opportunity to see your models operational in flight, contributing directly to satellite attitude determination and control systems. You'll work at the cutting edge of AI and aerospace, optimizing algorithms for the extreme constraints of space environments while collaborating with experienced hardware teams to integrate your models into operational satellite subsystems.
 



  





 Role \& Responsibilities
 



 • You design and develop machine learning models optimized for satellite GPU hardware constraints
 



 • You implement real\-time inference algorithms for attitude determination and control systems
 



 • You optimize model performance for power\-limited space environments and radiation tolerance
 



 • You collaborate with hardware teams to integrate ML models into satellite subsystems
 



 • You conduct ground testing and validation of models before flight deployment
 



 • You monitor and analyze model performance from operational satellites in orbit
 



 • You develop data pipelines for processing satellite telemetry and sensor data
 



  





 Must Have Criteria
 



 • 1\-4 years of experience in machine learning model development and deployment
 



 • Expert\-level proficiency in PyTorch and TensorFlow for deep learning development
 



 • Strong experience with computer vision algorithms and image processing techniques
 



 • Hands\-on experience with reinforcement learning for control systems applications
 



 • Proficiency in time series analysis and forecasting for sensor data processing
 



 • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related technical field
 



  





 Nice to Have
 



 • Experience with aerospace or satellite systems development
 



 • Knowledge of attitude determination and control systems (ADCS)
 



 • Experience with edge AI deployment in resource\-constrained environments
 



 • Familiarity with space\-grade hardware and radiation\-hardened systems
 



  





 What We Offer
 



 • Opportunity to see your AI models operational in space missions
 



 • Work on cutting\-edge technology at the intersection of AI and aerospace
 



 • Collaborative environment with experienced space industry professionals
 



 • Competitive compensation and equity in a fast\-growing space startup
 



 • Direct impact on the future of commercial satellite technology

**Job Description** **Job Summary**


The Associate Manager – Statistical Operations leads end‑to‑end statistical and analytical operations supporting **RMS and OMNI business planning and decision‑making**. The role ensures high‑quality forecasting, **universe‑level trend tracking, KPI validation, and Store \& Sample Maintenance**, along with overall operational rigor using internal, syndicated, and panel data.


This role partners closely with **Analytics, Data Science, Sourcing, Transformation \& Enablement, Business, Technology, and People (HR)** teams to deliver reliable statistical outcomes while fostering strong team collaboration and associate development.

**Statistical Operations**

* Own end‑to‑end statistical operations across forecasting and analytics workflows, including data intake, validation, model inputs, output reviews, and downstream hand‑offs.
* Ensure **accurate, timely, and SLA‑compliant delivery** of forecasts, validated KPIs, universe metrics, and analytical outputs across RMS and OMNI processes.
* Monitor and assess **universe‑level trends** to ensure stability, consistency, and alignment across time periods and data sources.
* Perform **KPI validation and data health checks**, ensuring completeness, reasonability, and adherence to defined statistical standards.
* Lead **Store \& Sample Maintenance processes**, including store and sample additions, removals, corrections, alignment, and ongoing universe maintenance.
* Ensure store‑ and sample‑level data integrity through regular validation, reconciliation, and impact assessments on forecasts and KPIs.
* Leverage **panel and syndicated data** to support forecasting, universe trend analysis, KPI validation, and statistical measurements.
* Support analytical enablement for **new initiatives, pilots, and ongoing programs** requiring statistical support or model updates.
* Manage historical and ongoing updates such as **universe restatements, store/sample maintenance updates, trend adjustments, and KPI corrections**, with strong governance and documentation.
* Review and validate statistical methodologies, assumptions, and outputs to ensure consistency across datasets, models, stores/samples, and time horizons.
* Conduct forecast and KPI performance reviews and drive continuous stability and accuracy improvement initiatives.
* Lead and contribute to **cross‑functional analytical projects** aimed at strengthening statistical processes and operational efficiency.
* Drive **automation and process optimization** initiatives to reduce manual effort, improve scalability, and enhance data reliability.
* Partner with **Analytics, Data Science, and Transformation \& Enablement teams** to transition pilots into BAU operations.

**Tools \& Systems**

* Hands‑on experience with **R, Python, SQL, and Advanced Excel**.
* Familiarity with **enterprise forecasting, planning, or analytics platforms** and data warehouse environments.
* Exposure to **automation, scripting, or workflow optimization** initiatives is preferred.

  

**Qualifications**  

* **8–10 years of progressive experience** in statistical operations, forecasting, analytics, or decision science roles, preferably within **FMCG / CPG, Retail, or Consumer Analytics** environments.
* Proven experience supporting **business planning, demand forecasting, or performance analytics** in large‑scale or matrixed organizations.
* Demonstrated exposure to **panel and syndicated data** used for demand forecasting, causal analysis, and trend interpretation.
* Experience working with **retailer‑level data**, including promotions, pricing, assortment changes, store coverage, and distribution dynamics.
* Prior experience operating in **production / BAU analytical environments** with defined SLAs, governance, and recurring delivery cycles.

  

**Additional Information** **Our Benefits**

* Flexible working environment
* Volunteer time off
* LinkedIn Learning
* Employee\-Assistance\-Program (EAP)
